--- source: "motionsites" id: "vertex" title: "Vertex" category: "Ecommerce" type: "hero" types: [] license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md" url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#vertex" --- Build a single, self-contained, production-ready `index.html` — one file, no build step, no frameworks, no local assets. It renders a full-viewport dark hero section for a fictional e-commerce SaaS called "Vertex Shops". Every image loads from the absolute CloudFront URLs in §8. There is NO video anywhere in this page. Two components below are marked PIXEL CONTRACT. Those are the most commonly botched parts of this design. Implement them exactly as written, including the DO-NOT lists. Do not "improve" them, do not substitute a more conventional button/pill pattern, do not add glows or centring that is not specified. ===================================================================== 0. GLOBAL SHELL ===================================================================== , . Vision — Streamline the shop virtual FONTS — exactly these three tags in , in this order: Reset: *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box} html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} /* page never scrolls */ body{font-family:Poppins,Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased} a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit} /* REQUIRED - button labels must never underline */ ===================================================================== 1. CORE ARCHITECTURE — A FIXED DESIGN CANVAS THAT IS SCALED ===================================================================== The single most important idea: the desktop composition is authored at a fixed 1172 x 657 px design canvas. EVERY element is absolutely positioned in raw design pixels — there is no flow layout, no flexbox column, no auto-centring on desktop. The whole canvas is then scaled by ONE transform to fit the viewport. The optical centre of every centred element is x=586. .stage{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} .canvas{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:1172px;height:657px; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(var(--k,1));transform-origin:50% 0} .canvas>*{position:absolute} .stack{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:300} /* layout shell, no box of its own */ .stack>*{position:absolute} .navmenu{display:contents} /* shell, invisible on desktop */ .burger{display:none} /* desktop */ Scale law, computed in JS on every resize: k = min(vw / W, vh / 560) Using 560 (not 657) as the height divisor is deliberate: it fills the width and lets the browser mock bleed off the bottom edge rather than letterboxing. W = 1172 on desktop; see §10 for the tablet ramp. Background (never animates — it is the stage): .bg{position:absolute;inset:0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(25,127,255,0) 38%, rgba(25,127,255,.042) 54%, rgba(25,127,255,.052) 68%, rgba(25,127,255,.030) 100%), #020204} STARFIELD — two 1x1px divs whose entire star field is one giant box-shadow list, generated in JS. .stars{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px; border-radius:50%;background:#fff} Layer A (#stA): 150 stars, blur 0px, alpha random .05–.30 Layer B (#stB): 18 stars, blur 1.2px, alpha random .35–.70 Each entry: "vw vh px 0 rgba(255,255,255,)", joined with commas, assigned to el.style.boxShadow. ===================================================================== 1.5 EXACT COORDINATE TABLE — NON-NEGOTIABLE ===================================================================== All values are design pixels inside the 1172 x 657 canvas. Reproduce every one. If your layout does not match this table, the layout is wrong. ELEMENT POSITION SIZE RADIUS .nav left 247, top 3 678 x 64 32 .mark left 21, top 19 (in nav) 24 x 24 — .wm left 50, top 0 (in nav) auto — .wm .kick left 3, top 20 auto — .wm .name left 0, top 26 auto — .links left 156, top 0 (in nav) auto x 62 — .nav .btn left 530.7,top 10.5 125.5 x 39.5 14 .badge left 462, top 95 250 x 39 12 .badge i left 4, top 4 (in badge) 29 x 29 8 .badge b left 45, top 0 (in badge) auto x 39 — .h1 (both lines) left 586, translateX(-50%) nowrap — #h1a first baseline y 204.5 ink width 563.5 cap height 37.2 #h1b first baseline y 258.5 ink width 197.5 cap height 37.2 .sub (both lines) left 586, translateX(-50%) nowrap — #sub1 first baseline y 300.5 ink width 389 cap height 8.4 #sub2 first baseline y 316.5 ink width 311 cap height 8.4 .cta2 left 526, top 349 121 x 54.5 13 .showcase left 0, top 0 1172 x 0 — .ring left 0, top 0 1172 x 657 — .card left 586, top 616 130 x 300 12 margin:-150px 0 0 -65px (so the card centres on that point) .browser left 165, top 558 842 x calc(99px + var(--fill,0px)) radius 28 28 0 0 .page left 7, right 6, top 42, bottom 0 10 10 0 0 .wa right 16, bottom 24 (in .stage, OUTSIDE .canvas) 56 x 56 50% Z-INDEX ORDER (front to back): .nav 400 · .stack / .h1 / .sub / .cta2 / .badge / .wa 300 · .browser 100 · .ring 5 · .bg 0. The browser mock MUST paint in FRONT of the carousel ring, overlapping its lower third. That overlap is the whole point of the composition. Remaining ink targets for the type fitter (§11): #wmName ink 51 cap 11.4 first baseline y 38.5 #badgeTxt ink 184 cap 9.4 transform pre 'translate(2px,-1px)' #ctaLabel ink 87 cap 8.9 then optically centred in its button #vpLabel ink 76 cap 9.5 then optically centred in its button .links a cap 7.9 (one shared size), then the whole row squeezed to width 317 ===================================================================== 2. PIXEL CONTRACT A — THE BADGE ===================================================================== The badge is a FIXED-SIZE absolutely-positioned box with an icon tile pinned to its left edge and a left-aligned label beside it. It is NOT a centred pill and NOT a flex row. .badge{left:462px;top:95px;width:250px;height:39px;border-radius:12px;z-index:300; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.115); /* faint bank of light along the foot, sampled off the prototype */ background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(190,225,255,.175) 0px, rgba(190,225,255,.128) 2px, rgba(190,225,255,.075) 4px, rgba(190,225,255,.026) 6px, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 9px, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 100%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035)} .badge i{position:absolute;left:4px;top:4px;width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:8px; display:grid;place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(to top, #46afc8 0px, #35abc7 2px, #0b859d 4px, #026c84 6px, #004e66 8px, #053f58 10px, #012c3d 12px, #031a2a 14px, #061125 16px, #090f25 19px, #090c1c 23px, #060d16 29px); box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 rgba(150,220,250,.40), inset -1px 0 0 rgba(150,220,250,.52), 0 0 6px rgba(60,190,230,.20), 0 3px 8px -5px rgba(90,220,255,.6)} .badge i svg{width:14px;height:16px;position:relative;top:-1px;left:0px} .badge b{position:absolute;left:45px;transform-origin:0 50%;top:0;height:39px; display:flex;align-items:center; font-size:13px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);white-space:nowrap; padding-top:1.5px} Markup:
…bolt svg…Professionals at store startup
Bolt SVG: viewBox "5 1 14 22", preserveAspectRatio="none", fill rgba(16,112,152,.72), stroke rgba(190,236,255,.6), stroke-width 1.6, stroke-linejoin round, single path: "M13.9 1.6 5.5 13.6a.7.7 0 0 0 .6 1.1h4.2l-1 7.7a.7.7 0 0 0 1.25.55l8.3-12.1a.7.7 0 0 0-.6-1.1h-4.2l1-7.7a.7.7 0 0 0-1.25-.55Z" How it must LOOK: a dark, almost transparent 250x39 rounded rectangle with a 1px hairline border. At its far left, inset 4px, a small bright cyan-to-navy rounded square holding a white-stroked lightning bolt. The label begins 45px from the badge's left edge — a clear 12px gap after the tile — reads left-to-right, and is vertically centred in the 39px height. Tile and text NEVER overlap. DO NOT: - do not centre the label in the badge, and do not use justify-content:center, text-align:center, or margin:auto on .badge b - do not make .badge display:flex with a gap and let the icon and text flow - do not let the badge width grow to fit the text (it is exactly 250px; the text is scaled to a 184px ink width by the fitter) - do not put the icon on top of, or behind, the text - do not add an outer glow, drop-shadow, or coloured ring to .badge itself - do not increase the border-radius into a full pill (it is 12px, not 20px) ===================================================================== 3. PIXEL CONTRACT B — THE GLOW BUTTON (.btn), USED TWICE ===================================================================== The signature element: a near-black button with a bank of cyan light pooled at its FOOT. That light is a BACKGROUND GRADIENT CLIPPED BY THE BUTTON'S OWN ROUNDED RECT. It is not a glow, not a shadow, not a separate bar, not a neon underline. `overflow:hidden` is mandatory and does the clipping. .btn{display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden; /* bloom is a fixed ~18px bank of light at the foot, sampled row by row */ background:linear-gradient(to top, #9ad9ec 1px, #89dff0 2px, #79e0f1 3px, #61daef 4px, #3ec8e4 5px, #14a8c6 6px, #0596b3 7px, #038aa8 8px, #047796 9px, #006180 10px, #025066 12px, #0a4f5e 13px, #04465a 14px, #073746 16px, #0a2a37 18px, #0d212e 20px, #0f1824 24px, #0a121e 30px, #0a111d 34px, #0a111d 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 3px -2px rgba(180,228,255,.10), inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.09), inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.09), var(--hair,0 1px 0 rgba(152,218,234,.38)), 1px 0 0 rgba(152,218,234,.17), -1px 0 0 rgba(152,218,234,.17), 0 0 8px rgba(60,190,235,.10), 0 2px 5px -3px rgba(90,220,255,.45); transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,filter .25s} .btn::before — a thin bright streak across the TOP edge only: content:"";position:absolute;left:22%;right:38%;top:0.8px;height:1.9px;z-index:1; filter:blur(.55px); background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(120,225,255,0) 0%,rgba(120,225,255,.58) 34%, rgba(160,240,255,.74) 50%,rgba(120,225,255,.58) 66%,rgba(120,225,255,0) 100%) .btn::after — side edge-light, 13px inward falloff, MASKED so it attenuates up the button (boost over the fill: +50 @12px from the foot, +35 @18, +25 @24, +17 @30). The mask is mandatory; without it the edge light floods the entire button. content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;z-index:1; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(200,245,255,.70),rgba(200,245,255,0) 13px), linear-gradient(270deg,rgba(200,245,255,.70),rgba(200,245,255,0) 13px); -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(to top,#000 0,#000 6px,rgba(0,0,0,.40) 12px, rgba(0,0,0,.15) 18px,rgba(0,0,0,.09) 24px,rgba(0,0,0,.02) 30px,rgba(0,0,0,.02) 100%); mask:linear-gradient(to top,#000 0,#000 6px,rgba(0,0,0,.40) 12px, rgba(0,0,0,.15) 18px,rgba(0,0,0,.09) 24px,rgba(0,0,0,.02) 30px,rgba(0,0,0,.02) 100%) .btn span{position:relative;z-index:2;display:block;line-height:1; text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,20,30,.5)} .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);filter:brightness(1.12); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(200,245,255,.6),inset 1px 0 0 rgba(170,225,255,.35), inset -1px 0 0 rgba(170,225,255,.35),0 6px 22px rgba(20,180,225,.55)} Instance A — nav CTA, Build new shop: .nav .btn{position:absolute;left:530.7px;top:10.5px;width:125.5px;height:39.5px; border-radius:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.005em} .nav .btn span{margin-top:0} Instance B — hero CTA, See prices: .cta2{position:absolute;left:526px;top:349px;width:121px;height:54.5px; --hair:0 0 0 transparent;border-radius:13px;font-size:17px;font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.01em;z-index:300} .cta2::before{display:none} /* the HERO button has no top streak; the nav one does */ .cta2 span{margin-top:0} How it must LOOK: the top ~60% of the button is near-black (#0a111d). The bottom ~18px is a saturated teal-to-pale-cyan band, brightest in its last 1-5px, fading upward and dying out completely by 34px. The band spans the full inner width and its bottom corners follow the button's border-radius exactly — it is visibly cut off by the button's own edge, with nothing bleeding past it. The nav button also carries a faint 2px light streak across its top edge. The label is centred, white, Poppins 500, never underlined. DO NOT: - do not add ANY outer glow or halo: no extra box-shadow with a blur above 8px, no filter:drop-shadow, no blurred pseudo-element sitting outside the button, no ::before/::after positioned beyond inset:0. The box-shadow list above is complete and final — its largest outer blur is 8px at 10% alpha. - do not omit overflow:hidden; without it the light bank escapes the rounded rect - do not omit the ::after mask - do not replace the multi-stop foot gradient with a simple two-colour gradient, a solid bar, a ::after bar, or a border-bottom - do not let the light bank read as a separate element beneath the button - do not give .cta2 a ::before streak, and do not remove it from the nav button - do not use a

ms-price-calculator.promptText:
---
source: "motionsites"
id: "price-calculator"
title: "Price Calculator"
category: "SaaS"
type: "pricing"
types: []
license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md"
url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#price-calculator"
---

Recreate Project Estimation Calculator Section

Create a full-width dark calculator section with id calculator-section. Background: bg-background, padding py-16 md:py-28 px-4 md:px-16, max-width max-w-7xl centered.

Header: Centered. Small mono uppercase tracking-widest label "Try project estimation calculator" in text-muted-foreground. Below it, an h2: "Get premium website within your budget" — text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-normal.

Layout: 2-column grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2), rounded-2xl overflow-hidden, no gap.

LEFT COLUMN (Calculator Form): Background #0D0D0D, padding p-8 lg:p-12, sections divided by divide-y divide-[#1E1E1E].

4 sections separated by horizontal dividers:

Service Type (radio buttons): h3 "What kind of service do you need?" — 3 options: "Only Design" (design), "Only Development" (development), "Design + Development" (both, default). Custom radio circles: w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2, active = border-[#FF5656] with inner w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#FF5656].

Number of Pages (slider): h3 with current value in #FF5656. Shadcn <Slider> min=1, max=30, step=1, default=5. Labels "1" and "30" below.

Add-ons (checkboxes): Two checkboxes with price labels on the right in #FF5656:

"I will need help with content" → +$50/pages

"I want to optimize my website for SEO" → +$50/pages Custom checkboxes: w-5 h-5 border-2 rounded, checked = border-[#FF5656] bg-[#FF5656] with white SVG checkmark.

Timeline (radio buttons): h3 "How fast do you need this?" — 3 options with prices:

"Within 7 Days" → +$100/pages

"Within 14 Days" → +$25/pages

"Regular Speed (Based on discussion)" → no extra cost (default)

RIGHT COLUMN (Cost Estimation): Padding p-8 lg:p-12, border border-white/10 rounded-r-2xl, min-height 717.98px.

h3 "Estimated Cost" + description paragraph.

3 stacked cards (rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-3):

Agency card: bg-muted/50. Title "Typical Agency charges minimum". Large price text-4xl font-bold. Subtitle: "+ Too much extra time & additional cost".

Freelancer card: bg-muted/50. Title "Regular Freelancer charges minimum". Large price text-4xl font-bold. Subtitle: "+ Too much headache & back-and-forth".

Your price card: bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-orange-500 text-white. Title "With Webfluin Studio". Price text-5xl font-bold. Subtitle: "Save your money, time & headache".

PRICING LOGIC:

calculatePrice():
  Base prices by service:
    design: base=399, perPage=100
    development: base=199, perPage=100
    both: base=499, perPage=200
  
  total = max(base, base + (pages - 1) * perPage)
  if needContent: total += pages * 50
  if needSEO: total += pages * 50
  if rush: total += pages * 100
  if fast: total += pages * 25

calculateAgencyCost():
  perPage = (both ? 1000 : 400)
  return 8000 + (pages - 1) * perPage

calculateFreelancerCost():
  perPage = (both ? 500 : 200)
  return 3000 + (pages - 1) * perPage

All prices displayed with .toLocaleString() and $ prefix.

State: serviceType (design|development|both, default both), pages (number, default 5), needContent (bool), needSEO (bool), timeline (regular|fast|rush, default regular).

Dependencies: Shadcn Slider component, useToast hook.

ms-haul-footer.promptText:
---
source: "motionsites"
id: "haul-footer"
title: "HAUL!"
category: "Footer Section"
type: "footer"
types: []

url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#haul-footer"
---

Build a React functional component using Tailwind CSS, `motion/react` for animations, and `lucide-react` for icons.

**1. Typography & Setup:**
- Import the "Inter" font from Google Fonts (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) and set it as the default sans-serif font in the Tailwind config/CSS.
- The overall background of the page should be `#f8f9fa`.

**2. Top Spacer Section (View Below):**
- Create a section at the top of the page. Height should be `50vh` (on mobile/lg) and `30vh` (on md screens).
- Background color: `#FDFDFD`.
- Center a text element that says "View Below". The text should be `text-gray-300`, small font, bold, uppercase, with wide `tracking-[0.5em]`.
- Animate this text with Framer Motion to fade in from `opacity: 0` to `opacity: 1`.

**3. Main Parallax Container:**
- Below the spacer, create a main full-viewport-height (`h-screen`) section.
- Set its background image to: `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260430_115327_3f256636-9e63-4885-8d0b-09317dc2b0a5.png&w=1280&q=85`
- Make sure the background covers the container (`bg-cover bg-center`) and set `overflow-hidden` with `relative` positioning.
- Set up a Framer Motion `useScroll` target on this container. Map the `scrollYProgress` from `[0, 1]` to `[-50, 150]` using `useTransform`. Apply this transformed y-value to the foreground truck image layer (described below).

**4. The Top-Aligned Footer Card:**
- Position a container `absolute top-0 w-full` inside the main parallax section. Give it top padding (`pt-12` mobile/lg, `pt-24` tablet).
- Inside, create a card constrained to `max-w-7xl mx-auto`.
- Card Styling: `bg-white/95`, `backdrop-blur-sm`, `shadow-xl`, rounded corners (`rounded-2xl` mobile, `rounded-3xl` desktop), `overflow-hidden`.
- Animation: The card should slide down and fade in (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }}`, `animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`, duration 0.8s easeOut).
- **Footer Content (Top Half):**
  - Use a flex row layout (flex-col on mobile, flex-row on md+) with spread space.
  - **Logo Area**: Include an orange square (`bg-orange-500`, 40x40px mobile, 48x48px desktop, rounded-lg, shadow-inner, p-2). Inside the square, place an SVG with viewBox "0 0 256 256" and this exact white path: `d="M 228 0 C 172.772 0 128 44.772 128 100 L 128 0 L 0 0 L 0 28 C 0 83.228 44.772 128 100 128 L 0 128 L 0 256 L 28 256 C 83.228 256 128 211.228 128 156 L 128 256 L 256 256 L 256 228 C 256 172.772 211.228 128 156 128 L 256 128 L 256 0 Z"`. Next to the logo block, add the text "HAUL!" (`text-gray-900`, 2xl/3xl, font-bold, tracking-tighter).
  - **Links Area**: Display 3 columns of links using flex. Layout: `Company` (Founding, Platform, Testify), `Mobile` (Get Apple App, Get Google App), `Contracts` (Private Data, User Consent). Section headers should be uppercase, tracking-widest, text-sm, bold. Link items should be gray-500, font-medium, and hover to `orange-600` with transition.
- **Footer Content (Bottom Bar):**
  - Add a top border (`border-gray-100`) and use a solid white background (`bg-white`).
  - Layout: flex, space between, aligning text to the left and social icons to the right. 
  - Text: "© 2026 HAUL! All Rights Reserved" (text-sm, gray-500, medium).
  - **Social Icons**: Map through an array of icons imported from `lucide-react`: Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Linkedin (w-5 h-5). Wrap them in `a` tags shaped as 40x40px circles with `border-gray-100`. On hover, they should turn `bg-orange-500` with white text and an `orange-500` border (transition all duration-300).

**5. Background Truck Parallax Layer:**
- Add a `motion.div` placed absolutely at the bottom of the container (`absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-full`).
- Add standard pointer-events-none and z-20.
- Ensure the `y` axis style is tied to the `useTransform` created in step 3 so it scrolls at a different speed than the background.
- Inside, place an image with `src="https://roof-wish-40038865.figma.site/_components/v2/f31fd17907ce60745d45e83a61d44fd3810d5f25/truck_1.8c4bff83.png"`.
- Image styling: `w-full h-full object-contain object-bottom origin-bottom`. Add scale responsive classes (`scale-[1.5]` mobile, `scale-110` sm, `scale-[2.0]` md, `scale-105` lg) to ensure the truck fits properly on various screen widths.

# Myth Atlas ‚Äî Interactive 3D Creature Field Guide (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file, full-viewport web app called **Myth Atlas**: an interactive 3D field guide to creatures that never existed. It looks like a museum specimen plate on warm sandstone paper. A phoenix and a kraken sit in the centre as real textured 3D models you can drag, zoom and spin. A left sidebar, two specimen tabs, and a right catalogue card surround them. Clicking a tab flies one model out and springs the other in, while the card's copy swaps with a staggered rise. A sun button flips the whole page and the 3D lighting to a dark dusk mode.

Vanilla HTML, CSS and JS in one file, using Three.js r170 from a CDN import map. No frameworks and no build step. Reproduce every value, string, icon, URL and timing below exactly.

---

## 1. Head and external resources

- `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `lang="en"`, charset utf-8, viewport `width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover`.
- Title: `Myth Atlas ‚Äî Featured creatures`
- Meta description: `Turn a phoenix and a kraken in your hands. An interactive 3D field guide to creatures that never existed.`

## 6. Three.js scene

- Renderer: `{canvas, alpha:true, antialias:true, powerPreference:'high-performance'}`, pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio,2)`, `SRGBColorSpace`, `NeutralToneMapping`, exposure 1.05.
- `scene.environment = new PMREMGenerator(renderer).fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture`, `environmentIntensity = .95`.
- `PerspectiveCamera(26, 1, .1, 100)`.
- `key = DirectionalLight(0xfff4e2, 1.6)` at (2.5, 4, 5). `rim = DirectionalLight(0xbfd8ff, .5)` at (‚àí4, 2, ‚àí3).
- Light presets:
  ```js
  day:  { env:.95, key:1.6, rim:.5, keyColor:0xfff4e2, exposure:1.05 }
  dusk: { env:.28, key:2.6, rim:1.9, keyColor:0xffc98a, exposure:1.0 }
  ```
- One rig per creature: `pivot` (slide, scale, sway) > `spin` (free rotation from the hand) > `holder` > `model`. `home` quaternion = `Euler(pitch, yaw, 0, 'YXZ')`, applied to `spin`.
- Loading: `GLTFLoader` with `DRACOLoader` and `MeshoptDecoder`. Compute the bounding sphere, subtract its centre from `model.position`, wrap in `holder` scaled `1/radius` so every model has radius 1. Each mesh: `frustumCulled=false`, `map.anisotropy = max`, `envMapIntensity = 1`. On failure log, set `rig.failed` and show `.fallback`. Each model loads once (cache the promise).

### Camera placement (critical)
The canvas spans the hero while the model is centred on the stage. Do this with a shifted principal point, not by moving the canvas:
```js
// measure(): s = focus ? heroRect : stageRect
goal.cx = s.left - h.left + s.width/2;
goal.cy = s.top - h.top + s.height * (focus ? .5 : .44);
goal.px = Math.min(s.width*.5, s.height*.6) * 1.16;   // pixels per world unit
goal.sw = s.width;
renderer.setSize(W, H, false); camera.aspect = W/H;
// every frame:
camera.position.z = H / (2*Math.tan(degToRad(26/2)) * view.px * zoom);
camera.setViewOffset(W, H, W/2 - view.cx, H/2 - view.cy, W, H);
```
`view` eases toward `goal` at rate 7. First measure snaps. ResizeObservers on hero and stage, plus `orientationchange`.

## 7. Interaction

All easing below uses `f(rate) = 1 - exp(-dt*rate)`, with `dt` capped at .05s.

- **Drag:** pointer capture on stage (ignore buttons). `k = PI / max(260, view.px*1.6)`, about half a turn per model width. `vel = delta*k`. `turnBy` premultiplies `spin.quaternion` by a Y-axis rotation then an X-axis rotation (world axes). Adds `.dragging`, clears `yawQueue`.
- **Inertia:** when released, keep applying `vel`, decaying by `exp(-dt*4.5)`.
- **Zoom:** `zoom` eases to `zoomGoal` at rate 6, clamped .55‚Äì3.4. Wheel: `zoomGoal*exp(-deltaY*(ctrlKey ? .01 : .0016))`, non-passive `preventDefault`. Two-finger pinch scales by the distance ratio. Rail buttons multiply or divide by 1.35. `#zoomIn.on` when `zoomGoal>=1`, `#zoomOut.on` otherwise. `#closeup` `aria-pressed` = `zoomGoal>2.2`.
- **Turn buttons:** `yawQueue` ¬±œÄ/2, 360¬∞ adds 2œÄ. Consumed with `step = yawQueue*f(4.2)`.
- **Double-click / key 0:** reset. `homing` slerps `spin` to `home` at rate 6 until within .002 rad; `setZoom(1)`.
- **Keyboard on stage:** arrows turn ¬±.18 rad; `+`/`=` zoom √ó1.2; `-` zoom √∑1.2.
- **Close-up button:** toggles zoom 2.6 ‚Üî 1.
- **Expand:** toggles `.focus`, `.on`, aria-pressed and aria-label ("Close expanded viewer" / "Expand viewer"), then calls `measure()`.
- **Light button:** toggles `data-light` day/dusk, `document.body.style.background = dusk ? '#14170f' : ''`, `.on`, aria-pressed and aria-label ("Switch to daylight" / "Switch to dusk lighting"). All light values ease at rate 4, key colour via `lerp`.
- Any interaction calls `touched()`: records `lastTouch`, cancels homing, adds `.hero.touched`.

## 8. Tab switch and idle life

`select(i)`:
1. Ignore if already active. `dir = sign(i - from)`. Update `aria-selected` and tabindex.
2. `paintInfo(i)`: add `.leaving`, then after 200ms fill the card, caption, scale text, featured card and fallback image, and reset card scroll.
3. Add `.stage.switching`, clear velocity and queue, `setZoom(1)`.
4. `anim = {from, to:-1, dir, t0:now}`: the old model leaves at once. If the new one isn't loaded, show the loader and await it. Bail if the user moved on.
5. Reset `spin` to `home`, set `anim.to = i` and `t1 = now`, remove `.switching`.

Timing with `DUR = 780`ms; `inCubic(t)=t¬≥`, `outCubic(t)=1-(1-t)¬≥`, `outBack(t)=1+2.2(t-1)¬≥+1.2(t-1)¬≤`, `slide = goal.sw*.95/view.px` world units:
- **Outgoing** over `DUR*.6`, `e=inCubic(t)`: `k=1-e`, `x=-dir*e*slide`, `twist=-dir*e*1.4`.
- **Incoming** over `DUR`, `e=outCubic(t)`: `k=max(.0001,outBack(t))*(.25+.75e)`, `x=dir*(1-e)*slide`, `twist=dir*(1-e)*1.6`.

Every frame each visible rig gets:
- `pivot.scale = k`
- `pivot.position = (x, sin(s*1.3+i)*.028, 0)`: a constant slow hover
- `pivot.rotation = (sin(s*.9)*.03*idle, twist + sin(s*.55)*.16*idle, 0)`

Here `s` is seconds and `idle = clamp01((now - lastTouch - 1800)/1500)`, so sway eases back in 1.8s after the hand lets go.

Boot: `paintInfo(0,true)`, `measure()`, show the loader, start the loop, load the active model, hide the loader, play the intro as an incoming `anim` (`from:-1`), then warm the other model.

## 10. Feel

A quiet natural-history museum plate that happens to be alive. Warm paper, hairline rules, deadpan scholarly copy, and one vivid creature that weighs something in your hand: momentum when you flick it, a soft spring when it arrives, a slow breath when left alone. Do not add gradients, glows or extra colour.

Here is every specification: --- ### Fonts - **Heading font:** "Helvetica Now Display Bold" -- load via this stylesheet in `index.html`: ``` ``` - **Body font:** "Inter" (weights 300-900) -- load via Google Fonts in `index.css`: ``` @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap'); ``` ### CSS Variables (defined in `:root` in `index.css`) ``` --font-heading: 'Helvetica Now Display Bold', sans-serif; --font-body: 'Inter', sans-serif; --color-text: #192837; --color-accent: #7342E2; --color-login-bg: #F2F2EE; ``` Global reset: `* { box-sizing: border-box; }`, body uses `var(--font-body)`, `var(--color-text)`, margin/padding 0. --- ### Background Full-viewport looping background video, absolutely positioned, covering the entire page with `object-cover`. URL: ``` https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260606_131516_eca35265-ea66-4fbd-8d52-22aae6e1a503.mp4 ``` Attributes: `autoPlay`, `muted`, `loop`, `playsInline`. Classes: `absolute inset-0 z-0 w-full h-full object-cover`. --- ### Logo (inline SVG component) A custom geometric SVG logo, 32x32, viewBox `0 0 256 256`, fill `#192837`: ``` M 64 128 L 64.5 128 L 32 95 L 0 64 L 0 0 L 64 0 L 128 64 L 128 64.5 L 161 32 L 192 0 L 256 0 L 256 64 L 192 128 L 128 128 L 128 192 L 96 223 L 63.5 256 L 0 256 L 0 192 Z M 256 192 L 224 223 L 191.5 256 L 128 256 L 128 192 L 192 128 L 256 128 Z ``` --- ### Navbar - Max-width `1280px`, centered with `margin: 0 auto`. - Padding: `px-5 sm:px-8 py-4 sm:py-5`. - `relative z-10`, flexbox with `justify-between`, `items-center`. - **Left:** Logo component. - **Center (desktop, hidden on mobile `md:flex`):** 5 nav links -- "Vault", "Plans", "Install", "News", "Help". Each is `text-sm font-medium`, color `var(--color-text)`, `transition-opacity hover:opacity-70`, gap-8. - **Right (desktop, hidden on mobile `md:flex`):** Two pill buttons with `gap-3`: - "Start For Free": background `#7342E2`, white text, `text-sm font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full`, hover shadow, active scale-95. - "Sign In": background `#F2F2EE`, text `var(--color-text)`, same sizing/rounding. - **Mobile (`md:hidden`):** Hamburger button using Lucide `Menu` icon (24px). Toggles to `X` icon when open. --- ### Mobile Menu (slide-in sheet) Uses Framer Motion `AnimatePresence`. Two layers: 1. **Backdrop:** Fixed overlay, `rgba(25,40,55,0.35)` background, `backdrop-blur(4px)`. Fades in/out over 0.3s. Unbreakable storage, one-tap access, and pro-grade tools for your non-stop world." - Animates: same fade-up, delay `1 * 0.15`. **CTA Button:** - Pill button (`borderRadius: 50px`), background `#7342E2`, white text. - Size: `clamp(0.9rem, 2vw, 1rem)`, padding `17px 24px`, min-width `210px`. - Box-shadow: `0 4px 24px rgba(115,66,226,0.28)`. - Flexbox with `justify-between`, gap `32px`. - Label: "Get It Free" with `ArrowRightCircle` icon (20px) on right. - Hover: `scale: 1.04, brightness(1.1)`. Tap: `scale: 0.96`. - Animates: same fade-up, delay `2 * 0.15`. --- ### Animation System (Framer Motion variants) All hero elements use a shared `fadeUp` variant: ``` hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 28 } visible: (i) => ({ opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { delay: i * 0.15, duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] } }) ``` --- ### Dependencies - `react`, `react-dom` (v18) - `framer-motion` - `lucide-react` (icons: ArrowRightCircle, Zap, LockKeyhole, Fingerprint, Menu, X) - Tailwind CSS 3 with default config, no custom theme extensions - Vite + TypeScript

--- source: "motionsites" id: "orbit-flora" title: "Orbit Flora" category: "AI" type: "hero" types: [] license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md" url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#orbit-flora" --- Build a **single-file** `index.html` full-viewport poster. No scroll. No frameworks. No redesign. Match layout, type, color, both image URLs, entrance choreography, mobile menu, and mouse morph-reveal **exactly**. --- ## 0. Document shell ```html Orbit — Secure system ``` - Root `` starts with class `anim` - `html, body`: `width/height 100%`, `margin: 0`, `overflow: hidden`, background `#161616` - Body: `"Orbit Sans", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`, color `#fff`, antialiased - CSS vars: - `--ink: #ffffff` - `--surface: #161616` - `--orb-reveal: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)` - `--orb-soft: cubic-bezier(.25, .8, .28, 1)` Structure: ``` main.viewport (fixed, inset 0, black) section.stage (absolute, inset 0, contain:strict, isolation:isolate) [all poster elements] ``` Z-order: wordmark `1` → flower `2` → corner copy `3` → brand/nav/pill `4`. Mobile: scrim `9`, sheet `10`, burger `12`. --- ## 1. Fonts (mandatory) Two custom TrueType faces, weight 400, `font-display: block`, embedded as `@font-face` data-URLs: 1. **`"Orbit Sans"`** — nav, pill, corner copy. Fallback: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif 2. **`"Orbit Display"`** — giant wordmark only. Fallback: `"Times New Roman", Times, serif` Do **not** use Inter, Roboto, system-ui, or Playfair. Extract the original base64 TTFs from the existing `index.html` `@font-face` blocks if needed. --- ## 2. The two image URLs (use exactly — do not replace) Both are Higgsfield-proxied PNGs as webp `w=1280&q=85`. Transparent backgrounds. Pixel-art / halftone lilies. ### FRONT / BG lily (default visible) ``` https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260808_192942_e1086505-d7da-433b-a59b-8220f4e6c808.png&w=1280&q=85 ``` Raw source: ``` https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260808_192942_e1086505-d7da-433b-a59b-8220f4e6c808.png ``` ### REVEAL / TOP lily (only visible inside morph trail) ``` https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260808_151324_bf318a5f-5525-4fc7-aab5-e9a341018828.png&w=1280&q=85 ``` Raw source: ``` https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260808_151324_bf318a5f-5525-4fc7-aab5-e9a341018828.png ``` Front `alt`: `Pixel-art pink and violet lily`. Reveal `alt=""`. No other images. --- ## 3. Every on-stage element (desktop) ### Brand mark SVG `.brand-mark`, `viewBox="0 0 66 62"`, white 4-stroke asterisk, `stroke-width: 5px`, square caps: - `(33,1)→(33,61)`, `(3,31)→(63,31)`, `(11.8,9.8)→(54.2,52.2)`, `(54.2,9.8)→(11.8,52.2)` - Position: `top: 2.141745dvh; left: 3.854167vw; width: clamp(34px, min(3.4375vw, 5.2dvh), 66px)` ### Primary nav Links: Home / Resources / Benefits / Contact → `#home` `#resources` `#benefits` `#contact` White, size `clamp(13px, min(1.302083vw, 2.05dvh), 25px)`, each `li` at `top: 3.426791dvh`: | Item | left | scaleX | |---|---|---| | Home | `10.104167vw` | `1.165` | | Resources | `17.526042vw` | `1.052` | | Benefits | `27.578125vw` | `1.126` | | Contact | `36.171875vw` | `1.168` | `.primary-nav` is full-stage but `pointer-events: none`; links opt back in with `pointer-events: auto` so the lily stays hoverable. ### Secure system pill White pill, text `#161616`, `top: 2.336449dvh; right: 7.5vw`, height `clamp(34px, 4.439252dvh, 57px)`, `border-radius: 999px`, tracking `0.026923em`. ### Wordmark ORBIT ```html

``` - `top: 11.565421dvh; left: 4.348958vw` - `"Orbit Display"`, size `min(27.8125vw, 55dvh)`, tracking `0.033708em` - **OR** solid `#fff`; **O** has `scaleX(1.0866)`, `margin-right: 0.042135em` - **BIT** gradient: `linear-gradient(180deg, #ffc5dc 0%, #fd86db 100%)` via `background-clip: text` ### Flower stack ```html
``` - `top: 14.749065dvh; left: 49.121328vw; height: 106.109034dvh; transform: translateX(-50%); pointer-events: none` - Sizer: hidden, `height: 100%; width: auto` (sets intrinsic width) - Layers: `absolute; inset: 0`; imgs `object-fit: cover` - Top layer starts fully masked out: `mask-image: linear-gradient(#0000, #0000)` ### Corner copy Color `#f7f7f7`, size `clamp(14px, min(1.40625vw, 2.102804dvh), 27px)`, `bottom: 4.361371dvh` Left (`left: 3.177083vw; scaleX(1.073)`): `Every workflow, / intelligently connected.` Right (`left: 78.28125vw; scaleX(1.058)`): `Less manual work. / More meaningful output.` Animate via inner `.support-copy__inner` only. ### Mobile chrome (hidden on desktop) Burger + scrim buttons. Shown only at `(max-width: 900px), (max-aspect-ratio: 4 / 5)`. --- ## 4. Mouse morph-reveal trail (implement exactly) **Not** a CSS circle spotlight. Organic morphing blob trail that punches holes in the front lily and paints the reveal lily in the same shape. ### Constants ``` TRAIL_MAX_POINTS = 60 TRAIL_HEAD_R = 140 TRAIL_NOISE_AMP = 44 TRAIL_BLOB_PTS = 24 TRAIL_FADE_SPEED = 0.92 TRAIL_SAMPLE_DIST = 8 ``` ### Architecture Each `MorphTrailLayer`: - Hidden offscreen canvas (`display:none`) sized to `.flower` - Visible absolute layer with cover-fit `` - Every active frame: `maskImage = url(canvas.toDataURL())`, size `100% 100%`, no-repeat Two layers, same trail: - `invert=false` → FRONT/BG (white fill → `destination-out` blobs = holes) - `invert=true` → REVEAL/TOP (clear canvas → white blobs = only trail shows) Mouse on **`.stage`**: `mousemove` / `mouseenter` / `mouseleave`. Convert to flower canvas space via getBoundingClientRect + scale. ### Per frame ``` targetR = hovering ? 140 : 0 headRadius += (targetR - headRadius) * (hovering ? 0.14 : 0.04) ``` When hovering and `headRadius > 5`, if distance from last sample `> 8px`, push `{x,y,r:headRadius,alpha:1,seed:random*100}`; cap 60. Decay: `alpha *= 0.92; r *= 0.995`; remove if `alpha < 0.01`. `time += 0.016`. ### `drawMorphBlob(ctx, cx, cy, r, t, seed)` Skip if `r < 2`. 24 points: ``` n1 = sin(angle*3 + t*1.4 + seed) * 0.45 n2 = sin(angle*5 - t*0.9 + seed*2.3) * 0.3 n3 = cos(angle*2 + t*1.8 + seed*0.7) * 0.25 noise = (n1+n2+n3) * 44 * (r/140) ``` Closed path via midpoints + `quadraticCurveTo` (organic blob, not circle). Fill white. Result: moving the mouse leaves a morphing organic wipe that cuts the front lily away and paints the second lily along a fading trail. Wordmark still shows through transparent petals. Leave stage → head lerps shut, trail dies. --- ## 5. Entrance animation (once) Pure CSS while ``. JS removes `.anim` after last `orb-*` animation finishes (6000ms safety). Never replays. Keyframes: - `orb-word`: `translateY(118%) → 0` (no fade) - `orb-subject`: fade + `translateX(-50%) translateY(3.4dvh → 0)` — do **not** scale the lily - `orb-corner` / `orb-quiet`: small rise + fade - `orb-dim`: fade only Desktop timing: | Element | anim | dur | delay | |---|---|---|---| | brand | quiet | 620ms | 100ms | | nav 1–4 | dim | 550ms | 180 / 225 / 270 / 315ms | | pill | quiet | 620ms | 340ms | | word inner | word | 1150ms | 300ms | | flower | subject | 1150ms | 660ms | | both corners | corner | 720ms | **980ms same** | Easing: word/flower use `--orb-reveal`; rest use `--orb-soft`. While animating, wordmask has overflow hidden + padding/negative margin so the serif can rise without clipping layout. Do **not** animate transform on nav `li`, corner parents, or the O — their `scaleX` is optical. Reduced motion: only whole-stage 280ms fade. Mobile entrance: burger instead of pill/nav; slightly tighter delays. --- ## 6. Responsive essentials **(max-width: 900px) or (max-aspect-ratio: 4/5):** white circular burger, frosted sheet menu, scrim, Escape/Tab-trap/inert when closed. **(max-aspect-ratio: 4/5):** smaller centered lily `height: min(55dvh, 110vw)`, word `min(27.5vw, 18dvh)`, wrapping corner copy. **(max-width: 1200px) or portrait:** center the wordmark (`left:0; width:100%; text-align:center`). --- ## 7. Acceptance checklist - Black `#161616` poster, no scroll - Asterisk + 4 nav words with exact scaleX + white Secure system pill - Giant OR white + BIT pink gradient; O slightly wider - FRONT lily at exact desktop coords, overlapping BIT - Load: frame → word rises → lily rises in front → both corners together; then `.anim` gone - Mouse: 140px-head morphing trail, 24-point noisy blobs, fade 0.92, sample every 8px, max 60 points - Trail punches FRONT and paints REVEAL; wordmark readable through transparency - Exact two Higgsfield URLs above - Orbit Sans + Orbit Display embedded

## HLS.js Video Implementation
```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import Hls from "hls.js";

const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
const videoSrc = "https://stream.mux.com/T6oQJQ02cQ6N01TR6iHwZkKFkbepS34dkkIc9iukgy400g.m3u8";

useEffect(() => {
  const video = videoRef.current;
  if (!video) return;

  if (Hls.isSupported()) {
    const hls = new Hls();
    hls.loadSource(videoSrc);
    hls.attachMedia(video);
    hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, () => {
      video.play().catch((e) => console.log("Auto-play prevented:", e));
    });
    return () => {
      hls.destroy();
    };
  } else if (video.canPlayType("application/vnd.apple.mpegurl")) {
    video.src = videoSrc;
    video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", () => {
      video.play().catch((e) => console.log("Auto-play prevented:", e));
    });
  }
}, []);
```

ms-card-stack.title: Card Stack
ms-card-stack.promptText:
---
source: "motionsites"
id: "card-stack"
title: "Card Stack"
category: "Portfolio"
type: "hero"
types: []
license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md"
url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#card-stack"
---

# Opaque Stack: WebGL Leaning-Card Portfolio with Fly-to-Page Transition (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file portfolio home page for a fictional creative studio, **OPAQUE®**.

**The stack:** on an off-white `#fafafa` canvas, a long diagonal row of thin portrait image cards stands in 3D. Each card is turned −30° and the row leans from the lower left to the upper right, seen through a very narrow 5° lens from slightly above.

- **Scroll or drag:** the row slides endlessly along its diagonal, with eased momentum.
- **Hover:** the card under the cursor slides out of the stack, and its uppercase title follows the cursor.
- **Click a card:**
  1. Every other card vanishes at once.
  2. The clicked card glides to the centre of the screen, turns to face the viewer and becomes square, while the camera flies to a straight-on view.
  3. The project page fades in over it: a centred title and description, a two-column image grid, and a "Next project" row.
- **Back:** clicking "OPAQUE® PROJECTS" (or pressing Esc) returns to the stack, and the row flies in again.

Each card's edges blur softly into the page through a custom shader: sharp in the middle, blurred towards every edge.

Use plain HTML, CSS and JS in one file, with **three.js r128** and **GSAP 3.12.5** from cdnjs. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written.

---

## 1. Page basics

- `<html lang="en">`, title `OPAQUE® Projects`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8.
- **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the Inter latin woff2 faces (400 and 500) as base64 `@font-face` rules instead.
- **Scripts, in this order before the inline script:**
  - `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js`
  - `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js`
- **Variables:** `--bg:#fafafa`, `--ink:#141414`, `--mute:#a9a9a9`, `--line:rgba(0,0,0,.08)`.
- **Reset and base:**
  - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`.
  - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `var(--bg)`.
  - body font `"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, ink colour, antialiased.
- **Utility class `.u`:** 11px, letter-spacing .02em, uppercase.
- **The body starts with class `loading`.**

## 2. The single image asset

All twelve projects come from **one 4×3 contact sheet** (2336×1744, white gutters): twelve moody editorial images.

| Row | Images |
|---|---|
| 1 | Red glossy lips with a gold ring; soft white cumulus clouds in blue sky; red neon tubes at night; a white mannequin bust in hard venetian-blind light |
| 2 | A blue-tinted woman's face close-up; a woman's silhouette against warm orange light; liquid chrome metal spheres; a glowing blue jellyfish in the dark |
| 3 | Grey concrete stairs with a hard diagonal shadow; a rainbow prism light leak; car headlights in fog; a black-and-white crashing wave |

URL (exact):

`https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_084005_ab0d1fcf-a93f-4e32-a277-1523e1768fbe.png&w=2400&q=88`

**Cutting the sheet into cells:**

- Load it with `crossOrigin='anonymous'`.
- Use the sheet constants `SW=2336, SH=1744, CW=.2425, CG=.01, RH=.3244, RG=.0134`.
- Cell i is at column `c=i%4` and row `r=floor(i/4)`. With `k = naturalWidth/SW`, the cell is at:
  - x `c*(CW+CG)*SW*k`, width `CW*SW*k`
  - y `r*(RH+RG)*SH*k`, height `RH*SH*k`
- `cellCanvas(i,size)` draws a cell into a square canvas. For each project:
  - the **sharp** texture is a 512px canvas (`THREE.CanvasTexture`);
  - the **blur** texture is a 24px canvas (`CanvasTexture`, `minFilter = magFilter = LinearFilter`), so upscaling it is the blur;
  - `url` is the 512px canvas as a JPEG data URL (quality .7), used for the corner thumbnail.
- After each project, add `100/12` to the loading progress and wait 30ms.

**Projects** (name, category, year):

| # | Name | Category | Year |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Velvet Mouth | Graphic identity | 2025 |
| 1 | Cumulus | Site design | 2025 |
| 2 | No Signal | Video | 2024 |
| 3 | Still Life | 3D | 2024 |
| 4 | Memories | AI | 2025 |
| 5 | Shadowplay | Graphic identity | 2024 |
| 6 | Mercury | 3D | 2025 |
| 7 | Abyss | Site design | 2024 |
| 8 | Concrete Poem | Graphic identity | 2023 |
| 9 | Prism | AI | 2025 |
| 10 | Headlights | Video | 2023 |
| 11 | Tide | Site design | 2024 |

- **Categories:** `All, Graphic identity, Site design, AI, Video, 3D`.
- **REPEAT = 3:** the twelve projects appear three times, giving 36 cards.

## 3. Renderer and camera

- **Canvas `#gl`:** `position:fixed; inset:0`, full size, `touch-action:none`.
  - `body.hov #gl` gets `cursor:pointer`; `body.drag #gl` gets `cursor:grabbing`.
- **Renderer:** `THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias:true, alpha:false})`, clear colour `#fafafa`, pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio,2)`.
- **Camera:** `PerspectiveCamera(5, innerWidth/innerHeight, .1, 1000)`.
  - `placeCamera()`: position `(0, 100/7.5, aspect<1 ? 55 : 35)`, then `lookAt(0,0,0)`.
  - On resize: set the renderer size, update the aspect and projection, and call `placeCamera()` unless a project is open.
- **Group:** one `world` group in the scene holds every card.

## 4. Card shader (ShaderMaterial, transparent)

**Vertex shader:** pass `vUv`; standard projection.

**Fragment shader**, with uniforms `uMeshSize` (vec2), `uImageSize` (vec2, set to 1,1), `uImageTexture`, `uBlurTexture`, `uOpacity`:

```
ratio = vec2(min((mesh.x/mesh.y)/(img.x/img.y),1.0), min((mesh.y/mesh.x)/(img.y/img.x),1.0))
uvCover = vUv*ratio + (1-ratio)*0.5
progress = 1.0; margin = 0.15
on each of the four edges: progress.rgb *= smoothstep(edge, edge±margin, vUv)
blur.a *= 0.75
color = mix(sharp, blur, 1.0 - progress.r)
color.a *= uOpacity
```

The middle 70% of the card is sharp, and the outer 15% on each side fades into the blurred copy.

## 5. Cards and layout

- **Sizes:** `GAP=.375`, `BE=4/3`, `SC=1-(BE-1)*.5`, `H0=1.5*SC`, `W0=1.5*BE*SC`.
- **Geometry:** `BoxGeometry(H0, W0, .0175)`, a thin portrait slab.
- **Each card is:**
  - `mesh`: the shader material, with `uMeshSize = (H0, W0)`;
  - `hit`: the same geometry with an invisible `MeshBasicMaterial` (opacity 0, transparent, no depth write), `scale.x = 1.5`, a generous hover target;
  - `inner` group: holds the mesh and slides on hover;
  - `holder` group: holds `inner` and `hit`, and is placed on the row.
- **Card state:** `{n, i, mesh, hit, inner, holder, order:n, visK:1, on:true}`.
- **Motion state:**
  - `scroll = {current:0, previous:0}`
  - `mouse = {x:-1, y:-1, drag:{x,y,active}, on:{x,y}, down}`
  - `M = 0` (eased drag)
  - `intro = {x:-20}`
  - `wrap(min,max,v)` = modulo wrap
- **layout(), every frame:**
  1. Ease the drag: `M += (drag.x - drag.y - M) * .1`.
  2. Ease the scroll: `scroll.previous += (current - previous) * .15`.
  3. Set `J = scroll.previous/25 - M/100 + intro.x`.
  4. Take the visible (filtered) cards: `N` = their count, `len = max(N,24)`, `F = len*GAP/2`, `step = len/N`. Each visible card gets `order = k*step`, which spreads a filtered set along a loop of at least 24 slots.
  5. For every card:
     - `visK += ((on?1:0) - visK) * .12`, and `uOpacity = visK`.
     - If nothing is open:
       - `x = wrap(-F, F, (order - J)*GAP)`
       - `y = -(1 - visK)*1.2`, so filtered-out cards sink
       - `z = aspect<1 ? -x*6 : -x*aspect*1.5`
       - `rotation.x = 0`, `rotation.y = -π/6`
       - visible only while `visK > .02` and `|z| < 12.5`

## 6. Interaction

- **Hover:**
  - Each frame, raycast the visible cards' `hit` meshes at the mouse NDC. Skip this before ready, while open, while dragging, or with no mouse.
  - On a new hovered card:
    - The previous card's `inner.position` goes back to (0,0), expo.out 0.5s.
    - The new card's `inner.position` goes to `x: 2/3, y: -.1`, expo.out 0.5s.
    - The body gets `hov`.
    - `#label` shows the project name.
    - `#thumb` shows its image.
- **Wheel:** `scroll.current += (deltaY + deltaX)/20`, passive, ignored before ready or while open.
- **Arrow keys:** ±12. **Esc:** closes the project.
- **Drag:**
  - pointerdown on the canvas stores `on = drag - client` and captures the pointer.
  - Once the pointer has moved more than 3px:
    - drag mode starts and the body gets `drag`;
    - `world.scale` → 0.825 (expo.out .75s);
    - `drag = on + client`.
  - On pointerup, drag mode ends and the scale returns to 1 (expo.out .75s).
  - A pointerup without a drag on a hovered card opens it.
- **Cursor label `#label`:**
  - Fixed, 11px Inter 500 uppercase ink, `pointer-events:none`.
  - Follows at `translate(x+14px, y+12px)`.
  - Opacity transition .2s.

## 7. Open a project (exact sequence)

`openTile(t)`:

1. Set `opened = t`, clear the hover, and add `opened` to the body (the side chrome fades out).
2. **Hide every other card at once.**
3. Snap `t.inner.position` to (0,0).
4. `t.holder.position.x` → 0, expo.out over `1.25/3*2` s. On each update, `z = -x*aspect*1.5`, so the card slides along the row to the centre.
5. `t.holder.rotation.y` → 0, expo.inOut 1.25s (it turns to face you).
6. `camera.position` → `(0, 0, innerWidth<640 ? 35 : 30)`, expo.inOut 1.25s, calling `lookAt(0,0,0)` on every update.
7. **When the camera tween completes:**
   - fill the page and make `#page` visible;
   - fade it `opacity 0 → 1` over 0.5s, power1.inOut;
   - then hide the card underneath.

`closeTile()`:

1. Kill the page tweens, hide the page (opacity 0, hidden), and remove `opened`.
2. Reset the card's `rotation.y` to `-π/6` and call `placeCamera()`.
3. Set `opened = null`.
4. The row flies in again: `intro.x = -20` → 0, expo.out 2s.

"OPAQUE® PROJECTS" (`#home`) calls `closeTile`.

## 8. Project page `#page`

- **Container:** fixed, inset 0, z-index 8, `overflow-y:auto`, `overscroll-behavior:none`, background `var(--bg)`, a flex column. It starts at opacity 0 and `visibility:hidden`.
- **Head section `.head`:**
  - Height 50vh (min 20rem), `margin-top:3.75rem`, content centred vertically, font-size 11px, line-height 1.0909.
  - The inner row has padding `5rem 14px`.
  - `h1` (the project name): width 12.5rem, Inter 500 11px uppercase.
  - `p` (the description): max-width 287px, padding `0 2px`.
- **Grid `.grid`:** two equal columns, no gap. Five blocks, all cut from the project's own sheet cell (as JPEG data URLs, quality .85):

  | Block | Crop (x, y, w, h of the cell) | Output size | Width | Aspect ratio |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | 0, .08, 1, .84 | 1200×1000 | half | 1.2 |
  | 2 | .18, 0, .64, 1 | 900×1400 | half | .64 |
  | 3 | 0, .2, 1, .6 | 1800×1080 | full (spans both columns) | 1.67 |
  | 4 | .05, .05, .5, .5 | 1000×1000 | half | 1 |
  | 5 | .45, .45, .5, .5 | 1000×1000 | half | 1 |

  - Each block is a relative box with overflow hidden and an absolutely-filled `object-fit:cover` image.
  - Images start at opacity 0 and fade in (`.in`, .6s `cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)`) as they load.
- **Next section `.next`:** height 50vh (min 20rem), centred, padding 14px, 11px uppercase.
  - Credits row: "Category" in an 8.25rem column at 30% opacity, then the category.
  - A full-width link: "Next project" in an 8.25rem column at 30% opacity (100% on hover, .5s), then the next project's name.
  - Clicking it fades the page to 0 over .25s, refills it with the next project, scrolls to the top, and fades back in over .5s (power1.inOut).
- **Descriptions** (by project index):
  0. A campaign built from close-up texture and saturated colour, shot and graded in-house.
  1. Site design and art direction for an atmospheric weather brand, all soft light and slow motion.
  2. A night-time film series exploring signal, noise and the glow of the city after dark.
  3. Still lifes rendered in 3D, mixing studio light with synthetic materials.
  4. An AI-assisted portrait series about memory, distortion and the faces we half remember.
  5. Visual identity built from shadow and warm light, for a theatre collective.
  6. Liquid-metal forms for a product launch, modelled, lit and animated in 3D.
  7. An immersive site for a deep-sea research lab, glowing in the dark.
  8. A typographic identity cast in concrete for an architecture biennale.
  9. Generative colour studies trained on refracted light.
  10. A short film shot entirely in fog, following two headlights through the night.
  11. An editorial site for a surf brand, built around the rhythm of the tide.

## 9. Chrome (all with class `chrome`, transition opacity .6s)

`body.loading` hides it. `body.opened` hides everything except the nav.

- **Nav** (fixed at left 6px, top 6px, flex, gap 3px, z-index 10, `.u`): four tiles.
  - Labels: `OPAQUE<sup>®</sup> PROJECTS` (198px wide, ink), `Research`, `Studio`, `Contact` (122px, mute).
  - Each tile: 58px tall, padding `0 10px 10px` with the text at the bottom, radius 4px.
  - Background `rgba(242,242,241,.5)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(14px)` and an inset 1px `var(--line)` ring.
  - Hover: ink text on `#ececeb`.
- **`#thumb`:** fixed at top-right 10px, 58×58, radius 3px, cover background. Filter `grayscale(1) contrast(1.1)`. Shows the hovered project's image (Memories at start).
- **Filter chips `#chips`:** fixed at right 10px, bottom 62px, a column aligned right, gap 5px.
  - One pill per category: 30px tall, padding `0 13px`, radius 30px, background `rgba(242,242,241,.9)`, line ring.
  - Text: Inter 500 10px uppercase, mute; ink when active or hovered.
  - A count in a 7px `<sup>`.
  - Clicking sets `t.on` for the matching cards: the others sink and fade through `visK`, and the remaining ones re-spread along the loop.
- **Mode switch `#mode`:** fixed at bottom-right 10px, padding 3px, radius 4px, the same glass. Two buttons, "Overview" and "Index": 34px tall, 11px uppercase. The active one is white with a line ring.
  - **Index** shows `#index`: a list fixed at left 10px, top 96px, width `min(420px,40vw)`.
  - Each row is a grid `28px 1fr auto auto`, holding number, name (500, ink), category and year, with a top border line.
  - Row hover: ink text, padding-left 12px.
  - Hovering a row scrolls the stack to that project and sets the thumbnail; clicking a row opens it.
- **At 760px or narrower:** nav tiles are 76px (first one 120px) and the index is 80vw.

## 10. Loader and intro

1. `#loader` covers the page (bg colour) with a centred "0%" (Inter 500 11px).
2. While the textures build: `prog.previous += (current - previous)*.1` each frame, shown as a rounded percent.
3. At 100:
   - The percent fades out (.5s, delay .25).
   - The loader fades out (.5s, delay .75, power1.inOut), then is removed, and `loading` is removed from the body.
4. After 750ms:
   - Set `ready = true`.
   - **The row flies in:** `intro.x` -20 → 0, expo.out 2s.
   - `world.scale` starts at 0.825 and eases to 1 (expo.out 1s, delay 1.25s).
   - The thumbnail shows project 4.
5. **The render loop** runs `layout()`, `pick()` and `renderer.render()` on every requestAnimationFrame.

# Prompt: Koru Tech footer

Build a single-file **website footer section** (header bar plus full footer, one screen) for a fictional IT services company, **Koru Tech**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is dark and techy: a near-black green page and a glass nav. At the bottom, a glowing emerald horizon over a perspective grid floor, with a giant outlined "KORU TECH" wordmark standing on the horizon line. Emerald accents throughout.

## Media

- **Still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/139344bb-585a-4867-9a31-94cbfad8f6d9.jpg` (1920×1280, 3:2). A dark green-black sky, a bright emerald horizon light low in the frame (horizon at 78.6% height), and a faint emerald perspective grid floor below.
- **Motion:** a muted 4s loop of the same scene, `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/17d62c8c-c7a4-491d-82ff-b0cbd3387820.mp4` (1600×1064).
  - The camera glides forward over the grid; the grid lines stream towards the viewer and the horizon glow breathes brighter and dimmer.
  - The horizon was stabilised so it never moves, and the last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - Fade it in (0.9s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** a 1536-wide reference frame, `--u = min(100vw/1536, 100vh/930)`, centred. The page is a flex column at least one screen tall.
- **Rows:** a 100u header row at the top and an 805u footer row pinned to the bottom. Only the empty band between them stretches.
- **Scene box:** pinned to the page bottom, centred, `width: max(100%, 1536u)`, `aspect-ratio: 3/2`, holding the still (cover, bottom-centre), the video (cover, object-position 50% 100%) and the wordmark.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Albert Sans** 400/600.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#030D0B`
  - accent emerald `#0BE3AE`, deeper emerald `#02C78A`
  - text `#F8F8F8`, muted `#BBBCC2`
- **Glass:** an emerald-tinted fill (4.5% → 7%) with an emerald hairline border that is brighter at the top.

## Header (1536 frame)

- **Logo:** at (251, 43). A 45u emerald gradient rounded tile (`#14E6B0` → `#01B987`, radius 10) holding a bold white geometric "K", then "KORU TECH" (600, 17u, tracking .06em).
- **Nav:** a glass pill 452×58u at (543, 33) with "Home · Services · Projects · About · Contact" at 15.2u. Home is the current page, in emerald.
- **Button:** a white "Book a Call" pill (158×51u at 1131.5, 37) with an emerald arrow.

## Footer

- **Left column** (from x 134):
  - the logo again
  - the tagline "Maximize your digital infrastructure and / enhance organizational efficiency." (16u)
  - "QUICK CONTACT" (tracking .05em)
  - four 51u round emerald-ring buttons: professional network (emerald glyph), Instagram, X and YouTube (white glyphs)
- **Link columns** (headings 600 at 17.4u, links 16.6u):
  - **Quick Links** at x 723: Home, About Us, Services, Projects, Contact Us
  - **Support** at x 921: FAQs, Support Center
  - **Get in Touch With Us** at x 1148, each row with a small emerald icon:
    - phone: "Phone: +64 9 555 0142"
    - mail: "Email: info@korutech.example"
    - mail: "Email: sales@korutech.example"
    - pin: "Address: Wellington, New Zealand"
- **Wordmark:** an inline SVG spanning the scene width (viewBox 1440×200, 21% of the box tall, bottom 21.4%, so it stands on the horizon). It's "KORU TECH" as outlined text (Albert Sans 600, textLength 1478, so the "H" runs off the right edge) with a 1.6px stroke. The stroke fades up from bright mint `#35FFC8` at the horizon to emerald at 42% opacity at the top.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations sequence, about 1.7s, behind an `entrance-pending` class with a fallback.
  - The header logo, nav and button rise 8u.
  - The footer logo rises, then the tagline wipes up.
  - Then the Quick Contact title, the socials and the three columns, staggered.
- **Hover:** links brighten; social rings fill faintly emerald and lift 2px; the button gets an emerald halo.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone (below 1180px)

- **One screen:** the page is locked to one screen, and a small script scales the content (`--k`) so it never scrolls.
- **Header:** the nav and button collapse into a glass menu button with a dropdown.
- **Columns:** the footer reflows. Tablets show the brand, then three columns; phones show two columns, then contact full width.
- **Scene:** the scene box is at least 640px wide, and a band is reserved so the wordmark never sits under text. On short landscape phones the wordmark hides.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The emerald horizon glows low on the screen with the grid streaming towards you, and the giant outlined KORU TECH stands exactly on the horizon line.
- The footer columns sit above it with even margins, and the loop never jumps.
- **Content:** no real brands; contact details are fictional.

# Prompt: NimbusOS footer section

Build a single-file **footer section** for a fictional digital-growth agency, **NimbusOS**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. A deep indigo, photographic "sky" with a soft diagonal light fold fills the screen. A white newsletter call-to-action sits on it at the top left, and a crisp white footer card floats above a striped indigo floor at the bottom.

## Media

- **Sky:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4ec0de15-9d60-43b1-a76e-7d721f094fd6.jpg`. A deep indigo-to-violet gradient with a soft diagonal light fold, `background-size: cover`, anchored to the bottom centre.
- **Floor:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cadf77d3-d2b1-45a2-800b-5f96d6ec3f18.jpg`. Horizontal indigo and lavender stripes, stretched to 100% width and 157.5u tall at the bottom. Its top 8u fades in with a mask.
- **Grain:** a fine SVG noise overlay at 7% opacity in `soft-light` blend, tiled at 220u.
- **Background colour:** `#03063A` behind everything. The background never moves.

## Scale

- **Units:** every size is in reference pixels of a 1433×1098 artboard, multiplied by `--u = min(100vw/1433, max(.68px, 100vh/1098))`.
- **Fill:** the page is one viewport tall. A flexible spacer between the hero and the card absorbs any extra height, so there are never blank bands.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** a neo-grotesk (Helvetica Neue style), weight 400 only. Headings get a hair of text stroke.
- **Colours:**
  - brand indigo `#111884`, hover `#1A23A6`
  - ink `#000`, muted text `#4E4E51` / `#59595C`
  - rules `#E0E1E9`, card `#FEFEFE`

## Hero (top left, 47u in, 35u down)

- **Badge:** a 43u white note badge with a folded top-right corner and an indigo notes glyph.
- **Headline:** "Let Your Work Speak For Itself. / We’ll Handle The Words." at 53.8u on a 66u line, white at 90%, 41u below the badge.
- **Lede:** two lines at 18.6u on a 29.5u line, white at 69%: "We’re here to help you navigate your digital journey. Get in touch with us today to discuss / how we can take your business to the next level."
- **Signup**, 35.7u below:
  - a 530 × 55.5u square email field, white at 20% with a 4u blur, placeholder "Enter Your Mail..."
  - a 193.5u white "Sign Up" button with a 48u indigo square holding a circled arrow
  - the field focuses to white at 26% with a 1.5u inner ring
  - submitting clears the field and shows "Thanks — we’ll be in touch."

## Footer card

- **Card:** square-cornered white, 48u from each side, sitting right on top of the floor. A fine double inner border and a crisp 1u dark outline with a tiny drop line underneath.
- **Top row:** 360u tall, 62u top padding, 58u left padding. Grid columns: 469u (flexible), then 236, 207.5, 199.5 and 165u.
  - **Brand column:**
    - an original indigo logo of six small hexagons around a filled centre hexagon (33 × 31u), then "NimbusOS" at 25.4u
    - "The Architect Of / Modern Digital Growth." at 30.6u, 60u below
    - a 177 × 48u indigo "Get In Touch" button with a white square arrow cap
  - **Link columns:** each starts with a 2.4u light rule on its left, a 19.8u heading, then links at 15.8u in muted grey, 19.5u apart. Links turn indigo on hover.
    - Industries: Automotive, Energy & Utilities, Financial, Life Science, Embedded Teams
    - Insights: News, Case Studies, Podcasts, Events, Public Sector
    - Company: About Us, Careers, Join Us, Contact Us, Press
    - Connect: X.com, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, each with a small outline icon
- **Bottom row:** 62u tall, above a hairline. "Privacy Policy · Terms of Use · Cookie Consent" on the left and "© 2025 NimbusOS Ltd. All rights reserved." on the right.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations sequence, about 1.9s, behind an `entrance-pending` class with a 3s failsafe. It starts when the fonts are ready, and any pointer or key press skips it.
  - The badge settles (80ms), then the headline wipes up out of a clip (220ms).
  - The lede, then the signup.
  - In the card: the logo, the headline wipe, the button, then the link columns 90ms apart, and the bottom row last.
- **Hover:** buttons deepen to `#1A23A6`, and links turn indigo.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no transitions.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet (768×1024 artboard):** fits one screen with no scrolling, and the spacer takes the extra height.
- **Phone (390×844 artboard):**
  - the link groups become an accessible ARIA tab set (Industries / Insights / Company / Connect) with arrow-key navigation, showing one group at a time in two columns
  - legal links and the copyright stack under them

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The indigo sky and striped floor frame a white newsletter block at the top left and a full-width white footer card at the bottom.
- Columns and rules are aligned, and there are no blank bands at any window size.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

Build a single-page hero section with a full-screen looping background video, liquid glass UI elements, and a dark cinematic aesthetic. Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React icons. Here are the exact specifications:

Background Video:

Full-screen muted autoplaying video covering the entire viewport, positioned absolutely with object-cover
Video source URL: https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260328_115001_bcdaa3b4-03de-47e7-ad63-ae3e392c32d4.mp4
The video is shifted down by 17% (translate-y-[17%]) so the top portion of the video is cropped -- the interesting content is in the lower portion of the frame
The video loops seamlessly with a custom JavaScript fade system (no CSS transitions): 500ms requestAnimationFrame-based fade-in on load/loop start, 500ms fade-out when 0.55 seconds remain before the video ends. A fadingOutRef boolean prevents re-triggering the fade-out from repeated timeUpdate events. On ended, opacity is set to 0, then after 100ms the video resets to currentTime = 0, plays, and fades back in. Each new fade cancels any running animation frame to prevent competing animations. Fades resume from the current opacity rather than snapping.
The outer container is min-h-screen bg-black with overflow-hidden

Font:

Import Google Font "Instrument Serif" (both regular and italic) via CSS @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&display=swap')
The heading uses fontFamily: "'Instrument Serif', serif" applied via inline style

Liquid Glass CSS (.liquid-glass class):

background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) with background-blend-mode: luminosity
backdrop-filter: blur(4px) and -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
border: none
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)
position: relative; overflow: hidden
A ::before pseudo-element creates the glass border effect:
position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1.4px
background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%)
Mask trick for border-only rendering: -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude
pointer-events: none

Layout (all inside one full-screen flex column):

Navigation bar (relative z-20, padding pl-6 pr-6 py-6):
Inner container: rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between max-w-5xl mx-auto
Left side: Logo area with a Globe icon (size 24) and text "Asme" in white, font-semibold text-lg, with gap-2
Next to the logo (with gap-8): three nav links ("Features", "Pricing", "About") -- hidden on mobile, shown on md: -- styled text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-colors text-sm font-medium
Right side (gap-4): "Sign Up" as plain white text button, "Login" as a liquid-glass rounded-full px-6 py-2 button

Hero content area (relative z-10 flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-12 text-center -translate-y-[20%]):
Heading: "Built for the curious" -- text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl text-white mb-8 tracking-tight whitespace-nowrap with Instrument Serif font
Below the heading, a max-w-xl w-full space-y-4 container:
Email input bar: liquid-glass rounded-full pl-6 pr-2 py-2 flex items-center gap-3. Inside: a transparent email input (placeholder: "Enter your email", text-white placeholder:text-white/40 text-base) and a white circular submit button (bg-white rounded-full p-3 text-black) containing an ArrowRight icon (size 20)
Subtitle text: text-white text-sm leading-relaxed px-4 -- "Stay updated with the latest news and insights. Subscribe to our newsletter today and never miss out on exciting updates."
Manifesto button: centered, liquid-glass rounded-full px-8 py-3 text-white text-sm font-medium hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

Social icons footer (relative z-10 flex justify-center gap-4 pb-12):
Three circular icon buttons, each liquid-glass rounded-full p-4 text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all
Icons: Instagram, Twitter, Globe (all size 20) from lucide-react
Each has an aria-label

Tech stack: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 3, lucide-react for all icons. Default Tailwind config with no extensions. No other UI libraries.

ms-pixel-garden.promptText:
---

# HERO PROMPT — "Dune Play" by Grovekit (interactive pixel-art plant playground)

Build a single self-contained `index.html` (inline CSS + inline vanilla JS, no frameworks, no build step) that recreates the page described below **exactly**. The page is a full-viewport, non-scrolling toy: three pixel-art desert plants (a coconut palm, a barrel cactus with a pink flower, and a jacaranda tree) stand on small sand mounds over a flat warm-sand background. You can click or brush them to shake their leaves and petals loose, turn on weather so the wind bends them and strips foliage off, watch leaves fall and pile up as litter, have everything "grow back", flip to an x-ray "skeleton" view, toggle sound, switch to a single-plant carousel and toggle dark mode.

Everything visual on the plants is made of square "cells" (fat pixels) drawn on one full-screen `<canvas>`. All UI chrome is HTML floating above the canvas.

Document title: **`Dune Play · Grovekit`** (with a middle dot). `lang="en"`, UTF-8, `width=device-width,initial-scale=1` viewport.

---

## 1. Assets

Exactly three sprites are used. Each is a **transparent-background pixel-art PNG** rendered by Higgsfield and served through the images.higgs.ai proxy. Load them with `crossOrigin = "anonymous"` (pixel data is read back from a canvas, so CORS must be honoured). Use these URLs verbatim:

| key | plant | URL |
|---|---|---|
| `palm` | coconut palm | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=png&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261109_023150_cc5c0d10-d6fc-429d-9245-a05e69771f45.png&w=1024` |
| `cactus` | barrel cactus with pink flower | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=png&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261109_023155_2d3af7db-5e50-423f-822f-fbbb8b599e76.png&w=1024` |
| `jac` | jacaranda tree (purple blossom) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=png&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261109_023200_f11ab77e-4a73-43f2-971c-d77090c352ff.png&w=1024` |

Font: **Inter** from Google Fonts, weights **400, 500, 600** only, `display=swap`, with `preconnect` hints to `fonts.googleapis.com` and `fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). Fallback stack: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Antialiased font smoothing (`-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`).

No other images, icon fonts or libraries. All icons are tiny inline SVGs or text glyphs, described below.

The three sprites are loaded in parallel; only when all three are decoded and converted does the app run layout and start the animation loop. Until then the page shows the UI over the plain background.

---

## 2. Theme tokens

Define CSS custom properties on `:root` (light) and override them on `body.dark` (dark). The theme switches by toggling the class `dark` on `<body>`.

| token | light | dark | use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg` | `#f2ebdf` | `#14110d` | page + canvas background (warm sand / near-black brown) |
| `--panel` | `#fff` | `#1f1b15` | pill / panel fill |
| `--ink` | `#17140f` | `#f3ede2` | primary text, slider fill |
| `--mute` | `#8b8378` | `#8f877a` | secondary text, inactive segments, dots, ticks |
| `--line` | `rgba(23,20,15,.09)` | `rgba(243,237,226,.09)` | 1 px borders, dividers |
| `--seg` | `#ece5d9` | `#2b261e` | segmented-control trough, BETA chip |
| `--knob` | `#fff` | `#f3ede2` | switch & slider knobs (but see dark overrides below: both become pure `#fff` in dark) |
| `--track` | `#ddd5c8` | `#3a342a` | off-switch track, slider track |
| `--on` | `#17140f` | `#f3ede2` | active view button, Grow back button fill |
| `--shadow` | `0 10px 34px rgba(60,44,20,.07)` | `0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.35)` | control-bar drop shadow |

Hard-coded colours (not tokens):
- Switch ON track: `#2fb35a` (green), both themes.
- In dark mode the switch knob and slider knob are forced to pure `#fff`.
- Skeleton overlay: `#c8382a` (light) / `#ff6a4d` (dark).
- Windsock pole: `#6b6258` (light) / `#9a8f80` (dark); sock stripes `#e8573b` (orange-red) and `#f4efe6` (off-white), both themes.
- Counter icon flower: pink `#f06aa8`, centre yellow `#ffd24a`.
- Sand mound tones: `#e4cfa6`, `#d9c094`, `#cdb282`, `#efdcb8` (same in both themes).
- Cactus "bare" rib colour: `#b2875a`.

Global resets: `* {box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0}`. `html, body` are 100% height, `overflow:hidden`, background `var(--bg)` with `transition: background .5s`. Body colour `var(--ink)`, text selection disabled (`user-select:none` incl. `-webkit-`). Buttons: inherit font and colour, transparent background, no border, `cursor:pointer`.

The canvas background is **not** a CSS colour: each frame the canvas is filled with the *computed* background colour of `<body>`, so during the .5 s theme transition the canvas fades in lock-step with the page.

---

## 3. Layout of the UI chrome

All chrome is `position:fixed`, `z-index:5` (tooltip `z-index:6`), on top of the canvas.

### 3.1 Shared "pill" style
Class `.pill`: background `var(--panel)`, `1px solid var(--line)` border, `border-radius:30px`, box-shadow `0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.03)`, `transition: background .5s, border-color .5s`.

### 3.2 Brand pill (top-left)
- Element: a `.pill` div with text **`Grovekit`**.
- Position: `left:24px; top:16px`. Height `44px`, horizontal padding `18px`, content centred (grid, place-items center).
- Type: 14px, weight 600.

### 3.3 Title (top-centre)
- Centred horizontally (`left:50%`, `translateX(-50%)`), `top:26px`. Flex row, items centred, gap `8px`. Not a pill (no background).
- Text **`Dune Play`** at 17px, weight 500.
- Followed by a **`BETA`** chip: 8px, weight 600, letter-spacing `.06em`, background `var(--seg)`, colour `var(--mute)`, padding `3px 5px`, radius `5px`, nudged up `translateY(-6px)` so it sits like a superscript.

## 4. The canvas

- `<canvas id="scene">` fixed, `inset:0`, 100%×100%, `image-rendering: pixelated`, `touch-action:none`. It sits below all UI.
- Backing size = `round(innerWidth·DPR) × round(innerHeight·DPR)` where **DPR = min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 2)**.
- All drawing is axis-aligned filled squares of side **C** device pixels (one "cell"). No antialiasing, no images drawn to the main canvas — every sprite pixel is its own `fillRect`.

---

## 5. Sprite-to-grid pipeline (run once per plant at load)

Each plant definition:

| key | target rows | flex (bendiness) | default foliage kind | wood rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| palm | **96** | **1.15** | `frond` | hue 12–48° (inclusive), saturation > .30, value < .82 |
| cactus | **58** | **0.12** | `flesh` | special (below) |
| jac | **86** | **0.60** | `petal` | hue 8–50° (inclusive), saturation > .22, value < .72 |

Steps:
1. **Decode** the PNG, draw it to an offscreen canvas at native size, read pixels.
2. **Crop to alpha bounding box**: the bbox of all pixels with alpha **> 60**.
3. **Downsample**: target rows = per plant (above); cols = `round(rows · bboxWidth / bboxHeight)`. Draw the cropped region into a `cols × rows` canvas with `imageSmoothingEnabled = true` and `imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'` and read it back.
4. **Alpha threshold**: skip any cell with alpha **< 120** (everything kept is drawn fully opaque).
5. **Posterise**: each R, G, B channel → `round(c/8)·8` (multiples of 8), clamped to ≤ 255 when building the colour string `rgb(r,g,b)`.
6. **Classify** using HSV of the posterised colour (h in degrees 0–360, s = (max−min)/max, v = max, all from 0–1 channels; standard hue formula, negative hue + 360):
   - **Palm / Jacaranda**: `wood = rule(h,s,v)` from the table — brown trunks/branches are wood; everything else is foliage of the plant's default kind (`frond` for palm, `petal` for jacaranda — the whole jacaranda canopy behaves like petals).
   - **Cactus** (evaluated in this order):
     - `green` = 60 < h < 170.
     - If green **and v < .36** → **wood** (the dark rib lines) with a **bare colour `#b2875a`** (see §9).
     - else if **flower** → kind `petal`. Flower = (h > 300 or h < 18) with s > .35 (pink petals), **or** (38 ≤ h ≤ 62 with s > .6 and the cell is in the top 30 % of rows, y < rows·0.3) (the yellow flower centre).
     - else if **spine** = s < .38 and v > .55 (pale, low-saturation light pixels) → kind `spine`.
     - else → kind `flesh` (the green body).
7. **Looseness**: build an occupancy grid of kept cells. For each cell count occupied cells `n` in its **7×7 neighbourhood** (offsets −3…+3 both axes, the cell itself included, out-of-bounds ignored). `loose = clamp((1 − n/49)·1.8 + random·0.25, 0, 1)`. Edge/outer cells are loose (≈1), interior cells are tight (≈0).
8. **Seed**: each cell gets `seed = random · 6.28`.

Each cell record stores: home column `hx`, home row `hy`, colour, `wood` flag, optional `bare` colour, `kind` (`frond` | `petal` | `flesh` | `spine`), `loose`, `seed`, and runtime state. Each plant record also stores `cols`, a spring position `k = 0` and velocity `kv = 0`.
