## 6. World layout (on load and on every window resize / view change)

- **Cell size**: `C = max(2, round(innerHeight · DPR · 0.0054))` device pixels in the three-plant view; factor **0.0068** in single view (plants appear ~26 % larger).
- Grid width `cols = ceil(canvasWidth / C) + 2`.
- **Ground row** `GY = round(canvasHeight · 0.68 / C)` — the ground line is at 68 % of the viewport height.
- Allocate a **litter height map** `hm` (one int per column, all 0) and a **floor mask** `floor` (one flag per column, all 0).
- Plant centre fractions of width: palm **0.20**, cactus **0.48**, jacaranda **0.77**. In single view all are at **0.50** and only the selected plant is visible (`one` index; default **1 = cactus**).
- Per plant: centre column `cx = round(canvasWidth · fx / C)`; origin `ox = cx − round(cols/2)`; `oy = GY − rows` (the sprite's bottom row sits on row GY−1).
- **Sand mound** per plant: width `w = round(max(plantCols · 1.05, 40))` cells, starting at column `cx − round(w/2)`. For each x = 0…w−1 with `t = x/(w−1)`, mound height `hgt = round( sin(t·π)^0.6 · 3 )` (0–3 cells, a flat-topped dome). Fill cells from row `GY+1` up to row `GY+1−hgt` (y = 0…hgt, row = GY − y + 1). Each cell's tone = `tones[(x·7 + y·3) mod 4]` with tones `['#e4cfa6', '#d9c094', '#cdb282', '#efdcb8']` — a dithered sandy texture. The mound is drawn before the plant every frame (the plant base overlaps its top).
- **Litter floor**: only under visible plants, columns `cx − (W>>1)` to `cx + (W>>1)` (exclusive) where `W = round(max(plantCols·1.05, 40) · 1.25)` — i.e. **1.25× the mound width**. Falling foliage can only land where `floor` is set; elsewhere it falls through and off the bottom of the screen.
- Update the single-view dots (active = selected index).
- **Reset**: every cell of every plant goes back to attached (state 0); body class `bare` is removed.

## 7. Interaction: shaking

### Hit test
Convert the pointer to grid coords: `gx = clientX · DPR / C`, `gy = clientY · DPR / C`. For each visible plant, quick-reject unless `ox−3 ≤ gx ≤ ox+cols+3` and `oy−3 ≤ gy ≤ GY+2`. Then the plant is hit if **any attached cell** (state 0, wood or foliage) has `|ox + hx + sx − gx| < 3` and `|oy + hy − gy| < 3` (sx = that cell's current sway offset). First hit plant wins.

### Hover cursor
On pointermove (when not dragging) set the canvas cursor to `pointer` over a plant, otherwise `default`.

### Click (pointerdown)
If a plant is hit: capture the pointer, start a drag record `{plant, lastX = clientX}`, and **shake(plant, dir = random ±1, power = 1)**.

### Drag shake
While dragging, on pointermove compute `dx = clientX − lastX`; whenever `|dx| > 28` px, **shake(plant, sign(dx), power = 0.7)** and set `lastX = clientX`. (So brushing back and forth keeps shaking the same plant.) pointerup / pointercancel end the drag.

### shake(plant, dir, power)
1. `leaves` = all foliage (non-wood) cells currently attached.
2. Spring impulse: `kv += dir · (5 + 4·power)`.
3. Count to detach: `n = max( min(leaves, 30), min( round(leaves · 0.13 · power), 170 ) )` — at least 30 (or all if fewer), ~13 % of what's left, capped at 170.
4. Sort leaves descending by `loose + random·0.9` (looser, outer leaves preferred, with randomness) and detach the first `n` with initial velocity:
   - `vx = dir·(6 + random·16) + windDir·windSpeed·12`
   - `vy = −(6 + random·16)` (upward toss; units = cells/second, +y is down)
5. Increment the Shaken counter by 1 (always, even if nothing was left to drop) and re-render it as en-US formatted.

### Spring
Each plant has a 1-D damped spring `k` (position) / `kv` (velocity), integrated every frame: `kv += (−k·42 − kv·3.4)·dt; k += kv·dt` (stiffness **42**, damping **3.4**, semi-implicit Euler). Its contribution is added to the sway (§8), so a shake makes the whole plant whip side to side and settle over ~1–2 s.

---

## 8. Wind model and per-frame simulation

### Time
`t` = seconds since page start; `dt = min(0.05, frame delta seconds)`.

### Gust noise
`gustN(t) = ( sin(1.31t) + sin(2.17t + 1.3) + 0.8·sin(0.63t + 2.1) + 2.8 ) / 5.6` → a smooth 0…~1 signal.

### Wind value
`g = gustN(t)`; `w = dir · ( speed·0.75 + speed·g·gust·0.9 + gust·g·0.12 )`, `aw = |w|`. `dir` is −1 (Left) or +1 (Right). Note that even at speed 0 the gust term gives a faint idle breath.

### Automatic shedding rate
`rate = speed > 0.15 ? speed^2.4 · 0.045 · (0.35 + gustN(1.7t) · gust · 1.7) : 0`.

### Per plant, per frame
1. Draw its sand mound cells.
2. Integrate the spring (§7).
3. **Sway**: `sway = ( w·0.55 + sin(0.9t + cx)·0.05 + (aw > 0.05 ? sin(3.1t + cx)·aw·0.12 : 0) ) · flex + k·0.55·max(0.25, flex)` (cx = plant centre column, de-syncing plants).
4. For each cell with `hg = 1 − hy/rows` (0 at base, 1 at top):

**Attached (state 0)**
- Foliage only: counts toward `total` and `attached`. Auto-detach with probability per frame `rate · dt · (spine ? 0.25 : 1) · (0.2 + loose·1.6) · (0.4 + hg)`, initial velocity `vx = w·30 + (random−0.5)·8`, `vy = −random·6`. If detached, skip drawing as attached.
- **Bend offset** (all attached cells): `ox = sway · hg^1.7 · rows · 0.14`, `oy = 0` — the base is anchored, the top bends most.
- **Streaming tails** (foliage only): `arm = loose^1.6 · (flex > 0.3 ? 1 : 0.35)` (stiff plant — cactus — gets 0.35×); `g = 0.65 + 0.35·sin(2.6t − hx·0.18 + seed·0.3)` (a travelling ripple across the canopy); then `ox += w·aw·arm·rows·0.42·g + sin(7t + seed)·arm·aw·1.4` (pull downwind plus fast flutter) and `oy = −arm·aw²·3·g` (outer leaves lift slightly in strong wind).
- Store `sx = round(ox)`, `sy = round(oy)` (whole cells, keeping it crunchy pixel art). Draw at cell `(ox_plant + hx + sx, oy_plant + hy + sy)`.
- Colour: the cell colour, except cactus rib wood cells which are mixed toward their bare colour (§9).

**Not attached** — foliage counts toward `total` only.

**Flying (state 1)** — lifetime factor `lt` by kind: **petal 1.5, frond 1.25, flesh 0.95, spine 0.6** (set at detach; each flying cell also gets a random phase `ph ∈ [0, 6.28)`).
- Accelerations: `ax = w·48·lt + sin(4.2t + ph)·16·lt` (wind push + side-to-side flutter); `ay = (spine ? 50 : 18) / lt` (gravity: spines drop fast, petals float).
- Drag-toward-target integration: `vx += (ax − vx·1.6)·dt`; `vy += (ay − vy·1.1)·dt`.
- Position: `x += vx·dt + sin(6t + ph)·0.05·lt`; `y += vy·dt`.
- **Leaving the screen**: if `x < −4` or `x > cols + 4` or `y > canvasHeight/C + 4` → state 3 (gone, not drawn).
- **Landing**: with `c = round(x)`, if `c` is in range, `floor[c]` is set, `y ≥ GY − hm[c]` and `vy > 0` → state 2, snap `y = GY − hm[c]`, `x = c`, then `hm[c] = min(5, hm[c] + 1)`. Litter piles up on the ground row and stacks at most **5** cells high per column.

**Landed (state 2)** — if `aw > 0.55` (storm-strength), each frame with probability `(aw − 0.5)·dt·1.4` the litter is **re-lifted**: detach again with `vx = w·40`, `vy = −8 − random·10` (and its column's `hm` decrements by 1).

**Returning (state 4)** — see §9.

States 1, 2, 4 are drawn at `(round(x), round(y))` in the cell's own colour.

General detach rules: wood never detaches; a cell already flying is ignored; detaching an attached cell starts it at its current displayed position (home + sx, sy); detaching a landed cell decrements `hm` at its column; gone (3) and returning (4) cells cannot be detached. Every detach increments a per-frame counter used for sound.

5. **Skeleton overlay** (when Skeleton is on): after all the plant's cells, draw every attached wood cell again on top in `#c8382a` (light) / `#ff6a4d` (dark) at `(ox + hx + sx, oy + hy)` (horizontal sway applied, no vertical tail offset). Result: palm trunk and frond ribs, jacaranda trunk/branches and cactus rib lines show as a red x-ray rig while foliage still moves around them.
6. Plant bareness `bareK = total ? 1 − attached/total : 0`; the scene is "bare" if any visible plant has `attached < total`.

After all plants: unless a grow-back is in progress, toggle `body.bare` to the bare flag (shows/hides Grow back). Fire one rustle burst for the frame's detach count (§11). Update wind sound gain. Draw the windsock with the current `t` and `w`. Request the next frame.

## 9. Bare colour mixing & Grow back

### Cactus ribs
Cactus rib cells (wood with bare colour `#b2875a`) are drawn as `mix(original, #b2875a, bareK)` — linear RGB interpolation, rounded. As the cactus loses its green flesh/spines/flower, the dark rib lines warm up into a tan woody skeleton; when fully stripped they are pure `#b2875a`. (Uses the previous frame's bareK.)

### Grow back (button click)
1. Set a `growing` flag (suppresses toggling `body.bare` for **1800 ms**), clear `hm` to all zeros.
2. For every visible foliage cell not attached: if it is gone (state 3) or has never had a position, respawn it at `x = homeX + (random − 0.5)·30`, `y = GY + 6` (just below ground, spread around the plant). Set state 4, remember start `fx, fy`.
3. **Staggered, bottom-first** start time: with `r = hy/rows`, `t0 = now + (r > 0 ? (1 − r)·0.25 : 0) + (1 − r)·0.45 + random·0.35` seconds — cells near the base start first, the crown last (up to ~1.05 s later). Duration `du = 0.55 + random·0.35` s.
4. Remove `body.bare` immediately (button fades out).
5. Each frame for state 4: `e = clamp((now − t0)/du, 0, 1)`, `ez = 1 − (1 − e)^3` (**ease-out cubic**); `x = fx + (homeX − fx)·ez`, `y = fy + (homeY − fy)·ez − sin(e·π)·8` — every pixel flies home along an **8-cell upward arc**. Home = `(ox + hx, oy + hy)` (no sway). Before its start time a cell waits at its start position. When `e ≥ 1` it becomes attached (state 0) with `sx = 0`.

### Grow back visibility rules
- Visible (`body.bare`) whenever any visible plant has any detached foliage (flying, landed, gone or returning), recomputed every frame — except during the 1.8 s grow window, where it stays hidden.
- Removed on layout changes (resize, view switch, carousel step), which also reattach everything.
- In single view it sits right of the carousel nav (§3.9).

## 10. Windsock (pixel art, in the control bar)

Drawn every frame on the 28×30 canvas (displayed at 2×, pixelated). Clear it, then:
- **Pole**: colour `#6b6258` (light) / `#9a8f80` (dark). A 2-px-wide rectangle at x = 13, y = 1, height 29; plus a 4×2 base foot at x = 12, y = 28.
- **Sock**: `a = min(1, |w|)`, `d = sign(w)` (or +1 if 0), droop angle `ang = (1 − a)·1.25` rad (calm: hangs ~72° down beside the pole; gale: straight out horizontally). Five segments `i = 0…4`:
  - distance from pole `r = 2 + 2.4·i`
  - flap `fl = sin(10t − 1.2i) · a · 0.9` (a wave travelling down the sock, stronger in stronger wind)
  - `dx = cos(ang)·r`, `y = 3 + sin(ang)·r + fl`
  - segment height `h = max(2, 4 − floor(i/2))` → 4, 4, 3, 3, 2 (tapering)
  - colour: even i `#e8573b`, odd i `#f4efe6` (orange/white stripes)
  - x: if d > 0, `15 + dx`; else `9 − dx` (mirrored to the left side of the pole)
  - fill a rect `3 × h` at `(round(x), round(y − h/2 + 1))`.

## 11. Sound (Web Audio, created lazily on first Sound ON)

- Turning Sound ON the first time creates an `AudioContext` (with `webkitAudioContext` fallback); later ON clicks just `resume()` it.
- **Noise buffer**: mono, 2 s at the context sample rate, brown-ish noise: `l = (l + 0.02·white)/1.02`, sample = `l · 3.5`, where white ∈ [−1, 1).
- **Wind bed**: looping buffer source → **bandpass 420 Hz, Q 0.6** → gain (starts 0) → destination, started immediately. Every frame the gain is smoothed with `setTargetAtTime(target, now, 0.25)` where target = Sound on ? `min(0.5, aw·0.45 + 0.01)` : 0 (so turning Sound off fades it out but keeps the graph alive).
- **Rustle bursts**: once per frame when ≥ 1 cell detached that frame (and Sound is on): a new one-shot source on the same noise buffer → **highpass 1800 Hz** → gain envelope → destination. Peak `a = min(0.22, 0.02 + n/180)` (n = cells detached this frame); gain 0 at now, linear ramp to `a` in 20 ms, exponential ramp to 0.0005 by +0.35 s; start at a random offset 0–1 s into the buffer; stop at +0.4 s.

---

## 12. Controls state & behaviour

Initial state: weather off, mode `breezy`, direction +1 (Right), wind speed **0**, gust **0.45**, skeleton off, sound off, light theme, three-plant view, single index 1.

- **Weather switch**: toggles weather. Turning it **ON** applies the current mode's preset with animated sliders. Turning it **OFF** animates speed back to **0** and gust to **0.45**. The Breezy/Storm segment is dimmed (.55) while weather is off.
- **Presets** (speed, gust): **Breezy = 0.40 / 0.45** (labels "Breeze" / "Gusty"), **Storm = 0.95 / 0.95** (labels "Gale" / "Wild gusts").
- **Breezy/Storm buttons**: select the mode **and** force weather ON, then apply the preset (animated .7s).
- **Direction Left/Right**: sets dir −1/+1 and moves the `.on` highlight. Affects wind sign, leaf flight, toss velocity, sway direction and windsock side.
- **Sliders**: manual edit; touching one turns weather OFF (no preset reset).
- **Skeleton switch**: toggles the red wood overlay.
- **Sound switch**: toggles audio (initialises on first enable — requires that user gesture).
- **Moon**: toggles dark theme (all tokens + canvas background + skeleton/pole colours).
- **View toggle**: "All plants" / "One plant" sets single mode, swaps `.on`, toggles `body.single`, re-layouts (bigger cells, one centred plant, reset).
- **‹ / ›**: previous `(one + 2) mod 3` / next `(one + 1) mod 3`, re-layout. Dots reflect palm, cactus, jacaranda order.
- **Resize**: re-layout (resets all foliage).

Optional debug hook: expose `window.__pp` with the plants array, state object, grow, slider setters, weather sync, shake, setSingle and a `detachAll` that throws every foliage cell with random velocity (x ±10, y up to −20) — handy for testing, not visible.

---

## 13. Look & feel summary

- Light: warm cream sand `#f2ebdf` everywhere, white rounded pills with hairline borders, near-black ink. Dark: deep brown-black `#14110d` with `#1f1b15` pills and cream ink; transitions are .5 s.
- The plants are chunky (cells ≈ 0.54 % of viewport height, e.g. 5 device px on a 900 px tall 1× screen, 10 on retina), sitting on the 68 % ground line with small dithered sand mounds. Palm left (tall, very bendy), cactus slightly left of centre (short, nearly rigid, pink flower on top), jacaranda right (purple canopy, medium flex).
- At rest there is a subtle idle sway. In Storm the palm whips hard downwind, fronds stream out into tails, petals and leaves rip away, flutter across the screen, pile up in little drifts under the plants (max 5 high) and get swept off again; the windsock stands straight out and flaps.
- Pixel crispness everywhere: integer cell offsets, `image-rendering: pixelated`, crisp-edged icon SVG.

---

## 14. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Title is `Dune Play · Grovekit`; Inter 400/500/600 loaded from Google Fonts.
- [ ] All light and dark tokens match §2 exactly; theme toggles via `body.dark` with .5 s background transition and the canvas background follows the computed body colour.
- [ ] Brand pill "Grovekit" at 24/16, 44 px high, 14px/600.
- [ ] Title "Dune Play" 17px/500 + raised 8px BETA chip + 20 px circled "i" 14 px further right; tooltip text verbatim, 290 px, slides 6 px + fades; outside click closes it.
- [ ] Counter pill at top 88, 7×7 pink flower with yellow centre, "Shaken **4,812** times", increments per shake with en-US commas.
- [ ] View toggle (two buttons 44×36, three-bar / one-bar icons) at right 88, moon pill 46×46 at right 24; view toggle hidden ≤ 900 px.
- [ ] Control bar: min(1240px, 100vw−32px) × max(13vh, 96px), bottom 16, radius 28, gap 28, padding 28, big soft shadow; order windsock · Weather · divider · Direction · Wind speed · Gusts · divider · Show.
- [ ] Switches 50×30, springy knob, green `#2fb35a` when on; segments with white raised selected chip; custom 168 px sliders with 3 tick dots and 20 px knob.
- [ ] On load labels read "Calm" and "Gusty"; Breezy → 0.40/0.45 ("Breeze"/"Gusty"), Storm → 0.95/0.95 ("Gale"/"Wild gusts"), animated .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); weather off → 0/0.45; touching a slider turns weather off.
- [ ] Three sprite URLs used verbatim, loaded with CORS; converted via alpha bbox (>60), high-quality downsample to 96/58/86 rows, alpha ≥ 120 kept, channels posterised to multiples of 8.
- [ ] Wood classification per §5 (palm h12–48 s>.3 v<.82; jac h8–50 s>.22 v<.72; cactus dark green v<.36 ribs → wood with bare `#b2875a`; pink/yellow-top → petal; pale low-sat → spine; rest flesh).
- [ ] Looseness from 7×7 neighbourhood `(1−n/49)·1.8 + rand·0.25`, clamped; per-cell random seed.
- [ ] C = round(H·DPR·0.0054) (single 0.0068), min 2, DPR ≤ 2; ground at 68 %; plants at 20/48/77 % (single: centred, default cactus).
- [ ] Sand mounds: width max(cols·1.05, 40), height round(sin(tπ)^0.6·3), four tones by (7x+3y) mod 4; litter floor only under mounds at 1.25× width; litter stacks ≤ 5.
- [ ] Pointer cursor over plants; click shakes with impulse dir·(5+4·power), detaches max(min(L,30), min(round(L·0.13·power),170)) loosest-biased leaves with the specified velocities; dragging shakes every 28 px at power 0.7; spring k=42, damping 3.4.
- [ ] Sway, streaming tails (arm = loose^1.6, ×0.35 for cactus), gust noise, wind and shed-rate formulas exactly as §8.
- [ ] Flying physics: ax = w·48·lt + flutter, ay = 18/lt (spines 50/lt), drag 1.6 / 1.1, lifetimes petal 1.5 / frond 1.25 / flesh 0.95 / spine 0.6; off-screen removal at ±4 cells; storm (|w| > 0.55) re-lifts litter.
- [ ] Grow back appears (slides up 10 px) whenever foliage is missing; click → bottom-first staggered return, ease-out cubic, 8-cell arc; gone pixels respawn below ground near the plant; button stays hidden 1.8 s.
- [ ] Single view: ‹ • • • › nav left of centre, Grow back right of centre, 12 px gap; dots show the active plant.
- [ ] Skeleton draws attached wood on top in `#c8382a` / `#ff6a4d`; cactus ribs warm toward `#b2875a` as it goes bare.
- [ ] Windsock: pole + base, five tapering orange/white segments, droop (1−a)·1.25 rad, travelling flap, mirrors with direction, pole colour per theme.
- [ ] Sound: brown-ish looping noise → bandpass 420 Hz Q 0.6 → gain min(0.5, |w|·0.45 + 0.01) smoothed 0.25; rustle bursts → highpass 1800 Hz, 20 ms attack, exp decay to 0.0005 at 0.35 s, peak min(0.22, 0.02 + n/180).
- [ ] Resizing or switching views rebuilds the layout and reattaches every leaf; no page scroll, no text selection, no console errors.

All content wrapped in relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center w-full

Sidebar (w-40): Items — Home (active), Tasks (badge "10"), Transactions, Payments (chevron), Cards, Capital, Accounts (chevron). Section "Workflows": Trake rutes, Payments, Notifications, Settings
Main content (bg-secondary/30):
Greeting: "Welcome, Jane" — text-sm font-semibold
Action buttons row: Send (primary/accent), Request, Transfer, Deposit, Pay Bill, Create Invoice — rounded-full pill buttons text-[10px], + "Customize" text
Two equal-width cards (flex-1 basis-0) side by side:
Balance card: "Mercury Balance" with checkmark, amount $8,450,190.32 (cents in text-xs text-muted-foreground), stats (Last 30 Days, +$1.8M green, -$900K red), SVG area chart (h-20) with smooth cubic Bézier curve, linear gradient fill from accent at 15% opacity to transparent, stroke in accent color strokeWidth="1.5"
Accounts card: Header "Accounts" with + and ⋮ icons. Three rows (py-3, no dividers, text-xs, justify-between): Credit $98,125.50, Treasury $6,750,200.00, Operations $1,592,864.82
Transactions table: "Recent Transactions" heading, table with columns Date/Description/Amount/Status. 4 rows: AWS -$5,200 Pending (amber), Client Payment +$125,000 Completed (green), Payroll -$85,450 Completed, Office Supplies -$1,200 Completed
Dependencies

framer-motion for all animations
lucide-react for all icons
shadcn/ui Button component
Tailwind CSS with tailwindcss-animate plugin
Key Design Decisions

The dashboard overflows toward the bottom of the viewport and is clipped by overflow-hidden on the parent
No dark mode — light only
All colors use semantic Tailwind tokens, never raw color values in components
The SVG chart uses a hand-crafted cubic Bézier path, not a charting library

ms-vela-terms-hero.promptText: --- source: "motionsites" id: "vela-terms-hero" title: "Vela Terms Hero" category: "Crypto" type: "hero" types: [] license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md" url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#vela-terms-hero" --- # Prompt: Vela "in your terms" hero Build a single-file, one-screen hero for a fictional privacy app, **vela**: a secure messaging app, crypto wallet and Web3 browser. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is soft and warm: a grainy pastel gradient panel and a huge tight grotesk headline. The first word cycles through four verbs, each with its own glossy 3D icon, and the panel's colour changes with every word. A cream stats strip with a curved notch sits underneath. ## Media Four glossy 3D icons, each a 320×320 webp with transparency, in a soft inflated candy material. The files are orange, but the page shows each icon in its own word's hue (see **Icon tint** below). | Word | Icon | File | |---|---|---| | Message | rounded chat bubble with three embossed dots | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/83de7c35-dd91-4e56-bfb8-0ffafc83d0e0.webp` | | Browse | four-pointed sparkle star with two small orbiting spheres | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4d952211-0474-48cc-af48-58f68b3b7525.webp` | | Transact | two curved arrows cycling around a $ coin | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e2e91fca-5b3f-4e0e-a437-8a581592e407.webp` | | Build web | a globe of rounded hexagon-like cells with meridian grooves | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6b32bb47-4ad6-4938-a637-c997b373c68b.webp` | ## Scale and type - **Unit:** every size is in px of a 1440×960 frame, multiplied by `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960)`. The page fills the viewport. - **Font:** **Inter Tight** (variable, self-hosted latin), 500 for the headline, numbers and lead, and 400/500 for UI. - **Colours:** - ink `#0D0D0C` - secondary text at 56% ink, the scroll hint at 42% - strip and page cream `#FBF6EF` ## Layout (1440×960) - **Hero panel:** the top 75% of the screen. - It's made of four stacked gradient layers, one per word. Each layer has a vertical base gradient, a large radial glow at about 86% / 76% (bottom right), and a softer radial glow at about 32% / 105% (bottom left). - **Message**, lemon cream: base `#F2ECDF` → `#F4EBC6`, glow `rgb(246,222,104)`. - **Browse**, peach and apricot: base `#F8DCC7` → `#F9CBA9`, glow `rgb(249,150,84)`. - **Transact**, warm sage mint: base `#E9EBE0` → `#DFE9D4`, glow `rgb(150,206,150)`. - **Build web**, rose lilac: base `#F0E4E6` → `#ECD6E2`, glow `rgb(222,150,200)`. - A fine SVG fractal-noise grain sits on top at 18% opacity with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. - **Nav:** 80u tall, with a hairline under it. - **Left:** a 13u black dot and "vela", 600 weight at 25u. - **Right:** "Products / Company / Docs", each with a small chevron (17u, 42u gaps), then an outlined "Join Vela" button (48u tall, 7u radius, 1.4px border). The button fills black on hover. - **Headline:** - **Position:** left 112u, top 190u. - **Size:** 172u on a 0.86 line height, tracking −0.032em. - **Line 1:** the cycling slot, an icon at 1em square followed by the word. - **Line 2:** "in your terms", which never changes. - **Row:** at top 578u. - Two outlined store buttons, 58u tall: "App Store" with a fruit glyph and "Google Play" with a play-triangle glyph. Use neutral line icons, not official badges. - Beside them, a 2-line caption at 18.5u: "Vela is a secure messaging app, crypto wallet, and / Web3 browser built with state of the art technology." - **Stats strip:** the bottom 25% of the screen, in cream. - **Notch:** its top edge rises over the right side in a smooth S-curve. The SVG path is `M0 62 H1062 C1092 62 1098 54 1116 34 C1138 9 1146 1 1178 1 H1440 V62 Z` in a 1440×62 box, stretched to the width. - **Scroll hint:** "↓ Scroll to learn more" at 15u sits on the raised part. - **Content:** - "Nothing great is / made alone" at 29u, 500 weight - three stats at 54u: **11.5M+** "Active accounts", **$0.0002** "Average cost per transaction", **80+** "Dapps integrations", with labels at 16.5u - a thin line-art sprout (two leaves on a stem, a little ground line) on the far right ## Icon tint (in code) Each icon takes the hue of its word's panel, so the icon and background read as one colour family: - **Wrapper:** each icon sits in a 1.02em square wrapper with `isolation: isolate`. - **Base:** the `` is turned grey with `filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.1) contrast(1.08)`. - **Tint layer:** a colour layer sits on top, `background: var(--tint)` with `mix-blend-mode: color`, clipped to the icon's own shape with `mask: url() center/contain no-repeat`. The grey icon's shading and speculars survive, and only the hue and saturation change. - **Tints:** Message `#E9C22E` (yellow), Browse `#F2772F` (orange), Transact `#3FB874` (green), Build web `#C564C4` (rose violet). - **Motion:** the transforms (bob, pop-in) go on the wrapper. ## Motion (one clock) - **Clock:** everything reads one clock, a long Web Animation's `currentTime`, so a frame-by-frame recorder can seek it. - **Slots:** each word has a 1.75 s slot, in the order Message → Browse → Transact → Build web, looping. - **Enter, over 0.5 s:** opacity 0→1, rising from +0.32em, blur 10px→0, scale 0.96→1, ease-out cubic. The icon follows 60 ms later, scaling 0.7→1 and untwisting from −14°. - **Leave, the last 0.42 s:** fade out while drifting up 0.16em and blurring to 8px, ease-in cubic. - **Panel colour:** crossfades over a 0.77 s window that straddles each word change, so it passes through a soft muted mix as in the reference. - **Idle motion:** the icon floats gently (±0.028em, ±3°). The gradient layers drift slowly (±2.2% / ±1.6% at scale 1.08), so nothing is ever frozen. - **App Store:** while "Build web" holds, the App Store button fills to black with white text and then releases. - **Live first word:** Message also fades in on load. - **Reduced motion:** a still "Browse" state. - **Hidden tab:** the clock pauses. ## Phones (≤ 760px) - The panel flows in normal order. - The headline is at `clamp(52px, 15.5vw, 88px)`. - The store buttons wrap, and the caption sits under them. - The strip's stats wrap into two columns with the sprout on the right. - No sideways scroll. ## Acceptance check (1440×960) - "Browse in your terms" sits on a warm peach panel with the glossy star tinted orange; each icon always matches its panel's hue. - Every 1.75 s the word blurs up and out, and the next rises in with its own icon while the panel shifts to lemon, sage or rose. - The App Store button flashes black during "Build web". - **Content:** no real brands or logos.

ms-offline-footer.title: Offline
ms-offline-footer.promptText:
---
source: "motionsites"
id: "offline-footer"
title: "Offline"
category: "Footer"
type: "footer"
types: []
license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md"
url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#offline-footer"
---

# Prompt: "offline" power-button footer

Build a single-file **website footer** for a fictional digital-wellbeing product, **offline** ("Everything you need to know before you finally log off"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The footer is one full-bleed cinematic scene: a small beige vintage all-in-one computer (generic, no brand logo) on a grassy hill under a blue sky. The wordmark's "o" is a power button. Clicking it takes the scene offline: the sky turns to night, the CRT collapses to a point, and that last point of light flies up into the power-o.

## Media

- **Scene clip, 1080p:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/abdab52e-bb1b-477d-ae7c-26c5f8915433.mp4 (1920×1080, 60 fps, 5.0 s, no audio)
- **Scene clip, 720p, for screens ≤ 900 px:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/15017aa7-135b-471f-a8a1-42a208bc61b2.mp4
- **Poster:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/af6deff1-d678-4dc6-ae24-2880b16cdb20.jpg (the clip's first frame: day, screen off)
- **Fonts:**
  - Instrument Serif 400 (wordmark and column headings), self-hosted latin woff2: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizBRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zUTjnTLgNs.woff2
  - Inter 400/500 (body and links), latin variable woff2: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7W0Q5nw.woff2

### Clip timeline

The clip is one locked-off shot:

| Time (s) | What happens |
|---|---|
| 0 – 1.17 | Day, CRT off (glossy black screen) |
| 1.2 – 1.6 | Switch-on: a thin white line expands into white static, then TV colour bars with a purple-pink glow |
| 1.9 – 2.7 | Steady colour bars, dandelion seeds drifting |
| 2.7 – 4.4 | The sky turns from day through a warm dusk to deep navy night with stars; the light on the computer and grass dims |
| 4.46 – 4.62 | The picture collapses to a thin line, then to one point of light at the screen's centre |
| 4.62 – 5.0 | Night: dark screen, a faint point, stars, seeds |

Nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Every scene change comes from the clip, which never plays in reverse and never crossfades.

## Layout (desktop; 1 u = 1/1902 of the viewport width)

- **Footer:** 100svh tall, `overflow:hidden`. The video and poster cover it (`object-fit:cover`, `object-position: center bottom`).
- **Top tint:** a soft dark wash on the top 38 %.
- **Grid:** top-left at 105u / 78u, with columns of 528u, 404u and 404u, then the rest. White text.
- **Brand column:**
  - **Wordmark** "offline", Instrument Serif 58u. The **o is an inline SVG power symbol** (viewBox 0 0 50 62):
    - an open circle `M14.2 22.6 A19 19 0 1 0 35.8 22.6`
    - a vertical tick `M25 6.5 V33`
    - stroke 4.6, round caps, `currentColor`, matched to the serif's weight
    - plus a blurred white halo ring whose opacity is driven by a `--lit` variable
  - **Tagline:** 19.5u Inter at 1.5 line height, max 300u wide.
  - **Copyright:** "© 2026 OFFLINE, Inc. All rights reserved." at 17u, 34u below the tagline.
- **Link columns:** headings in Instrument Serif 35u, 40u above the first link. Links in Inter 19.5u with 19u gaps:
  - **Platform:** Manifesto, How it works, Pricing, FAQ
  - **About:** About, Careers, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy
  - **Social Media:** LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok

## Interaction

### Arrival (online)

- When the footer is 35 % in view, the text rises in: 10u lift, 0.9 s, staggered 60 ms.
- The clip plays from 0.6 s, shows the switch-on, then pauses on the colour bars at 2.3 s.

### Online idle (code overlay on a canvas over the video)

- **Scanline:** a soft white scanline band (≈52 px tall, 10 % white) sweeps down the screen glass every ~1.8 s, with a faint flicker. It's clipped to the screen rectangle, which is (806, 505)–(1077, 724) in the clip's 1920×1080 frame, mapped through the same cover transform as the video.
- **Glints:** ~10 small four-point star glints twinkle in the sky. Their number grows to ~22 as the clip's sky reaches night.

### The wordmark is a power button

- It's a `<button>` with `cursor:pointer` and aria-pressed.
- **Hover:** a soft white `drop-shadow` glow on the power-o.
- **Press:** the o scales to 0.94.

### Click while online → offline

- The clip plays from 2.3 s to the end at 1×: dusk, then night, then the CRT collapse.
- At clip time 4.72 s a **glowing dot** leaves the screen's last point of light, at (945, 594) in the clip frame.
  - It flies for 0.78 s on a curved, eased (cubic in-out) quadratic path up and left into the centre of the power-o.
  - Size: a white core with a 6× radial bloom halo, growing and then shrinking along the way.
- **Landing:** the power-o's halo ring glows (`--lit` from 0.9 to 0 over 0.9 s), as if the light went into the button.
- The clip holds on its night frame.

### Click while offline → back online

- Cut back to 0.6 s and replay the switch-on to the 2.3 s colour-bar idle.
- Clicks during the switch-off are ignored.

### Links

- On hover, a 1.6u underline wipes in from the left over 0.32 s and wipes out to the right.

## Phone (≤ 760 px)

- **Text:** the text block sits on top in two columns, with the brand spanning both.
- **Scene:** the clip sits at the bottom at 170 % width (16:9), with its top edge masked into the sky.
- **Sky:** the sky behind the text is a canvas. It paints the clip's top rows, blurred by 18 px and stretched, every frame, so it follows the clip from day to night.
- **Spacing:** the footer's bottom padding is about 80 % of the clip's height.

## Reduced motion

- No video and no entrance; the poster and text show statically.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

1. On load, the CRT switches on (line, static, colour bars) on a day sky, and the scanline shimmer runs.
2. Click the power-o: the sky goes to night, the CRT collapses, and a glowing dot flies into the o, which glows.
3. Click again: the scene comes back online.
4. Link hovers underline.
5. No brand logos anywhere.

Create a full-screen hero landing page for "Bloom" — an AI-powered plant/floral design platform. The design uses a liquid glass morphism aesthetic over a looping video background.

Background
Full-screen autoplaying, looping, muted video background: https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260315_073750_51473149-4350-4920-ae24-c8214286f323.mp4
Video covers entire viewport with object-cover, sits at z-0. All content floats above at z-10.

Fonts
Display/Body: Poppins (Google Fonts) — used for headings and body text
Serif accent: Source Serif 4 (Google Fonts) — used only for italic/emphasis text inside headings (e.g., <em>, <i>, .italic inside h1-h3)
Headings use font-weight: 500

Color Palette
Strict grayscale only — all CSS variables are 0 0% X% HSL values
Text is text-white, text-white/80, text-white/60, text-white/50 for hierarchy
No colored accents whatsoever

Liquid Glass CSS (two tiers)
Define under @layer components:

.liquid-glass (light)
background: rgba(255,255,255,0.01);
background-blend-mode: luminosity;
backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
border: none;
box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
position: relative; overflow: hidden;
::before pseudo-element: gradient border using linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%, transparent 40%, transparent 60%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%) with padding: 1.4px, masked via -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude;

.liquid-glass-strong (heavy, for CTA/panels)
Same structure but backdrop-filter: blur(50px), box-shadow: 4px 4px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15), and ::before uses 0.5/0.2 alpha instead of 0.45/0.15.

Layout — Two-Panel Split
Flex row, min-h-screen. Left panel w-[52%], right panel w-[48%] (hidden on mobile lg:flex).

Left Panel
Has a liquid-glass-strong overlay (absolute inset-4 lg:inset-6 rounded-3xl)
Nav: Logo image (/logo.png, 32×32) + "bloom" text (semibold, 2xl, tracking-tighter, white) on left. "Menu" button with Menu icon on right, liquid-glass pill.
Hero center (flex-1, centered):
Logo image again (80×80)
h1: "Innovating the / spirit of bloom AI" — text-6xl lg:text-7xl, tracking-[-0.05em], white. The italic part uses font-serif text-white/80
CTA button: "Explore Now" with Download icon in a w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/15 circle. Button is liquid-glass-strong, rounded-full, hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
Three pills: "Artistic Gallery", "AI Generation", "3D Structures" — liquid-glass, rounded-full, text-xs text-white/80
Bottom quote:
"VISIONARY DESIGN" label (text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-white/50)
Quote: "We imagined a realm with no ending." — mixed font-display/font-serif italic spans
Author: "MARCUS AURELIO" with horizontal lines on each side

Right Panel (desktop only)
Top bar: Social icons (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram) in a liquid-glass pill with ArrowRight. Account button with Sparkles icon button, both liquid-glass.
Community card: Small liquid-glass card (w-56), "Enter our ecosystem" title + description
Bottom feature section (mt-auto): Outer liquid-glass container with rounded-[2.5rem]
Two side-by-side cards: "Processing" (Wand2 icon) and "Growth Archive" (BookOpen icon), each liquid-glass rounded-3xl
Bottom card: flower image thumbnail (from @/assets/hero-flowers.png, 96×64), "Advanced Plant Sculpting" title + description, and a "+" button. All liquid-glass.

Icons
All from lucide-react: Sparkles, Download, Wand2, BookOpen, ArrowRight, Twitter, Linkedin, Instagram, Menu

Key Details
All interactive elements: hover:scale-105 transition-transform
Social icon links: text-white hover:text-white/80 transition-colors
Icon containers: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center
No border classes anywhere — glass effect handles all borders via ::before
border-radius token: --radius: 1rem

---

Build a single-page landing site for "Drift" -- a calm, ADHD-friendly planner app. Use React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + lucide-react for icons. No other UI libraries.

### Fonts

Import via Google Fonts in `index.css`:
- **Inter** (weights 400, 500, 600) -- used as base body font
- **Instrument Serif** (italic only) -- used for the italic word "the stress" in the hero heading

```css
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@1&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');
```

Body: `font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;` with antialiased rendering. `overflow-x: clip` on body.

### Color Palette

- Hero overlay: `bg-black/20`
- About section background: `#F6E4CF`
- Dark text / icons in About: `#321C04`
- Light cream (button backgrounds in About): `#FFF9F2`
- Muted accent (divider, secondary button bg): `#D9C4AA`
- Secondary button hover: `#CEBA9E`
- Dark button hover: `#1F1003`

### Tailwind Config

Add a custom keyframe `fade-in-down` (0%: opacity 0, translateY -8px; 100%: opacity 1, translateY 0) with 0.2s ease-out animation.

---

### SECTION 1: HERO (full viewport height)

- Full-screen section (`h-screen`, `overflow-hidden`, `mb-[-25px]` negative bottom margin so the next section overlaps it slightly)
- **Background video** (autoPlay, muted, loop, playsInline, object-cover, absolute inset-0):
  ```
  https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260711_090308_1dd0cea7-f9ba-4db4-8147-c7d746061c9e.mp4
  ```
- **Semi-transparent overlay**: `absolute inset-0 bg-black/20`

#### Navbar (centered floating pill)
- Positioned `absolute top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50`
- White rounded-full pill with shadow-lg containing:
  - Brand text "Drift." (text-lg, font-bold, tracking-tight, text-black)
  - Animated hamburger icon (two lines that animate to an X on click using rotate-45/-rotate-45 with cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.175,1) easing, 300ms)
- Dropdown (below the pill): white rounded-2xl container with links "Features", "Drift AI", "FAQ". Animated with opacity/scale/translate transitions. Hidden by default, pointer-events-none when closed.

#### Hero Content (bottom-aligned)
- Flex column, `justify-end`, padding bottom 12 (md:16)
- **Heading** (centered):
  - Line 1: "Own your time" -- text-5xl / sm:text-7xl / md:text-8xl / lg:text-[96px], font-normal, text-white, leading-[1.1], tracking-tight
  - Line 2: "without *the stress*" -- same sizing. The words "the stress" are rendered in Instrument Serif italic via inline style `fontFamily: "'Instrument Serif', serif", fontStyle: 'italic'` inside an `<em>` tag with className `not-italic`
- **Subtitle**: "Drift is a calm, ADHD-friendly planner that turns scattered ideas into a clear path" -- text-white/80, text-sm md:text-base, font-medium, max-w-[420px], centered
- **CTA Bar** (centered below heading with gap):
  - Container: `bg-black/25 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl`, flex row, items-center, pl-6 pr-1 py-1
  - Desktop text: "No noise. No complicated systems. Just your day, gently sorted." (text-white, text-sm, font-medium, hidden on mobile)
  - Mobile text (sm:hidden): "No noise. Just your day, gently sorted."
  - Button: "Start for free" -- bg-white, text-black, text-sm, font-medium, px-5, py-2.5, rounded-xl, hover:bg-white/90

---

### SECTION 2: ABOUT SECTION

- Background: `bg-[#F6E4CF]`
- **Rounded top corners**: `rounded-t-[25px]` with `relative z-10` (overlaps hero by 25px)
- Padding: py-20 md:py-32, px-6

#### Top Area (centered, max-w-3xl)
- Paragraph: "We craft tools that move with your rhythm, not over it. Designed for ease, presence, and flow." -- text-[#321C04], text-base md:text-lg, text-center, leading-relaxed, max-w-lg
- Two buttons (flex-wrap, centered, gap-4):
  1. **"Say hello"** -- dark pill button (`bg-[#321C04]`, `text-[#FFF9F2]`, rounded-full). Has a white circle on the left containing a Mail icon (lucide-react, size 16). Text is uppercase, tracking-wide, font-medium.
  2. **"Stay informed"** -- muted pill button (`bg-[#D9C4AA]`, `text-[#321C04]`, rounded-full). Has a white circle on the left containing a Plus icon. Same text styling.

#### Decorative Divider
- Full-width flex row with: small circle (w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#D9C4AA]) + 2px gap + horizontal line (flex-1 h-[2px] bg-[#D9C4AA]) + 2px gap + small circle

#### Bottom Area (max-w-6xl, flex-col md:flex-row)
- Left: Custom SVG logo (40x40, viewBox 0 0 256 256, abstract geometric shape with rounded quadrants, fill #321C04) + label "Calm / Amplified" (text-xs, uppercase, tracking-widest, font-semibold, line break between words)
- Right: Large paragraph: "We make AI tools and assistants. But, most importantly, we help you remember what gentle productivity looks like when software moves with you, not over you. We create systems that carry the cognitive weight, so you can attend to what truly counts." -- text-2xl / sm:text-3xl / md:text-4xl / lg:text-[42px], leading-[1.3], font-normal, text-[#321C04]

---

### SECTION 3: FEATURES SECTION (scroll-driven cards)

- **Fixed background image** (behind content, -z-10):
  ```
  https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260709_082449_46df5cc4-ad98-4541-9236-a2659c1478a4.png&w=1920&q=85
  ```
- Padding: px-5 md:px-10 lg:px-16, py-20 md:py-40 lg:py-48

#### Layout: CSS Grid on lg+ (400px / xl:460px left column, 1fr right column, gap-24 / xl:gap-48)

#### Left Column (sticky on desktop)
- `lg:sticky lg:top-0 lg:h-screen lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:justify-between lg:py-32`
- Heading: "Software that flows with your mind, not over it" -- text-white, text-2xl / sm:text-3xl / lg:text-[46px], leading-[1.2], font-normal
- Feature nav buttons (hidden below lg): list of feature titles as buttons. Active state: `bg-black/20 text-white`. Inactive: `bg-black/20 text-white/40`. Clicking scrolls to card (smooth, block: center).
- Bottom CTA (hidden below lg): "No noise. No complicated systems. Just your day, gently sorted." + "Start for free" button (same style as hero)

#### Right Column (scrolling cards)
- 3 feature cards with IntersectionObserver:
  - **Active detection** (threshold 0.6): highlights corresponding nav button
  - **Reveal animation** (threshold 0.15): cards slide in from right (translate-x-16 to translate-x-0, opacity 0 to 1, duration-700, ease-out). Once revealed, stays visible.

Each card (`bg-black/20 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-10`):
- Same SVG logo (40x40, fill rgba(255,255,255,0.8))
- Title (text-white, text-xl md:text-2xl, font-medium)
- Video (aspect-video, rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden, bg-black/30, autoPlay/muted/loop/playsInline)
- Description (text-white/60, font-medium, text-sm md:text-base, leading-relaxed)

**Feature data:**

1. Title: "Built for ease, not urgency"
   Description: "Drift strips away the noise that makes organizing feel draining. Every surface is made to be soft, quiet, and intuitive so you can move forward, not get stuck decoding."
   Video: `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260702_102608_5fa1187d-9ac6-44fb-82ab-54376200abc0.mp4`

# Kindred — Dot-Matrix Hands Hero (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file, full-viewport landing hero for **Kindred**, a community platform for creatives. The page is a calm off-white canvas with a centered headline, a black pill CTA with a rainbow underglow, and a row of partner logos at the bottom. Behind the copy, **two human hands reach toward each other (Creation-of-Adam style), drawn live in code as a black dot-matrix / LED halftone made of horizontal scanline rows of dots**. The hands slowly drift, roll and breathe, and each hand periodically **glitch-dissolves dot by dot into a second pose** and back. The background is rendered on a `<canvas>` every frame. It is not a video and not a GIF.

Plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no frameworks. The only external resources are the Google Font and one Higgsfield image used as the luminance source for the halftone.

---

## 1. Assets (use exactly these URLs)

| Use | URL |
|---|---|
| Hand source sheet (2×2 black-and-white photo sheet of four isolated hands on pure white, 2688×1520 original, requested at w=1600 → 1600×905). Must be loaded with `crossOrigin="anonymous"` (the proxy sends `access-control-allow-origin: *`) so `getImageData` works. | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261030_025250_100df7b8-31fd-4614-aa4a-c1b7d5b6b273.png&w=1600&q=85` |
| Font | `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap` (with preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com crossorigin) |

Sheet layout (fractions of the sheet's width and height, `[x, y, w, h]`):
- `LA` = `[0, .06, .47, .40]`, top-left: left forearm entering from the left edge, palm down, index finger pointing right, other fingers loosely curled (Adam's hand).
- `RA` = `[.53, .06, .47, .40]`, top-right: right forearm entering from the right edge, index finger pointing left, fingers drooping (God's hand).
- `LB` = `[0, .55, .47, .40]`, bottom-left: the left hand open, fingers spread, palm down, reaching right.
- `RB` = `[.53, .55, .47, .40]`, bottom-right: the right hand open, palm turned up, fingers curved, reaching left.

Pose A = the pointing pair (LA + RA). Pose B = the open pair (LB + RB).

No other images. Logos are inline SVG.

---

## 2. Design tokens

```css
:root{--bg:#f7f7f5;--ink:#111111;--mute:#9a9a9a;--sub:#7b7b7b}
```
- Page background `#f7f7f5` (warm off-white). Dots are `#0d0d0d`.
- Font: **Inter** 400/500/600, `-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased`, fallback `system-ui, sans-serif`.
- Global reset: `*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}`. `html,body{height:100%}`.

---

## 3. Structure

```
section.hero (position:relative; height:100vh; min-height:660px; overflow:hidden)
  canvas#dots (absolute, inset:0, 100%×100%, display:block)
  nav
  div.copy
  div.logos
```
Everything except the canvas has `position:relative|absolute; z-index:3`.

### 3.1 Nav
- A flex row centered horizontally, `gap: clamp(18px, 2.6vw, 40px)`, `padding-top: 36px`, font-size 13.5px.
- **Brand:** an inline SVG mark (16×18, viewBox `0 0 16 18`, path `M2 0h4v18H2zM7 9c3-1 5-4 6-9h3c-1 5-3 8-6 9 3 1 5 4 6 9h-3c-1-5-3-8-6-9z`, a stylised "K" with a straight stem and two curved arms) plus "Kindred". Weight 600, 15px, letter-spacing −.01em, gap 8px, margin-right 10px.
- **Links:** Platform · Marketplace · Creators · Resources · Company. Colour `#3a3a3a`, no underline; hover `#000` (transition .2s).
- **Sign In pill:** background `#111`, white text, padding 10px 21px, radius 999px, weight 500, margin-left 10px. On hover it rises 1px (`translateY(-1px)`, .25s).

### 3.2 Copy block
- Absolute: `left:50%; top:24.5%; transform:translateX(-50%)`, centered text, `width:min(92vw,720px)`.
- `h1`: weight 500, letter-spacing −.035em, line-height 1.04, `font-size: clamp(38px, 3.75vw, 68px)`.
  - Line 1, "Reconnecting", is a block span in grey `#9a9a9a`.
  - Line 2, "Human Creativity.", is ink `#111`.
- Subline `p`: "We’re not building another platform. We’re building a place where people belong." Margin-top 20px, auto sides, `max-width:340px`, colour `#7b7b7b`, `font-size:clamp(13px,1.02vw,15.5px)`, line-height 1.4. It wraps to two centered lines.
- CTA wrapper `.cta`: inline-block, relative, `margin-top: clamp(34px, 3.6vw, 52px)`.
  - The anchor "Join the circle" is a black `#111` pill with white 13.5px weight-500 text, padding 11px 20px, radius 999px.
  - **Rainbow underglow:** a `::before` element, absolute, `left:10%; right:10%; bottom:-6px; height:16px; border-radius:50%`, with background `linear-gradient(90deg,#ffcf5a,#7dffa8,#5ad7ff,#9b7bff,#ff6fd8,#ffb36b)`, `filter: blur(9px)`, opacity .85. It sits behind the pill and peeks out below it as a soft spectrum glow.
  - Hover: the glow goes to opacity 1, `blur(12px)` and `bottom:-9px`. The pill rises 1px. All transitions .3s.

### 3.3 Partner logos
- Absolute, `bottom: clamp(28px, 6vh, 64px)`, full width, flex centered, `gap: clamp(26px, 4.6vw, 66px)`, wraps, padding 0 16px.
- Colour `#8d8d8d`, `font-size: clamp(14px, 1.18vw, 17px)`, weight 500, letter-spacing −.01em. Each logo is a 17×17 inline SVG icon (fill currentColor) plus a word, gap 7px.
- The six logos, all fictional:
  1. **Lumenix**, leaf: `M3 15c0-7 5-12 14-12-1 9-6 14-13 13l-1 2-2-1z`
  2. **Velora**, hexagon ring: `M10 1l8 4.5v9L10 19l-8-4.5v-9zM10 6l-4 2.3v4.4L10 15l4-2.3V8.3z`
  3. **Nimbus**, double wave: `M1 5q4.5-3 9 0t9 0v3q-4.5 3-9 0t-9 0zm0 7q4.5-3 9 0t9 0v3q-4.5 3-9 0t-9 0z`
  4. **Quanta**, concentric rings: `M10 1a9 9 0 110 18 9 9 0 010-18zm0 3a6 6 0 100 12 6 6 0 000-12zm0 3a3 3 0 110 6 3 3 0 010-6z`
  5. **Solstice**, two peaks: `M1 17L7 6l3 5 3-7 6 13z`
  6. **Parallax**, stacked layers: `M10 1l9 4-9 4-9-4zm-9 8l9 4 9-4v3l-9 4-9-4zm0 5l9 4 9-4v2l-9 4-9-4z`
- All SVG viewBoxes are `0 0 20 20`.

---

## 4. The dot-matrix hands (canvas, the core of the design)

### 4.1 Pipeline per frame
1. Load the sheet once. Slice it into **four pre-downscaled tiles**, one 420px-wide canvas per `SRC` rect (height from aspect), drawn with `imageSmoothingQuality='high'`.
2. Keep two tiny offscreen "field" canvases, `fA` and `fB` (`willReadFrequently:true`). Each is sized **cols × rows**, so each pixel equals one dot.
3. Every frame, fill both fields white. Draw pose-A tiles (LA, RA) into `fA` and pose-B tiles (LB, RB) into `fB`, each with its hand's current transform (4.3). Read both with `getImageData`.
4. Clear the visible canvas. For each grid cell, pick a field (4.4), turn its luminance into a quantised dot size, and draw a filled circle in `#0d0d0d`.

### 4.2 Grid
- `DPR = min(2, devicePixelRatio)`. The canvas backing size is W·DPR × H·DPR. Draw with `setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0)`.
- Horizontal pitch `step = max(5, W/205)` (≈7px at 1440 wide).
- Row pitch `rowStep = step × 2.05`. The rows read as LED scanlines, with dots nearly touching along a row and clear gaps between rows.
- `cols = ceil(W/step)`, `rows = ceil(H/rowStep)`. The dot centre is `((i+.5)·step, (j+.5)·rowStep)`.
- Base radius `R = step × .46`.
- Per-cell dissolve seed: `seed = .55·hash(i,j) + .45·hash(j·3.1, 7.7)`. It is mostly random per dot, with a per-row bias so dissolves streak along rows. Here `hash(a,b) = fract(sin(a·127.1 + b·311.7)·43758.5453)`.
- Recompute everything on resize.

### 4.3 Hand placement and drift
- `LOOP = 20` seconds. `a = 2π·t/LOOP`. Phase `ph = 0` for the left hand and `π` for the right, so they move in counter-phase.
- Block size: `hw = W·.53` (portrait `W·.66`). `hh = hw · (.40·1520)/(.47·2688)`, which keeps the sheet aspect.
- Vertical centre: `cy = H·.54` (portrait `H·.66`).
- Base x position:
  - Left: `x = reach − W·.045`.
  - Right: `x = W − hw + W·.045 − reach`.
  - The forearms run past the screen edges.
- Motion:
  - `reach = (.035·sin(a+ph) + .012·sin(2a+1.3+ph))·W`: the hands slowly reach in and pull back.
  - `scale = 1 + .07·sin(a+.9+ph)`: they breathe toward and away from the viewer.
  - `rot = (left ? 1 : −1) · .045·sin(a+2.1+ph)` radians: a gentle roll.
- Transform order when drawing into the field: scale to field space `(cols/W, rows/H)`; translate to the pivot (left edge or right edge, `cy`); rotate; scale; translate back. Then `drawImage(tile, x, cy−hh/2, hw, hh)`.

### 4.4 Pose switches (glitch dissolve)
- `smooth(a,b,x)` is a clamped smoothstep. `mixAt(t,on,off,dur) = smooth(on,on+dur,t) · (1 − smooth(off,off+dur,t))`.
- Left half (`i < cols/2`): `mL = mixAt(t, 6.2, 14.6, 1.6)`. Right half: `mR = mixAt(t, 2.4, 10.4, 1.6)`.
  - The right hand opens at 2.4s and returns at 10.4s. The left opens at 6.2s and returns at 14.6s.
  - Both are back in pose A before the 20s loop restarts, so the loop is seamless.
- Per dot: `useB = seed < m`, and sample `fB` if true, otherwise `fA`. Dots switch in a scattered, row-streaked order.
- While a switch is in progress (`0.001 < m < 0.999`), any dot with `|seed − m| < .12` sits on the "front". Its value is multiplied by `|seed−m|/.12`, and also by `.3` when `hash(i+tick, j) ≤ .4`. The front flickers, thins and sparkles as it sweeps.

### 4.5 Luminance → dot
- `lum = red/255` of the chosen field pixel.
- `v = clamp((1 − lum − .16)/.42, 0, 1)`. White background gives no dot. Mid-grey skin gives big dots. Highlights give small dots, which produces visible shading inside the hands.
- Shimmer: `v *= .86 + .14·sin(t·3.2 + seed·40)`.
- Centre fade: with `cx = |(i+.5)/cols − .5|`, apply `v *= smooth(.035, .11, cx)`. The fingertips dissolve just before the CTA and never touch.
- Copy quiet zone: with `ex = cx/.2` (portrait `.44`) and `ey = ((j+.5)·rowStep/H − .385)/.085` (portrait centre `.33`), apply `v *= smooth(.85, 1.25, hypot(ex,ey))`. No dots cross the headline subline.
- **Quantise** to `LEVELS = [0, .26, .52, .78, 1]`: take the highest level with `v ≥ level − .13`. Level 0 draws nothing.
- Radius = `R × level`, except the lowest level, which uses `R × .38`. That gives the tiny "····" pinpoints in light areas. The result reads as a crisp LED halftone with five sizes, not a smooth gradient.

### 4.6 Row glitch
- `tick = floor(t·7)`, so the pattern changes 7 times a second.
- For each row, if `hash(j, tick) > .965`, the whole row slides by `round((hash(tick, j) − .5)·8)` columns. The sample index is `clamp(i − shift)`.
- A few random rows jump sideways for a beat, like a misaligned LED display.

### 4.7 Loop
- `requestAnimationFrame` calls `render((now − t0)/1000)`. `render` wraps `t` into `[0, LOOP)`.
- Expose `window.__render = render` so a deterministic recorder can drive time.

---

## 5. Responsive (≤760px)
- Nav: hide every link except Sign In. Use `justify-content:space-between` with padding `22px 18px 0`.
- Copy `top:20%`.
- Logos wrap onto two rows with `gap:14px 24px` and font-size 13px.
- On a portrait viewport (H > W), the hand band sits lower at `cy = .66H`, the hands are wider (`.66W`), and the quiet zone moves to `.33H` with width `.44`. The hands sit under the CTA.

## 6. Feel
Quiet, editorial and human. The hero should look like a monochrome LED wall showing two reaching hands. Motion is slow and continuous: drift, breathe, roll, shimmer. Every few seconds one hand crackles apart dot by dot and re-forms in a new pose. Keep everything black on warm off-white. The only colour is the soft rainbow glow under the CTA.

# Prompt: Vaultra crypto finance hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a fictional crypto finance platform, Vaultra**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a black night with a huge dotted particle globe rising from the bottom. Its rim glows red, blue and magenta, and it **slowly spins**. Thin straight light lines and small glass coin chips cross the dark sky, and a large gradient headline sits on top.

## Media

- **Globe still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/f1631235-0a76-464d-8f1d-2c4b48a997d5.jpg` (1672×941). The dotted particle globe with latitude rings and coloured rim glows, plus the thin diagonal lines and nodes.
- **Globe video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e71aea27-a808-4ae3-8231-a469d49285d4.mp4` (1280×720, 4s, muted, loops). The same globe rotating steadily left to right, with its particle rings sliding and its rim glows shimmering. The camera is still and the lines don't move.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it loops with no jump and never plays in reverse.
  - It sits over the still with identical geometry and fades in once its first frame is ready.
- **Masks:** both layers stretch to a plate that covers the hero. They're feathered at the sides on ultra-wide screens and at the top on phones.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** Inter Display 300, about 66px: "Innovative Crypto Financial Solutions / For Any Investment Challenge". It's white with a soft pink-to-lilac gradient at both ends.
- **Body:** **Poppins** 400/500 for the nav, buttons and body text.

## Layout

- **Nav:**
  - "Vaultra" with a double-slash logo mark at the left
  - "Home" (active, with a round icon) · Invest · Communit · Blog · For business · Membership
  - an "EN ⌄" globe selector
  - a white "Sign up" pill and an outline "Log In" pill
- **Centre:**
  - a small glass pill "⚡ Revolutionizing Crypto Finance"
  - the headline
  - "We Don't Just Focus On Investments, We Cover Your Entire / Financial Ecosystem, From Budgeting To Retirement."
  - a white "Get Started →" pill
- **Coin chips:** small round glass chips (₿, Ξ, ₮ and a hex token) riding the light lines at the edges. A mouse-scroll hint sits at the bottom with curved "USDT" and "ETH" labels.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** CSS, about 1.6s. The nav, pill and headline lines rise in, then the copy, the CTA and the chips.
- **Globe:** spins continuously via the video.
- **Reduced motion:** no video and no entrance.

## Acceptance check

- **Globe:** it visibly rotates, and the loop has no jump.
- **Brand:** "Vaultra" everywhere, and the "Sign up" typo is fixed.

# Prompt: Shipcraft CTA and footer

Build a single-file **closing CTA plus footer section** for a fictional app builder, **Shipcraft**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is near-black and warm:
- a tilted 3D editor panel glowing amber on the right
- a glossy amber-glass CTA button
- a four-part footer
- two white marble sculpture hands reaching toward each other, lit with an amber rim light
- a giant thin amber-brown "Shipcraft" wordmark sinking off the bottom edge

## Media (transparent PNGs)

- **Editor panel:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5bc1d856-0342-40d4-b7ca-c490ac20624a.png` (912×700). A perspective-tilted dark glass editor with a "Widget Tree" column, where "Home Screen" is selected in amber, and a "Code" column with amber, peach, lilac and teal syntax. It has a glowing amber top edge and fades out at the bottom and left.
- **Left hand:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4c029f38-d0a0-46d1-9ebc-3edcdaa11fc1.png` (582×290).
- **Right hand:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7eba3f06-a99e-44b8-bd46-7ccfaf6b2363.png` (558×328).
- **Hands:** both are polished white Carrara marble with grey veins and a warm amber rim light, reaching in from the left and right edges.
- **Motion:** no video. Only the UI animates.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Google Sans Flex (variable) for everything.
- **Colours:**
  - background `#0D0D0D`, headline white
  - text greys `#ADADAD`, `#7D7D7D` and `#717171`
  - amber accent `#F0A24C`, social icons `#E0A165`
  - wordmark `#5A3418`
- **Pill:** a dark `#1D1510` pill with an amber hairline and a sparkle icon.
- **Buttons:** glossy amber-glass. The CTA goes from a `#2C241D` to `#7A5832` gradient, with lit white and amber rims and a soft amber halo. The newsletter key has a warm metal gradient.

## Layout (787×753 reference artboard at 900px and wider; `--u` = container width / 787)

- **CTA band:**
  - pill "Ship Your Idea", then "Your next app / starts now."
  - "Describe it, shape it in the canvas or code, ship it to the App Store, Play Store, or web. No install, no credit card."
  - "Get started now"
  - the editor panel bleeding off the top-right
- **Footer:**
  - **Brand:** an original amber sail mark and "shipcraft", the blurb "Shipcraft keeps every surface in sync, / so you never rebuild from scratch.", and LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube outline icons.
  - **Columns:** Product (Preview, Features, How it works, Developers), Resources (Blog, Documentation, Videos, Community), Company (Contact, Privacy, Terms of Service).
  - **Newsletter:** "Subscribe to our newsletter", a glass email field with placeholder "jane@shipcraft.example" and an arrow key, and "Unsubscribe anytime".
  - **Bottom:** "©2026 / Shipcraft / Build a real app, fast." centred between the reaching hands, with the giant "Shipcraft" wordmark at the bottom.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a CSS sequence.
  - The pill fades, then the headline lines rise.
  - The paragraph, button and editor (scale/tilt in) follow, then the footer columns.
- **Reduced motion:** none.

## Narrower screens

- **Below 900px:** a single column with the editor under the CTA.
- **Footer columns:** wrap.
- **Hands and wordmark:** scale to the bottom of the section.

## Acceptance check (1440×1440)

- The amber-lit editor panel tilts on the right of the headline.
- The marble hands reach toward each other over "©2026 Shipcraft".
- The amber-brown "Shipcraft" wordmark sits at the bottom.
- **Content:** no real brands; the placeholder email is a .example address.
