# BUNTO° — kids' basics hero with a rotating garment ring

Build a single-screen, full-viewport hero for a fictional premium kids' clothing brand called BUNTO°. It is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, no frameworks and no build step. The page never scrolls (body overflow hidden). Everything below is exact; follow the numbers, the copy and the timings as written.

## 1. Overall idea

A warm off-white page with tiny wide-tracked all-caps labels around the edges, a huge pale ghost word "TINY" behind the centre, and six floating kids' garments arranged on an invisible horizontal ring that turns slowly and continuously, left to right across the front. The front piece is the largest, straight and highest. The side pieces are smaller, lower and lean outwards. The back pieces sit lower still, tucked behind the side pieces. Visitors can drag or fling the ring with mouse or touch. Hovering a piece updates the large index number bottom-left. Clicking any piece opens a product view: the ring freezes, the chosen piece glides to the left and grows, the others shrink and drift out to the sides, a round close button appears on the piece, and a product panel with name, description, four colour swatches and an "Add to bag" link fades in on the right. Swatches swap the garment's colourway in place. "Add to bag" flies a shrinking copy of the garment in an arc into the bag icon in the top bar, which bounces and shows a count badge.

## 2. Assets

There is one image. It is a transparent sprite sheet, 3200 × 2560 px, laid out as 5 columns × 4 rows of equal 640 × 640 cells, each cell holding one garment centred on a transparent background.

- Sheet URL (use exactly this, it serves a transparent WebP): `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261113_115509_577e7e29-0e80-43e6-93ac-e6cf71972818.png&w=3200&q=85`
- Original PNG behind it: `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261113_115509_577e7e29-0e80-43e6-93ac-e6cf71972818.png`
- Columns (products), left to right: 0 = cotton dungarees with bib pocket and rolled cuffs, 1 = sleeveless knit romper with wooden shoulder buttons, 2 = long-sleeve cotton tee with a chest pocket, 3 = chunky knit button cardigan with wooden buttons, 4 = bucket hat.
- Rows (colourways), top to bottom: 0 = Peach, 1 = Pink, 2 = Sage, 3 = Butter.
- Show one cell by putting the sheet on an element as `background-image`, `background-size: 500% 400%`, `background-repeat: no-repeat`, and `background-position: (col × 25)% (row × 33.333)%`. Never crop or re-host the image; every garment on the page is a CSS crop of this one sheet.
- Store the sheet URL once as a CSS custom property `--sheet: url("…")` on `:root` and reuse it.
- Add a hidden inline SVG filter, `<filter id="clean" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">` containing `<feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="1.1" intercept="-0.1"/></feComponentTransfer>`, and apply `filter: url(#clean)` to every garment layer. It removes faint compression specks around the cut-outs.

## 3. Fonts

One family: Inter, variable weight 200–700, latin subset, from Google Fonts: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@200..700&display=swap` (self-host the latin woff2 as `@font-face { font-family: "Inter"; font-weight: 200 700; font-display: swap }` if you prefer). Fallback `system-ui, sans-serif`. Turn on `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.

Weights in use: 200 for the big index number, 500 for all small caps labels and the product title, 600 for the bag count, 700 for the logo and the ghost word.

## 4. Colour tokens

- `--bg #F9F2E9` page background (warm cream)
- `--ghost #F5E6D9` ghost word "TINY"
- `--ink #3E3A3C` all text and icons
- `--muted #716D71` product description and category label
- `--line #E6D9D2` hairline borders of the round bag and close buttons
- `--dot #CFC6C2` inactive pagination dots (active dot uses `--ink`)
- Swatch colours: Peach `#FEDBDA`, Pink `#FCB7CC`, Sage `#C8C997`, Butter `#F5B55A`
- Floor shadow: radial gradient `rgba(120,96,86,.16)` at the centre → `rgba(120,96,86,.07)` at 55% → transparent, blurred by 3 design px.

## 5. Head

- `<title>BUNTO° — Soft things for small people</title>`
- Meta description: "Premium organic-cotton basics for ages 1–6: rompers, dungarees, tees, cardigans and hats in soft peach, pink, sage and butter."
- `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, `lang="en"`.

## 6. Scaling system

Two units, both relative to a 1440 × 900 design frame:

- `--n: calc(100vw/1440)` is the chrome unit. Edge-pinned UI (logo, labels, nav, index, scroll hint) is placed with it relative to the viewport edges.
- `--u: min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)` is the stage unit. A `.stage` box of `1440u × 900u` is centred in the viewport (`left:50%; top:50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%)`), and everything inside it (ghost word, shadow, dots, garments, close button, product panel) is positioned in design px multiplied by `--u`.

All small caps text uses a `max(9px, …)` or `max(8px, …)` floor so it never becomes unreadable.

## 7. Layout (desktop, design px at 1440 × 900)

Reusable caps style `.caps`: `font-size: max(9px, 10.5n)`, weight 500, `letter-spacing: .32em`, uppercase, line-height 1.62.

Edge chrome (positioned in `n` units from the viewport edges):

1. Logo, top-left: "BUNTO" plus a superscript "°", a link to "/". Left 46, top 30, font-size `max(22px, 30n)`, weight 700, letter-spacing −0.035em, line-height 1. The "°" is a `<sup>` at 0.5em, weight 500, raised `vertical-align: .9em`, margin-left .04em.
2. Tagline, top centre: two lines "SOFT THINGS FOR SMALL PEOPLE" / "AGES 1–6", caps style, centred at 50% horizontally, top 37, no wrapping, with `padding-left: .32em` to optically centre the tracking.
3. Nav, top-right: right 39, top 32, a flex row with a 16n gap: the caps link "MENU" (font-size `max(9px, 9.5n)`), then a round bag button. The bag button is `max(28px, 35n)` square, 1px `--line` border, fully round, centred icon at 42% size. The icon is an outline bag (16 × 16 viewBox, stroke 1.3): path `M3.5 5.5h9l-.7 8h-7.6z` for the body and `M5.8 5.5V4.4a2.2 2.2 0 0 1 4.4 0v1.1` for the handle. Inside the button sits a count badge (see section 11), and the button has `aria-label="Bag, 0 items"`.
4. Left label: "THE BASICS — 16 PIECES", caps, left 46, top 131.
5. Right label: "ORGANIC COTTON" / "KNIT", caps, right-aligned, right 38, top 132.
6. Vertical label on the far left edge: "EVERYDAY ESSENTIALS FOR LITTLE EXPLORERS", caps at `max(8px, 9n)`, rotated −90°, centred on left 26, top 447 (a zero-width flex box centred on that point, translated −50% vertically, then rotated).
7. Index, bottom-left: left 46, bottom 52, a flex row of: a big number "01" (font-size `max(30px, 50n)`, weight 200, letter-spacing −0.04em, line-height 1, inside an overflow-hidden box 1em tall so it can roll), a 1px × 28n vertical bar in `--ink` at 45% opacity with 20n margins either side, and a two-line caps label (`max(8px, 9.5n)`, min-width 16em) "ROMPER" / "COLLECTION". A second label, "CHOOSE" / "A COLOUR", is stacked on top of it, absolutely positioned and hidden (opacity 0, translateY 8px). Both labels transition opacity and transform over .45s ease.
8. Scroll hint, bottom centre: bottom 59, centred, a down arrow (11 × 16 viewBox, stroke 1.2, path `M5.5 1v13M1.5 10l4 4 4-4`, width 11n, min 8px) and "SCROLL TO EXPLORE" in caps at `max(8px, 9.5n)`, 14n gap.

Stage contents (design px × `u`, inside the centred 1440 × 900 stage):

1. Ghost word "TINY": full-width centred, top 109, font-size 295, weight 700, letter-spacing −0.02em, line-height 1, colour `--ghost`, no pointer events, not selectable, `aria-hidden`.
2. Floor shadow: an ellipse at left 370, top 690, 700 × 48, fully round, the radial gradient from section 4, blur 3.
3. Pagination dots: five 9 × 9 round dots (min 6px), 21 apart, centred at y 752. They are decorative (`aria-hidden`). The dot at index (front piece index mod 5) is `--ink`; the rest are `--dot`. Colour transition .5s.
4. Six garment elements (`.item`), each a 510 × 510 box whose centre is the transform origin (width/height 510u, negative margins of 255u, then positioned purely with `transform`). Each holds two full-size layers, `.art` and `.art2`, showing the sheet crop. `.art2` starts at opacity 0 and is used for colour cross-fades. Items are `role="button"`, focusable (`tabindex=0`), with `aria-label` like "Peach Romper", and `cursor: pointer`.
5. Close button (product view only): a 44 × 44 round button (min 34px), 1px `--line` border, background `rgba(249,242,233,.7)`, centred × icon (12 × 12 viewBox, stroke 1.3, path `M1.5 1.5l9 9M10.5 1.5l-9 9`, 36% size), `aria-label="Close"`, z-index 300. Hidden by default: opacity 0, `translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6)`, no pointer events. Its border turns `--ink` on hover.
6. Product panel (product view only): left 905, top 368, width 400. In order: a category line (caps at `max(8px, 9.5u)`, colour `--muted`), the product name as an h2 (font-size 34u, weight 500, letter-spacing −0.025em, line-height 1.1, margins 12u above and 14u below), the description paragraph (font-size `max(12px, 14u)`, line-height 1.6, `--muted`, max 30em), a swatch row (flex, 12u gap, margins 26u top and 30u bottom) of four 24u round colour buttons (min 18px, `role="radio"` inside a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Colour"`), and finally an "ADD TO BAG →" text button (caps at `max(8px, 9.5u)`, 1px `--ink` underline as a bottom border, 4px bottom padding). The selected swatch shows a 1px `--ink` ring 5u outside it at 70% opacity (a `::after` that scales from .8 to 1 over .3s).

## 8. The ring (the core motion)

Products in ring order (index: column, starting row): 0 = Romper Peach (1, 0), 1 = Tee Pink (2, 1), 2 = Dungarees Sage (0, 2), 3 = Cardigan Butter (3, 3), 4 = Bucket hat Pink (4, 1), 5 = Cardigan Sage (3, 2). The colours alternate so neighbours never match.

Product copy:

- Dungarees: category "Dungarees · Ages 1–5"; description "Washed cotton twill with a bib pocket, adjustable straps and rolled-up cuffs."
- Romper: "Romper · Ages 1–3"; "Soft knit in organic cotton, with wooden shoulder buttons and snaps for easy changes."
- Tee: "Long-sleeve tee · Ages 1–6"; "Heavyweight organic jersey with a little chest pocket and ribbed cuffs."
- Cardigan: "Cardigan · Ages 1–6"; "Chunky hand-feel knit with wooden buttons, made for layering on cool mornings."
- Bucket hat: "Bucket hat · Ages 1–6"; "Garment-dyed cotton canvas with a soft brim that folds into any pocket."

The product name is "<Colour> <Kind>", for example "Peach Romper" or "Sage Cardigan".

Geometry, in design px, run every animation frame with `requestAnimationFrame`:

- Constants: centre `CX = 718`, `CY = 418`, radius `R = 411`, vertical drop `DROP = 110`, base scale `S0 = 0.97`, tilt `TILT = 9°`, `N = 6`, `STEP = 2π/6`.
- Piece *i* sits at angle `θ = base + i·STEP`. Let `c = cos θ`, `s = sin θ` and `k = (1 + c)/2` (1 at the front, 0 at the back).
- x = `CX + R·s`; y = `CY + (1 − k)·DROP`; scale = `S0·(0.72 + 0.28·k)`; z-index = `round(k·100) + 1`; rotation = `TILT·s` degrees, so pieces on the left lean outwards anticlockwise, pieces on the right lean outwards clockwise, and the front piece is straight.
- Apply it as `transform: translate(x·u, y·u) scale(scale) rotate(rotation deg)`.
- Auto-turn: `base` grows by `OMEGA·dt` every frame, where `OMEGA = STEP / 4.2 s`. One slot every 4.2 s and a full turn every ≈ 25 s. Because x = R·sin θ, the front pieces travel left to right, come round behind on the right, and re-emerge on the left. Clamp `dt` to 50 ms, and do not advance while the tab is hidden.
- Front piece: the one with the largest cos θ. It drives which pagination dot is active.

Drag and fling:

- `pointerdown` on the stage (left button only, not in the product view) starts a drag. The stage has `touch-action: pan-y` (vertical page scrolling still works on phones), `cursor: grab`, and `cursor: grabbing` while dragging, with user-select disabled.
- `pointermove` (on window): convert the horizontal pointer delta to design px (divide by stage width / 1440) and add `dx / R` to `base`, so the front piece tracks the pointer. Keep a smoothed velocity `v = 0.6·v + 0.4·(dθ per 16.7 ms)`. Once the accumulated movement passes 6 design px, mark the gesture as a drag, add the `dragging` class and capture the pointer. A drag never opens a piece.
- On `pointerup` or `pointercancel`: if it was a drag, start a fling of `clamp(v, ±0.12)` rad per frame. Each frame add the fling to `base` and multiply it by `0.92^(dt·60)` until it falls below 0.0005. At release the auto-turn weight drops to 0 and climbs back to 1 at 0.8 per second, so the throw blends smoothly back into the slow turn.
- The auto-turn and the fling pause during a drag and while a piece is open.

Hover: entering a piece sets the index to that piece's number (01–06) and the label to "<KIND>" / "COLLECTION". Leaving resets it to "01" / "ROMPER COLLECTION". The number change is a vertical roll: the current digits slide up out of view (translateY −110%, .7s `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`), then after 300 ms the new digits jump to +110% with no transition and roll back to 0.

## 9. Product view (click)

- Clicking (or pressing Enter/Space on) any visible piece opens it. Add class `detail` to the hero. A blend value `d` animates 0 → 1 over 560 ms with ease-in-out cubic (`t<.5 ? 4t³ : 1 − (−2t+2)³/2`). Closing animates it back to 0 the same way.
- Chosen piece: interpolate from its live ring pose to a target. Desktop target x 470, y 425, scale 1.12; phone target x 716, y 300, scale 0.86. Rotation goes to 0, and z-index becomes 300.
- Every other piece: move outwards along x by `240·d` (away from the chosen piece's ring x), multiply its scale by `1 − 0.45·d`, multiply its opacity by `max(0, 1 − 1.4·d)`, and disable its pointer events.
- Floor shadow: translate by `((targetX − 718)·0.82·d, (targetY − 418)·d)` design px (an extra −60·d px vertically on phones) and scaleX `1 − 0.45·d`, so it settles under the opened piece.
- Pagination dots fade to `opacity: 1 − d`.
- The ring stops turning while open and resumes from the same angle after closing.
- Close button: placed at `(targetX + 205·targetScale, targetY − 200·targetScale)` design px, which is the top-right corner of the opened garment. With class `detail` it becomes opacity 1, scale 1 and clickable, after a .25s delay (opacity .35s ease, transform .45s `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`). Focus moves to it.
- Product panel: each child starts at opacity 0 and translateY 18u. In detail it goes to opacity 1 and none, with opacity .55s ease, transform .7s `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, staggered by 60 ms per child (0, .06, .12, .18, .24 s).
- Index: shows the opened piece's number. The "KIND / COLLECTION" label fades out upwards (−8px) while "CHOOSE / A COLOUR" fades in from +8px.
- Closing: the close button, the Escape key or keyboard all reverse everything. Focus returns to the piece and the index resets to 01 / ROMPER COLLECTION.

Colour swatches: clicking a swatch puts the new row's crop on `.art2`, adds a `swap` class (opacity transition .35s), and fades `.art2` to 1. After 360 ms it copies the crop to `.art`, hides `.art2` again without a transition, and plays a small scale bounce on the piece (×(1 + 0.035·sin(π·t)) over 420 ms). The product name, the aria-label, the selected ring and `aria-checked` all update.

## 10. Entrance (on load, once)

Wait until the sheet image has loaded (with a 2.5 s failsafe), then:

- Every chrome element starts hidden (class `rv`, opacity 0, only applied when JS has run) and is animated with the Web Animations API from opacity 0 and translateY 14px (its existing transform preserved) to its rest state. Each takes 1000 ms with `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, staggered 80 ms + 60 ms × order. The order is logo, tagline, nav, left label, right label, vertical label, ghost, shadow, dots, index, scroll hint. The ghost word is the exception: 1400 ms rising from 40px, starting at 150 ms. When each animation finishes, remove `rv` and cancel the animation so later inline styles (dot fade, shadow move) take over.
- The ring rises in at the same time, starting 300 ms after load and taking 1.6 s overall. Each piece's progress is `clamp((entered·1600 − (1 − cos θ)·260)/1000)` with ease-out cubic, so the front pieces arrive first and the back pieces a little later. Each piece moves up 36 design px into place, scales from 0.95 to 1, and fades from 0 to 1.

## 11. Add to bag

- Clicking "ADD TO BAG →" takes the opened piece's on-screen rectangle and the bag button's rectangle. It creates a fixed-position copy (`.fly`, z-index 1000, no pointer events) of the same size with the same sheet crop and colour, the `#clean` filter plus `drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(90,70,60,.18))`.
- The copy flies along a quadratic Bézier from the piece's top-left to the point that centres it on the bag. The control point is at x = start + 0.62·(end − start), y = max(0, min(startY, endY) − 0.12·height). The path is sampled into 25 keyframes. The scale rises to 1.06 over the first 12% (sine), then shrinks to `max(0.04, bagWidth·0.9/width)` with an exponent of 0.55, so it shrinks early. The rotation is `−14·sin(π·t)` degrees, and the opacity drops by 60% over the last 10%. Duration 950 ms, easing `cubic-bezier(.45,0,.25,1)`.
- On landing: remove the copy and increment the count. The badge (a 17px-tall pill at the bag's top-right, −5px offsets, `--ink` background, `--bg` text, 9.5px weight 600) pops in from scale 0 with `cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)` .45s. The bag button wiggles (scale 1 → 1.28 with −8° → 0.94 with 4° → 1, 520 ms ease-out), the badge pulses (scale 1.45, 420 ms, 60 ms delay), and the bag's aria-label becomes "Bag, N item(s)".
- The button text changes to "ADDED TO BAG ✓" and goes back to "ADD TO BAG →" after 1.8 s. The garment in the product view stays where it is.

## 12. Phone (max-width 820px and min-height 521px)

- `--u: min(100vw/600, 100vh/1100)`, so the ring is larger relative to the screen and its side and back pieces run off the edges.
- Hidden: the tagline, both side labels, the vertical label and the "MENU" text.
- The logo is at left 20, top 22, 24px; the bag is at right 20, top 18. The stage centre is at 45% of the viewport height. The ghost word is 250u at top 150u.
- The index is at left 20, bottom 26, with a 34px number, a 22px bar and 12px margins. The scroll hint becomes just the arrow at right 20, bottom 34.
- Product view: the piece goes to x 716, y 300, scale 0.86, centred above the panel. The panel is centred (left `calc(50% − 270u)`, top 585u, width 540u), with a 24px title, a 13px description at line-height 1.5, 9px caps lines, and swatches with a 12px gap and 12/14px margins. The close button follows the same formula, so it sits at the top-right of the piece.

Landscape phone (max-width 820px and max-height 520px): use the desktop layout with `--u: min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)` and `--n: calc(100vw/1000)`, the stage centred at 50%, the panel at left 905u, top 330u, width 430u, a 20px title and an 11px description. At any height up to 520px, hide the vertical label.

## 13. Reduced motion

With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no entrance animation (everything visible at once), no auto-turn, a product-view blend of about 1 ms, no fly animation (the badge just counts), no colour cross-fade, and transitions off for the panel, index, dots, shadow and swatch layers. Dragging still works.

## 14. Acceptance checklist

- At 1440 × 900 the ring turns slowly and continuously, left to right at the front, one piece every 4.2 s, with no jumps.
- The side pieces lean outwards about 9° at most, the front piece is straight, and the back pieces are lower and partly hidden.
- Dragging turns the ring under the pointer, a fling coasts and blends back into the auto-turn, and a drag never opens a piece.
- Clicking any piece runs the 560 ms transition into the product view, with the close button on the piece's top-right, and closing restores the ring at the same angle.
- All four swatches swap the colourway with a cross-fade, and the title updates.
- Add to bag flies the garment into the bag, the bag bounces, and the count increments every time.
- At 390 × 844 there is no sideways scroll, the product view stacks the piece above the panel, and the close button stays on the piece.
- No text other than the copy listed here, and no extra decoration.

ANIMATION ENGINE (requestAnimationFrame, NOT CSS marquee):
Constant SPEED = 0.8 px per frame (auto-scroll left)

# Prompt: Vantix footer ("Cobalt Flare")

Build a single-file **website footer** for a fictional creative agency, **Vantix**. Use plain HTML, CSS, inline SVG and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a deep-navy footer under a glowing electric cobalt and cyan aurora band. A thin blue arc runs through a glowing glass ring, and a big vertical cyan wordmark stands between two hairline dividers, with link columns, a "Book a call" call to action and social icons.

## Media

- **Glow plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4a917d4c-123f-4b68-8125-b201961b7791.jpg` (2240×843). A smooth cobalt-to-cyan light field across the top that fades into dark navy.
- **Motion:** a muted 4s loop over the plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a8f60da5-538f-403a-a812-6be0f098e319.mp4` (1600×600).
  - The aurora ribbons flow, ripple and curl across the band while the light drifts sideways.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - It fades in (0.9s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the glow is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** desktop is a 1326 × 1186 reference composition, with 1 unit = `--u = min(100cqw/1326, clamp(1px, 100cqw/2200, 1.16px), 100vh/1186)`. The footer always fits one screen; type keeps readable floors.
- **Framing:** content sits in a centred 1326u frame (offset `--x0`). The glow, arc and dashed rule stay full-bleed.

## Colours and type

- **Colours:**
  - page `#00071A`
  - text white; links `#AFCAF3`; copyright `#B3CCEF`
  - accent cyan `#2EF0FD`
  - dividers and the dashed rule `#2A74E8` at about 40%
- **Sky:** above the glow image (on tall screens) the background is a horizontal gradient taken from the plate's top row: `#2A70F9 → #0C40D2 → #126FF3 → #57E3FC → #64E4FC`.
- **Font:** Inter Display 300/400/500.

## Layout (reference units)

- **Glow box:** the top 558u, `preserveAspectRatio="none"` across the full width. The plate and the video share it, and both are masked so their bottom 18% fades into the page.
- **Arc:** a thin arc (1.6px, gradient `#2A6DFC → #3FD0FF`) sweeps from (0, 143) down through about (816, 386) and up to (1326, 334).
- **Ring:** r = 78 at (780.7, 351.5). A glass disc with a dark inner radial fill and a 2.4px rim graded from blue at the bottom-left to bright cyan `#8AF0FF` at the top-right. A soft 5px blurred copy of the rim sits under it as a glow.
- **Wordmark:** "Vantix", bold geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans 700), drawn as one vector path, reading bottom to top.
  - Its cap height is 88.5u, its baseline is at x = 667.5u, and its bottom is aligned at y = 901.7u.
  - It's filled with a vertical gradient `#1DB6FC → #44F4FD → #19DAFD`.
  - The two vertical hairlines at x = 473 and 762 fade in from the top.
- **Left:**
  - "Elevate your brand with / us and experience the / difference." (500, 29u) at (72, 589)
  - a 76u cyan ring with a cyan ↗ arrow, then "Book a call" (30u, cyan, underlined) at (73, 741)
- **Right:** "Important" (Services, Portfolio, Pricing, About, Reviews) at x = 859 and "Legal" (Terms & conditions, Privacy policy, Contact us) at x = 1078. Headings are 28u/500; links are 21.6u/300 on a 58.75u row.
- **Bottom:**
  - a full-width dashed rule at y = 964
  - "Follow us" at (72, 1025)
  - five 45u round icons (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Behance): dark blue glass with a thin blue ring and cyan glyphs
  - "Copyright © 2024 - All rights reserved" (15u, light) aligned right at y = 1099

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one CSS sequence with backwards fill, about 1.6s.
  - The wordmark wipes up out of a clip.
  - The headline rises out of a clip.
  - The two link columns and the CTA rise in turn.
  - The social row and the copyright fade in.
- **Hover:**
  - the CTA ring fills faint cyan and its arrow turns 45°, while the underline retracts
  - links turn cyan
  - icons lift 3u
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone (below 960px, portrait or touch)

- **One-screen grid:** the glow band on top takes the spare height, with the plate cropped to its bottom.
- **Wordmark:** horizontal and full width, rising out of the glow, with a rule just under it.
- **Main block:** headline and CTA, then the link columns. On phones they stack below the headline.
- **Bottom:** the social row, then the copyright.

## Acceptance check (1440×1152)

- The aurora visibly flows behind the arc and ring.
- The cyan "Vantix" stands vertically between the hairlines.
- Every accent (CTA, icons, wordmark) is cyan; there are no drop shadows.
- **Content:** no real brands except the generic social glyphs.

# HERO PROMPT — "olla" Stack-smart Kitchenware Landing Page (Balloon-Drop Grill)

> Exact recreation brief. Build a **single self-contained HTML file** (inline `<style>` and inline `<script>`, no frameworks, no build step, no libraries) that reproduces the page described below pixel-for-pixel and frame-for-frame. Every number in this document is load-bearing. Where a value is given in `vw`, `vh`, `%` or `px`, use exactly that unit. Where an easing curve, duration or delay is given, use exactly that. Every copy string is quoted verbatim — do not rephrase, re-capitalise or add punctuation.

---

## 0. Concept in one paragraph

A minimal, warm-beige kitchenware landing page for a brand called **olla**. At the top: a fixed white rounded navigation bar with a "Shop" mega-menu that wipes open downward into a strip of five line-icons. Below it, a hero made of two rounded panels side by side: a wide **night-sky panel** (deep navy sky, lilac clouds) on the left, and a narrow **yellow product card** on the right that plays a looping video of cookware nesting into itself. In the sky panel, a **folding grill pan hangs from a bunch of seven yellow balloons**, gently bobbing. A giant white word "olla" sits at the bottom-left of the sky panel. When the user scrolls, the balloons let go and float up out of the panel, and the grill **falls under gravity** — opening into a V shape and folding shut again as it falls — drifts sideways, shrinks, **passes behind the beige gutter between the sky panel and the kitchen panel below**, and **lands exactly in an empty gap on a kitchen counter** in a photographic kitchen section. When it lands, a centred headline fades up over the kitchen photo.

## 8. The grill technique (green-screen clip → keyed frame cache → scroll scrub)

The grill is **not** a playing video. It is a set of pre-keyed frames scrubbed by scroll.

### 8.1 Two canvases

- Both canvases have class `.grill`: `position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform`.
- `#gS` lives inside `#sky`; `#gK` lives inside `#kitchen`. Both always show the same frame at the same document-space position, size and rotation (§12 explains why).

### 8.2 Frame caching

- Constants: **NF = 48** frames, **FS = 560** px square cache canvases.
- Create an offscreen `<video>`: `crossOrigin = "anonymous"`, `muted = true`, `playsInline = true`, `preload = "auto"`, `src = GRILL_CLIP`. Wait for `loadeddata` (reject on `error`; the whole cache routine's failure is silently caught).
- Let `dur = video.duration − 0.05` (avoid seeking past the last decodable frame).
- For i = 0 … 47 sequentially: set `currentTime = dur · i / 47`, await the `seeked` event, then create a 560 × 560 canvas (2D context with `willReadFrequently: true`), draw the video scaled into the full 560 × 560, apply the chroma key (§8.3) in place, and push the canvas into the frames array.
- As soon as frame 0 is cached, set a `ready` flag and force a redraw, so the grill appears immediately while the remaining frames continue to cache.

### 8.3 Chroma key (per pixel, on the 560 × 560 canvas)

For each pixel with channels r, g, b:

1. m = max(r, b)
2. k = g − m (how much "greener than anything else" the pixel is)
3. If **k > 18**:
   - alpha = max(0, 1 − (k − 18) / 52) → written as alpha·255 (integer-truncated). So k = 18 is fully opaque, k ≥ 70 is fully transparent, linear in between (threshold **18**, soft range **52**).
   - **Despill**: g = min(g, m + 6) — clamps green to at most 6 above the larger of red/blue, removing the green fringe on edges.
4. Otherwise leave the pixel untouched (alpha stays 255).

Write the image data back with `putImageData`.

### 8.4 Drawing a frame

- Frame index f (see §11.4) is computed each animation frame; only when f changes (or on a forced redraw) do both canvases get cleared and redrawn: `clearRect` the full backing store, then `drawImage(frames[f], 0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight)` (scale the 560 cache to the canvas backing size). If f exceeds the number of frames cached so far, use the last cached one.
- Before `ready`, f = 0 and nothing is drawn (empty canvas).

### 8.5 Canvas sizing

- m = ceil( max(c0, c1) · 1.05 ) CSS px, where c0 and c1 are the start and end grill sizes (§9, §10). Both canvases: CSS width/height = m px; backing store = m · dpr square, with **dpr = min(devicePixelRatio, 2)**.
- The visible size is then controlled purely by a CSS `scale(size / m)` in the transform (§11.5), so the canvas never needs to be resized during scroll.

## 9. Geometry: sky panel start state and balloons

All geometry is computed in **document coordinates** (bounding client rect + `scrollY`) in a `measure()` function, run on load, after `document.fonts.ready`, and on every `resize`.

- S = sky panel rect: S.x = left, S.y = top + scrollY, S.w, S.h.
- K = kitchen panel rect, same way.

**Grill start (hanging in the sky):**
- Centre x0 = S.x + **0.81 · S.w**; centre y0 = S.y + **0.525 · S.h** (81 % across, 52.5 % down the sky panel — right of centre, in the lower half, clear of the tagline).
- Frame size c0 = **0.425 · S.h** (the square frame is 42.5 % of the panel height).

**Balloons (strings meet the grill handle):**
- Width bw = **0.30 · S.w**; height bh = bw · 2048 / 1360.
- Handle point in the panel's local coordinates: x = 0.81 · S.w, y = 0.525 · S.h − c0/2 + **0.075 · c0** (top of the frame plus 7.5 % of the frame).
- Balloon element `left` = 0.81 · S.w − bw · **0.494**; `top` = (0.525 · S.h − c0/2 + c0 · 0.075) − bh · **0.946**. That places the image's string-meeting point (49.4 %, 94.6 %) exactly on the handle.

---

## 10. Geometry: kitchen cover-fit mapping and landing target

The kitchen photo is `background-size: cover` and centred, so image-relative coordinates must be mapped through the fit:

- Intrinsic KI = 2688 × 1520.
- sc = max(K.w / 2688, K.h / 1520) (cover scale).
- ox = (K.w − 2688 · sc) / 2; oy = (K.h − 1520 · sc) / 2 (negative overflow offsets, centred).
- Image point (nx, ny) in 0…1 → document px: ( K.x + ox + nx · 2688 · sc , K.y + oy + ny · 1520 · sc ).
- Displayed image height H = 1520 · sc.

**Landing gap** (empty spot on the counter) = image point **(0.489, 0.641)** → (gx, gy).

**End size**: c1 = H · **0.2 / 0.83** — the grill body (≈ 83 % of its square frame) ends up 20 % of the displayed image height, matching the scale of the neighbouring air fryer.

**End centre**: x1 = gx; y1 = gy − c1 · **0.91** + c1 / 2 — i.e. the frame is positioned so that the point at **91 % down the frame** (the bottom of the grill body / its feet) rests exactly on the gap point on the counter.

**Headline**: image point **(0.496, 0.125)** → set `#ktext` left/top to that point minus K.x / K.y (panel-local px). Set `--kh` = H · 0.0285 px and `--kp` = H · 0.0205 px on `#kitchen` (1 decimal).

**Scroll end** (progress = 1): end = max(200, K.y − 0.093 · innerHeight) — the scroll position at which the kitchen panel's top sits 9.3 % of the viewport height from the top, directly under the nav, mirroring the hero panel's offset.

After measuring, resize both canvases (§8.5) and force a redraw.

---

## 11. Scroll choreography (runs every requestAnimationFrame)

### 11.1 Progress and smoothing

- Every frame: target = scrollY / end. Smoothed progress sp += (target − sp) · **0.18**. If |target − sp| < 0.0005, snap sp = target.
- p = clamp(sp, 0, 1) (clamp = min/max to [0, 1]).
- The loop starts after `document.fonts.ready` resolves (measure first, then begin rAF). Also call measure once immediately at script end.

### 11.2 Fall parameter and curves

- q = clamp( (p − 0.02) / 0.9 ) — nothing moves for the first 2 % of progress; the fall completes at p = 0.92.
- **Vertical** uses gravity-like acceleration: fall = q^**1.75**.
- **Horizontal drift** and **size** use smoothstep: s(q) = q² · (3 − 2q).

### 11.3 Idle motion (while hanging)

Let t = performance.now() / 1000 (seconds), idle = 1 − clamp(p · 12) — full at p = 0, faded to 0 by p = 1/12.
- **Bob** = idle · sin(1.9 · t) · **6 px** (±6 px vertical, 1.9 rad/s).
- **Sway** = idle · sin(1.3 · t) · **1.4°** (±1.4°, 1.3 rad/s).

### 11.4 Grill position, size, tilt, frame

- x = x0 + (x1 − x0) · s(q)
- y = y0 + (y1 − y0) · q^1.75 + bob
- size = c0 + (c1 − c0) · s(q)
- tilt (degrees) = sin(q · π) · **−9** + sway — tilts up to 9° counter-clockwise mid-fall and returns to level on landing.
- Frame index f = round( clamp( (q − 0.12) / 0.72 ) · 47 ), also clamped to [0, cachedFrames − 1]; 0 when not ready. The grill stays closed for the first 12 % of the fall, opens into its V around the middle, and is fully closed again by q = 0.84 — it lands closed.

### 11.5 Applying to the two canvases

With scl = size / m:
- `#gS` transform: translate( x − S.x − m/2 px, y − S.y − m/2 px ) rotate( tilt deg ) scale( scl )
- `#gK` transform: translate( x − K.x − m/2 px, y − K.y − m/2 px ) rotate( tilt deg ) scale( scl )
- Order matters: translate first, then rotate, then scale; transform-origin is the default centre of the canvas, so rotation and scaling happen around the grill's centre.

### 11.6 Balloons release

- r = clamp( p · 1.25 ) (the balloons finish leaving by p = 0.8).
- Balloon transform: translate( r · −0.06 · S.w px, bob − r · 1.25 · S.h px ) rotate( sway · 1.6 − r · 6 deg ).
- So they bob in sync with the grill while idle (same bob, sway amplified ×1.6), and on scroll they rise by 1.25 panel heights (well out of the top of the sky panel, clipped by its rounded overflow), drift left by 6 % of the panel width, and rotate to −6°, pivoting on the string knot.
- Note there is no tether: the balloons rise and the grill falls simultaneously — the release reads as "let go".

### 11.7 Landed state

Toggle class `landed` on `<body>` whenever **p > 0.9** (on every frame — scrolling back up removes it and the headline fades out).

### 11.8 Debug hook (optional, but included in the original)

Expose `window.__olla` with getter `p` (current smoothed progress), getter `ready` (number of cached frames) and the `measure` function.

---

## 12. Layering — why two canvases (the key illusion)

- The sky panel and the kitchen panel are **separate rounded boxes with `overflow: hidden`**, separated by a **1.19vw strip of page beige** (#e9e7df).
- The grill is drawn **twice**: once in a canvas inside the sky panel, once in a canvas inside the kitchen panel. Both are positioned from the **same document-space centre (x, y)** by subtracting each panel's own document origin. Same frame, same size, same rotation.
- Each panel clips its own copy to its own rounded window. So while the grill crosses the boundary, its upper part is visible inside the sky panel, its lower part inside the kitchen panel, and **the slice that overlaps the beige gutter is invisible** — the grill appears to pass *behind* the page, as if the panels were windows onto one continuous space. The rounded corners clip it too.
- Do NOT use a single fixed/overlay canvas — that would paint over the beige gutter and break the illusion.
- In the sky panel the giant "olla" word (z 3) and tagline (z 3) are above the grill (z 2), and the grill (later in DOM, same z 2) is above the balloons. In the kitchen panel the headline (z 4) is above the grill.

---

## 13. Responsive / phone layout (max-width: 760px)

- `--w` becomes `calc(100vw − 32px)` (16 px side gutters); `--gap` becomes **12px**.
- Hide `#links` and `#drop` entirely (`display: none`). Nav horizontal padding becomes **18px** (logo left, search icon right).
- `#hero`: `flex-direction: column`, `height: auto`, `padding-top: 76px`.
- `#sky`: `flex: none`, `height: 72vh`; `.word` font size **34vw**.
- `#card`: `flex: none`, `height: 78vh`, padding **18px**; the shop button `left: 18px; right: 18px`.
- `#kitchen`: `height: 70vh`.
- `#ktext`: `white-space: normal`, `width: 86%`.
- The JS geometry is unchanged — because everything is measured from live bounding rects in document space, the grill automatically falls from the sky panel, past the card (which is now stacked between sky and kitchen — the grill simply passes behind it since neither panel copy paints over the card), and lands in the kitchen gap. The scroll end formula is the same.

---

## 14. Copy deck (all text, verbatim)

| Location | Text |
|---|---|
| `<title>` | olla — Stack-smart kitchenware |
| Nav logo | olla |
| Nav links | Shop · olla · olla PRO · Simply Good · Recipes · Journal |
| Search button aria-label | Search |
| Drop items | Shop All · Stack-smart™ · EverCoat™ · Family Sized · Pro Performance |
| Sky tagline | Stack-smart<sup>™</sup> ⏎ kitchenware |
| Sky giant word | olla |
| Card pill | NEW |
| Card paragraph | Say hello to simplicity. ⏎ Introducing Stack-smart<sup>™</sup> ⏎ kitchenware. |
| Card button | Shop Stack-smart™ |
| Kitchen h2 | Cooks for your family. Fits your space. |
| Kitchen p | A stack-smart kitchenware system designed ⏎ to save up to 50% more cupboard space. |

(⏎ = `<br>`.)

---

## 15. Timeline walkthrough (what the user should experience)

1. **Load (scroll 0)**: Nav, sky panel, yellow card. Pots clip loops in the card with no visible edges (card colour sampled from the clip). Grill appears (as soon as frame 0 is keyed) hanging at 81 %/52.5 % of the sky panel, 42.5 % of the panel height, closed, gently bobbing ±6 px and swaying ±1.4°, with the balloon bunch above it, strings tied to the handle, bobbing with it.
2. **First few percent of scroll**: idle bob/sway fade out by p ≈ 0.083. Balloons start rising and drifting left, rotating toward −6°; they leave the top of the sky panel by p = 0.8.
3. **p 0.02 → 0.92**: the grill falls — slow at first, accelerating (q^1.75) — drifts horizontally toward the counter gap and shrinks (smoothstep), tilting up to −9° at mid-fall. From q 0.12 it opens into a V, then folds shut by q 0.84. It slides behind the giant "olla" word, exits the bottom of the sky panel, is hidden while crossing the beige gutter (and behind nothing else), re-emerges from the top edge of the kitchen panel and settles, level and closed, with its feet on the counter gap at image point (0.489, 0.641).
4. **p > 0.9**: headline "Cooks for your family. Fits your space." fades up 14 px over 0.7 s, the paragraph follows 0.12 s later. Kitchen panel top is now just under the nav.
5. **Scrolling back up** reverses everything exactly (all state is a pure function of smoothed scroll progress plus time for the idle motion).

---

## 16. Implementation notes and pitfalls

- Everything must be computed from live layout; never hard-code pixel positions. Re-run measure on resize.
- Use one rAF loop for everything; do not use scroll event listeners for animation (the loop reads scrollY directly).
- The grill canvases are never resized during scroll — only transformed. Redraw canvas pixels only when the frame index changes.
- Draw the cached 560 px frames with the default image smoothing.
- Do not add any opacity fades, blurs or crossfades to the grill, balloons or videos. The only opacity transitions on the page are the menu items and the landed headline.
- The card video must stay a real `<video>` element (not canvas), muted, looping, inline.
- Don't add shadows to any panel, nav or pill. Flat design: white, beige, navy, yellow.
- Panels' corner radius is **14px**; nav and drop strip **10px**; pill and button fully rounded (30px / 40px).
- If the grill clip fails to load (CORS/network), the page must still work: nothing is drawn for the grill and the rest animates normally.

---

## 17. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Single HTML file; Jost 400/500/600 from Google Fonts; title "olla — Stack-smart kitchenware".
- [ ] Page background #e9e7df; ink #16193a; navy #141a4a; card fallback #f7d23a; easing cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) everywhere an ease is used.
- [ ] All five asset URLs present verbatim (SKY, BALLOONS, KITCHEN via images.higgs.ai; GRILL_CLIP, POTS_CLIP via cloudfront), none substituted or re-hosted.
- [ ] Nav: fixed, 87vw, 5vh (min 40px) tall at top 1.9vh, white, radius 10px, 3.9vw side padding; logo "olla" clamp(17px,1.35vw,24px)/600/−0.03em; links centred with translateX(−52%), gap 2.4vw, clamp(12px,.95vw,16px)/500; left-to-right underline on hover (1.5px, bottom −3px, .35s); 18px search glyph at right.
- [ ] Shop hover/click opens the drop strip: 0.9vh below nav, 9.5vh (min 70px), clip-path wipe down .45s, items fade/slide from −6px with 0/40/80/120/160 ms stagger; chevron rotates 180°, Shop dims to .55; 160 ms close delay bridges the gap; five line icons (storefront, stacked cubes, leaf, family, bolt-in-circle) stroke 1.3, hover #3a49c9.
- [ ] Hero row: 87vw, padding-top 9.3vh, 100vh tall, gap 1.19vw; sky panel 71.1% × 89.3vh, radius 14, overflow hidden; card fills the rest, 89.3vh, radius 14.
- [ ] Sky tagline at 6.45%/8.8%, clamp(20px,2.05vw,36px)/500/1.08/−0.01em with small top-aligned ™; giant "olla" at left 6.1% bottom 5.4%, 27vh/500, line-height .74, −0.035em, above the grill.
- [ ] Card: NEW pill (3vh, min 22px, 1.25vw padding, radius 30), paragraph 2.1vh below at clamp(12px,.92vw,16px)/1.55/500, pots video at 50%/52%, 118% wide square, object-fit cover, radial mask closest-side #000 72% → transparent 99%; card background equals the average of the clip's top-left 12% region; "Shop Stack-smart™" pill button at bottom 2.4vh, 4.3vh tall (min 32px), hover navy/white.
- [ ] Kitchen panel: 87vw × 89.3vh, 1.19vw below hero, radius 14, overflow hidden, cover-fitted photo; 9.3vh spacer after it.
- [ ] Headline centred on cover-mapped image point (0.496, 0.125); h2 size = 2.85% and p size = 2.05% of displayed image height; hidden until p > 0.9, then .7s fade/rise with .12s stagger; reverses on scroll up.
- [ ] Grill clip cached as 48 seeked frames into 560px canvases; chroma key k = g − max(r,b), threshold 18, soft range 52, despill g → min(g, max(r,b)+6); grill appears as soon as frame 0 is ready.
- [ ] Grill hangs at 81%/52.5% of sky panel, frame = 42.5% of panel height, bobbing ±6px @1.9 rad/s and swaying ±1.4° @1.3 rad/s, fading out over the first 1/12 of progress.
- [ ] Balloons 30% of sky width, aspect 1360:2048, transform-origin 49.4% 94.6%, strings meet the handle at 7.5% of the grill frame; release: up 1.25 × panel height, left 6% width, rotate −6°, complete at p = 0.8.
- [ ] Progress = scrollY / max(200, kitchenTopDoc − 0.093·innerHeight), smoothed by 0.18/frame with 0.0005 snap; q = clamp((p − 0.02)/0.9); vertical q^1.75; drift and size smoothstep; tilt sin(qπ)·−9° + sway; frame = round(clamp((q − 0.12)/0.72)·47).
- [ ] Landing: centre x at gap x, frame bottom (91% of frame) on the counter gap at image point (0.489, 0.641); size = displayed image height × 0.2 / 0.83; lands closed and level.
- [ ] Two grill canvases (one per panel) driven by the same document coordinates; the grill visibly disappears in the beige gutter between sky and kitchen and is clipped by the rounded corners — never drawn on top of the gutter.
- [ ] Canvases sized ceil(max(c0,c1)·1.05) CSS px at dpr ≤ 2, animated only via transform translate→rotate→scale(size/m).
- [ ] Phone (≤760px): width 100vw − 32px, gap 12px, no links/drop, nav padding 18px, stacked hero (padding-top 76px), sky 72vh with 34vw word, card 78vh with 18px padding, kitchen 70vh, headline wraps at 86% width; the fall still lands in the gap.
- [ ] No opacity crossfades on grill/balloons/videos, no shadows, no external JS libraries; page works (minus the grill) if the clip fails.

ms-designer-portfolio.promptText: --- source: "motionsites" id: "designer-portfolio" title: "Designer Portfolio" category: "Portfolio" type: "hero" types: [] license: "Free prompt published by MotionSites AI — see NOTICE.md" url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#designer-portfolio" --- # Recreate the "Adrian Korvel" portfolio hero exactly Build a single-file, full-viewport portfolio hero for a fictional independent designer, Adrian Korvel. It is one screen, with no scrolling on desktop. The page is a deep burnt-terracotta scene. A giant, softly glowing condensed serif name sits behind an illustrated portrait of a young man with long curly hair that blows in the wind. Dark agave leaves sway in the bottom corners, and small sparkles twinkle. Around this sit small uppercase typewriter-style text blocks, a minimal nav and a strip of five badges along the bottom. Everything below must be reproduced exactly: values, text, assets, timings. --- ## 1. Assets (use these exact URLs; do not re-host, crop or re-encode) | Role | Type | URL | Size | How it is used | |---|---|---|---|---| | Scene still (background plate) | PNG, served as WebP through the image proxy | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_011718_f1fd2b4c-d260-44ae-a0a2-8256134a4c35.png&w=2048&q=85` | 2048 × 1360 (3:2) | CSS background of the plate box, stretched to the box (`background-size:100% 100%`). Terracotta field, soft central glow, dark brown agave clusters in the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, 3 small white four-point sparkles. No text, no person. | | Scene loop video | MP4 H.264, 1764 × 1172, 24 fps, 5.04 s, no audio | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_013821_69b8d7f5-48e9-43bb-8986-621494771aff.mp4` | ~2.4 MB | Same framing as the scene still. Agave leaves bend and whip hard in a gusting wind, sparkles twinkle, glow stays constant. Starts and ends on the still, so it loops seamlessly. Plays on top of the still inside the plate box. | | Portrait still on chroma green | PNG, served as WebP through the image proxy | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_011718_86327298-00a4-468f-bc16-1555fc51ab6a.png&w=2048&q=85` | 2048 × 1360 (3:2) | The young man (long dark-brown curly hair to the shoulders, oatmeal crew-neck chunky knit sweater, flat painterly vector illustration style) on flat #00FF00. Keyed to transparency in WebGL; shown until the video has frames and permanently for reduced motion. Must load with `crossOrigin="anonymous"` (the proxy sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`). | | Portrait loop video on chroma green | MP4 H.264, 1764 × 1172, 24 fps, 5.04 s, no audio | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_013339_aa2bb827-96c2-470c-be0f-f718d4c1cfcf.mp4` | ~6.2 MB | Same framing as the portrait still. His hair streams and whips to the right in a strong wind, the sweater ripples, he breathes and blinks once; the green never changes. Starts and ends on the still (seamless loop). Never shown directly: it is drawn into a WebGL canvas and keyed every frame. CloudFront sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, so it must be created with `crossOrigin="anonymous"`. | All four media share one geometry: a 3:2 image placed in a 1440 × 900 design frame at **left 0, top −28.125, width 1440, height 956.25** design units. That is a centred 16:10 crop of the 3:2 source, with 28.125 units hidden above and below. ## 2. Fonts (self-hosted latin WOFF2 from Google Fonts) | CSS family name | Google font | Weight(s) | File URL | Used for | |---|---|---|---|---| | "Caslon Cond" | Libre Caslon Condensed (variable) | 400–700 range, used at 500 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/librecasloncondensed/v3/flUpRrasxYEyVwtcWIsbLunUPow3bHNaxvyEX6gqZQ.woff2` | The giant two-line name | | "Instrument Serif" | Instrument Serif | 400 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizBRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zUTjg.woff2` | "Korvel" wordmark | | "Plex Mono" | IBM Plex Mono | 400 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F63fjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n1i8q1w.woff2` | Body copy, badges, CHAT | | "Plex Mono" | IBM Plex Mono | 500 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F6qfjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n3twJwlBFgg.woff2` | Nav links, BOOK A CALL | `font-display: block` for Caslon Cond (the name must never flash in a fallback face); `swap` for the others. In the standalone file all four are embedded as base64 data URIs. ## 3. Head and colour tokens - ``: Adrian Korvel — Independent Designer - meta description: "Adrian Korvel is an independent designer based in Lisbon, building calm, honest digital interfaces for studios that value clarity and craft." - viewport: `width=device-width, initial-scale=1` | Token | Value | Use | |---|---|---| | --bg | #aa4820 | Page background, plate fallback | | --ink | #fff8f1 | All small text and icons | | --name | #fae5d5 | Giant name | | --pill | #f4ede6 | BOOK A CALL background | | --pill-ink | #a03815 | BOOK A CALL text and arrow | Global reset (`*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}`). `html, body` height 100%, background --bg, colour --ink. `body` uses Plex Mono, `overflow:hidden` on desktop, `-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased`. Links inherit colour, no underline. ## 4. The scaling system (three units) Everything was measured on a 1440 × 900 mockup. One design unit is 1 mockup pixel. - `--u` (cover) = `max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`. Used only for the scene plate, which must always cover the whole viewport. - `--uc` (contain) = `min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`. Used for the content frame (name and portrait) and for the four copy blocks, so they always fit inside the viewport. - `--n` (nav) = `clamp(0.62px, 100vw/1440, 1.25px)`. Used for the nav and the badge strip, which are pinned to viewport edges and scale with width only. - `--ft` = `100vh − 900·--uc`, the y position where the content frame starts. Containers: - `.hero`: `position:relative`, 100vw × 100vh (100svh where supported), `overflow:hidden`, background --bg. - `.cover` (scene plate holder): absolute, `left:50%`, `bottom:0`, width 1440·--u, height 900·--u, `translateX(-50%)`. It is **bottom-anchored**: on wide, short screens the top of the scene is cropped, never the agave. - `.frame` (content): the same box but with `--u` redefined to `--uc`. Absolute, `left:50%`, `bottom:0`, 1440·--uc × 900·--uc, `translateX(-50%)`. It sits on the viewport's bottom edge. - Inside each: `.plate` and `.man` are at left 0, top −28.125·u, width 1440·u, height 956.25·u. ## 5. Layer stack and exact desktop layout (design units on the 1440 × 900 frame) From back to front: 1. **Plate** (`.cover > .plate`). The background image is the scene still (stretched 100% 100%), with the scene video as a child `<video class="plate-vid">` (absolute, inset 0, 100% × 100%, `object-fit:cover`, opacity 0 → 1 over 0.8 s ease once it fires `playing`). The video is muted, looped, `playsinline`, `preload=auto`, `crossOrigin=anonymous` and `aria-hidden`. The plate carries `role="img"` and `aria-label` "Terracotta backdrop with dark agave leaves". 2. **Name** (`h1.name`, `aria-label="Adrian Korvel"`, children `aria-hidden`). It fills the frame, with `pointer-events:none`. Font: Caslon Cond 500, colour #fae5d5, `line-height:1`. Glow: `text-shadow: 0 0 10u rgba(255,214,186,.55), 0 0 34u rgba(255,170,120,.45), 0 0 80u rgba(255,150,100,.25)`. Each line is an absolutely positioned span, full width, `text-align:center`, `nowrap`: - Line 1 "Adrian": font-size 202u, letter-spacing −0.01em, top 94u, translateX(−4.5u). Measured ink: x 449–977, cap top ≈ 118, baseline ≈ 272. - Line 2 "Korvel": font-size 212u, letter-spacing 0.065em, top 266u, translateX(11u). Measured ink: x ≈ 420–1030, baseline ≈ 453. - The portrait covers the middle of both words (the "r", "i" of Adrian and "orv" of Korvel are hidden behind his head and hair). That is intended. 3. **Portrait** (`.man`, `role="img"`, `aria-label` "Illustrated portrait of a young man with long curly hair in an oatmeal sweater", `pointer-events:none`). It contains one `<canvas>` (absolute, inset 0, 100% × 100%, `object-fit:cover`). The canvas pixel size equals the source being drawn (2048 × 1360 for the still, 1764 × 1172 for the video). Head top ≈ y 183, face centred at x ≈ 720, sweater running off the bottom edge. 4. **Bottom fade** (`.fade`, full viewport width, bottom 0, height 150·--uc, `pointer-events:none`): `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(176,82,44,0) 0%, rgba(190,110,74,.45) 62%, rgba(200,130,98,.72) 100%)`. It melts the sweater and agave into a lighter terracotta haze behind the badges. 5. **Copy blocks** (`p.copy`, z-index 3). Plex Mono 400, font-size 15.6·--uc, line-height 20.7·--uc, letter-spacing 0.025em, uppercase, `nowrap`, colour --ink. Lines are split with `<br>` exactly as shown: - `.c1`: left 62·--n, top --ft + 152·--uc. Text: "I design calm, honest / digital interfaces — / shaped like architecture, / warm like baked clay." - `.c2`: left 62·--n, top --ft + 366·--uc. Text: "No noise. No fluff. Just / craft. Every detail earns / its own place." - `.c3`: left `100vw − 214·uc − 62·n + 62·uc`, top --ft + 152·--uc. Text: "Based / in Lisbon, / remote" - `.c4`: left `100vw − 291·uc − 62·n + 62·uc`, top --ft + 363·--uc. Text: "Independent designer for / studios that value / clarity, craft, and the / long-lasting simplicity." - At exactly 1440 × 900 this puts the blocks at x 62, 62, 1226 and 1149. On other sizes the left blocks stay aligned with the nav padding and the right blocks keep the same distance from the right edge. 6. **Nav** (`header.nav`, absolute, top 0, full width, height 54·n, flex, `align-items:center`, horizontal padding 62·n, z-index 5): - Wordmark "Korvel" (`a.logo`, `aria-label` "Korvel, home"): Instrument Serif 400, 33·n, line-height 1, letter-spacing −0.01em, nudged up 2·n, margin-right 48·n. Ink x 64–131 at 1440. - Links (`ul.links`, Plex Mono **500**, 14.6·n, letter-spacing 0.02em): HOME · ABOUT · PROJECTS · JOURNEY. The middle dots are `li + li::before { content:"·"; margin:0 14n; opacity:.85 }`. Each link has 4·n vertical padding and a 1px currentColor underline drawn by `::after`, `scaleX(0)` from the left, going to `scaleX(1)` on hover/focus-visible over 0.35 s `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`. Ink x 182–509. - Right group (`margin-left:auto`, gap 30·n, margin-right 1·n, Plex Mono 13·n, letter-spacing 0.02em): - "CHAT", opacity .95, fading to .7 on hover over 0.25 s. Ink x 1184–1214. - "BOOK A CALL" pill: inline-flex, gap 8·n, height 32·n, padding 0 13·n, radius 999px, background #f4ede6, colour #a03815, Plex Mono 500, 12.6·n, letter-spacing 0.03em. It ends in a 12·n arrow icon: an SVG with viewBox 0 0 12 12, stroke currentColor 1.6, round caps, path `M3 9 9 3M4 3h5v5`. Box x 1245–1377, y 10–42. On hover the pill lifts 1px and gains `box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(80,20,0,.28)`, and the arrow moves (2px, −2px), both over 0.3 s `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`. 7. **Badge strip** (`ul.badges`, `aria-label` "How I work", absolute, full width, bottom 10·n, flex centred, z-index 5, Plex Mono 400, 13.4·n, letter-spacing 0.02em, `nowrap`, `text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(110,40,12,.55)`). Each `li` is a flex row with gap 8·n: a 15·n icon (with `drop-shadow(0 1px 4px rgba(110,40,12,.5))`) then the label. Separator: `li + li::before { content:"·"; margin:0 14n 0 6n; opacity:.85 }`. Items in order: 1. Bar-chart icon (three filled rounded bars) + "RESEARCH-LED PROCESS" 2. Pencil icon (stroked) + "HAND-MADE" 3. Diamond with inner circle (stroked) + "TAILOR-MADE SITES" 4. Price-tag icon with a dot (stroked) + "FIXED PRICING" 5. Clock icon (stroked circle with hands) + "QUICK REPLY" - All icons use a 16 × 16 viewBox with stroke-width 1.4. The strip spans x ≈ 306–1145 at 1440. ## 6. Green-screen keying (WebGL) Create a WebGL context on the portrait canvas with `{ premultipliedAlpha:true, alpha:true }`. Draw a full-screen triangle strip (−1,−1 / 1,−1 / −1,1 / 1,1). The vertex shader maps it to UVs with a flipped y: `v = vec2(p.x*.5+.5, .5-p.y*.5)`. The texture uses CLAMP_TO_EDGE and LINEAR filtering. Upload the current source each draw with `texImage2D`. Fragment shader: - `m = max(r, b)`, `d = g − m` - `alpha = 1 − smoothstep(0.06, 0.30, d)` - Spill clamp: `g = min(g, (r + b) × 0.52)`. This removes the green halo from fine hair strands while leaving brown hair, skin and the cream sweater untouched. - Output premultiplied: `gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb × alpha, alpha)`. Draw the still once it loads. When the portrait video fires `playing`, start a draw loop using `video.requestVideoFrameCallback` (fall back to `requestAnimationFrame`) that redraws the video every frame while `readyState >= 2`. The portrait video is never added to the DOM. ## 7. Motion and interaction **Video playback.** On load, call `play()` on both videos (muted, looped, inline). The still underneath stays visible until each video has frames, so nothing ever flashes empty. Both loops are exactly 5.04 s and start and end on their still. Hair, leaves and sparkles move only in these videos. Nothing in the scene is animated with CSS or SVG. **Entrance (one Web Animations timeline, runs once).** While loading, the hero has the class `js-pending`, which sets opacity 0 on the plate, portrait, name spans, copy, nav children and badge items. Start the timeline when the plate image, the portrait still and `document.fonts.ready` have all resolved, with a failsafe `setTimeout` at 3500 ms. Remove `js-pending`, then animate with easing `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.15,1)` and `fill:'backwards'`: | Element | From → to | Delay (ms) | Duration (ms) | |---|---|---|---| | Plate (still + video) | opacity 0, scale(1.06) → 1, scale(1) | 0 | 1600 | | Name line 1 | opacity 0, blur(14px), its own translateX + translateY(40px) → opacity 1, blur 0, its translateX | 250 | 1400 | | Name line 2 | same | 410 | 1400 | | Portrait | opacity 0, translateY(60px) → 1, none | 520 | 1500 | | Nav children (logo, links, right group) | opacity 0, translateY(−12px) → 1, none | 700, 790, 880 | 900 | | Copy c1, c2, c3, c4 (in DOM order; on phones the single .mcopy block) | opacity 0, translateY(14px), clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) → 1, none, inset(0 0 0% 0) | 1000 + i × 120 | 1000 | | Badge items 1–5 | opacity 0, translateY(10px) → 1, none | 1300 + i × 80 | 800 | **Reduced motion.** With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, all CSS transitions and animations are disabled, the entrance timeline is skipped (content appears at once), both videos are paused, the scene video is hidden and the keyed portrait still is redrawn. The page listens for changes to the setting and switches live. ## 8. Phone layout (max-width 820px) - `body` scrolls (`overflow:auto`). `--n` becomes 100vw/390. - `.hero` becomes a flex column, height auto, min-height 100svh. - Nav: static, height 64·n, padding 0 18·n. Wordmark 30·n. Links and CHAT are hidden; the pill is 34·n high with 12·n text. - A separate `.mcopy` block (hidden on desktop) appears under the nav: padding 6·n 18·n 0, Plex Mono 11.2·n, line-height 1.45, uppercase. Rows: (1) "I design calm, honest / digital interfaces — / shaped like architecture, / warm like baked clay." on the left and "Based / in Lisbon, / remote" on the right (`space-between`, gap 14·n). (2) "No noise. No fluff. Just / craft. Every detail earns / its own place." (3) "Independent designer for / studios that value / clarity, craft, and the / long-lasting simplicity." There are 12·n gaps between rows. The desktop `.copy` blocks are hidden. - `.stage` is relative, `flex:1`, min-height 560·n, `overflow:hidden`. It holds a cropped view of the same scene: both `.cover` and `.frame` use `--u = 100vw/700`, left −370·u, bottom −20·u, no transform. This shows frame x 370–1070, with the name and portrait centred. - The fade is 110·n tall. - Badges: absolute, bottom 12·n, wrap and centre, row-gap 7·n, column-gap 16·n, padding 0 18·n, 10·n text, 12·n icons, gap 6·n, no dot separators. ## 9. Acceptance checklist - At 1440 × 900 the page matches the measurements above within 2 px. The glowing name sits behind the portrait, and the portrait's hair overlaps the letters with clean keyed edges and no green fringe. - Both videos play and loop seamlessly. Hair visibly whips in the wind and the agave sways hard; nothing else in the scene moves. - On a wide, short window (e.g. 1536 × 776) the name never touches the nav, the copy blocks stay fully visible, and the scene still covers edge to edge. - At 390 × 844 the copy sits above the scene, with no horizontal scroll and no overlaps. - Reduced motion shows the stills with no animation. - No external requests other than the four media URLs above and the four font files (or none for fonts in the standalone build).

source: "motionsites"
id: "bold-studio"
title: "Bold Studio"
category: "Hero"
type: "hero"

url: "https://motionsites.ai/sections#bold-studio"
---

Build a fullscreen hero landing page for a creative agency called "VANGUARD" using React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. The page should be a single viewport-height section with a looping background video and all content overlaid on top.

**Background video:**
Use this exact CloudFront URL as a fullscreen `<video>` element with `autoPlay`, `muted`, `loop`, and `playsInline` attributes, set to `object-cover` to fill the entire viewport:
```
https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260606_154941_df1a96e1-a06f-450c-bd02-d863414cc1a0.mp4
```

**Fonts (loaded in index.html):**
1. "FSP DEMO - PODIUM Sharp 4.11" from `https://db.onlinewebfonts.com/c/8b75d9dcff6a48c35a46656192adf019?family=FSP+DEMO+-+PODIUM+Sharp+4.11` -- used for the brand name and main heading. Create a `.font-podium` utility class for it and register it in tailwind.config.js as `fontFamily.podium`.
2. "Inter" from Google Fonts (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) -- used for body text, nav links, stats, and CTAs. Register it in tailwind.config.js as `fontFamily.inter`.

**Icons:** Use `lucide-react` for all icons: `ArrowUpRight`, `Award`, `Crown`, and `X`.

**Navbar:**
- Horizontal bar at the top with responsive padding (`px-6 sm:px-10 lg:px-16`, `py-5 lg:py-7`).
- Left: brand name "VANGUARD" in `font-podium`, white, bold, uppercase, `text-2xl sm:text-3xl`, `tracking-wider`.
- Center (hidden below `md`): four nav links -- "Projects", "Studio", "Offerings", "Inquire" -- in `font-inter`, `text-sm`, `text-white/80`, `tracking-widest`, uppercase, with `hover:text-white` transition.
- Right (hidden below `md`): a "GET IN TOUCH" link with an `ArrowUpRight` icon, styled as a bordered button (`border border-white/30 hover:border-white/60`, `px-6 py-3`, `text-xs`, `tracking-widest`, uppercase, `hover:bg-white/10`).
- Right (visible below `md`): a hamburger button made of three white `div` bars (`w-6 h-0.5`, `w-6 h-0.5`, `w-4 h-0.5` with `space-y-1.5`).

**Mobile Menu Overlay (below `md` only):**
- Fixed fullscreen overlay (`fixed inset-0 z-50`) with `bg-black/95 backdrop-blur-sm`.
- Toggles visibility via React `useState` -- when open: `opacity-100 visible`, when closed: `opacity-0 invisible`, with `transition-all duration-500`.
- Header row matches the navbar: brand name on left, `X` close icon on right.
- Centered vertically: each of the 4 nav links rendered in `font-podium`, `text-4xl sm:text-5xl`, white, uppercase, with staggered entrance animations using inline `style` -- each item gets `transitionDelay: i * 80 + 100ms`, `opacity` and `translateY(20px)` transitions based on the open state.
- Below the links: a "GET IN TOUCH" bordered button with the same staggered animation pattern.
- All links call `setMenuOpen(false)` on click.

**Hero Content (vertically centered, left-aligned):**
All hero elements use staggered `animate-fade-up` animations (defined in CSS as `@keyframes fade-up` translating from `translateY(30px), opacity:0` to `translateY(0), opacity:1` over `0.8s ease-out`). Each successive element has an additional `0.2s` delay. Elements start with `opacity: 0` and use `animation-fill-mode: forwards`.

1. **Tagline:** A `Crown` icon (lucide, `w-4 h-4`, `text-white/70`) followed by "World-Class Digital Collective" in `text-white/70`, `text-xs sm:text-sm`, `font-inter`, `tracking-[0.3em]`, uppercase. Uses `animate-fade-up` (no delay). Has `mb-6 lg:mb-8`.

2. **Main Heading:** Three lines in `font-podium`, white, uppercase, `leading-[0.92]`, `tracking-tight`, each using `text-[clamp(2.8rem,8vw,7rem)]`:
   - "Design."
   - "Disrupt."
   - "Conquer."
   Uses `animate-fade-up-delay-1` (0.2s delay).

3. **Subtext:** "We build fierce brand identities" (line break) "that don't just turn heads --" then bold white "they lead." in `text-white/70`, `text-sm sm:text-base`, `font-inter`, `leading-relaxed`, `max-w-md`. Uses `animate-fade-up-delay-2` (0.4s delay). `mt-6 lg:mt-8`.

4. **CTA Row:** Uses `animate-fade-up-delay-3` (0.6s delay), `mt-8 lg:mt-10`, `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 sm:gap-6`.
   - Black button "SEE OUR WORK" with `ArrowUpRight` icon. `bg-black hover:bg-neutral-900`, `px-5 sm:px-7 py-3 sm:py-4`, `text-[11px] sm:text-xs`, `tracking-widest`, uppercase. Arrow has `group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5` transition.
   - Beside it (hidden on mobile, `hidden sm:flex`): an `Award` icon (`w-8 h-8`, `text-white/50`) with two lines of text: "Top-Rated" / "Brand Studio" in `text-white/60`, `text-xs`, `tracking-wider`, uppercase.

5. **Stats Row:** Uses `animate-fade-up-delay-4` (0.8s delay), `mt-8 sm:mt-10 lg:mt-14`, `flex flex-wrap gap-6 sm:gap-12 lg:gap-16`. Three stats:
   - "250+" / "Brands Transformed"
   - "95%" / "Client Retention"
   - "10+" / "Years in the Game"
   Values in `font-inter`, white, `text-2xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl`, bold, `tracking-tight`. Labels in `text-white/50`, `text-[9px] sm:text-xs`, `tracking-widest`, uppercase, `mt-1`.

**CSS Animations (defined in index.css under `@layer utilities`):**
```css
@keyframes fade-up {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@keyframes fade-in {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes scale-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.9); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
```
With classes: `.animate-fade-up` (0s delay), `.animate-fade-up-delay-1` through `.animate-fade-up-delay-4` (0.2s increments, starting `opacity: 0`), `.animate-fade-in`, `.animate-fade-in-delay`.

**Responsive behavior:**
- Full layout is mobile-first with breakpoints at `sm` (640px), `md` (768px), and `lg` (1024px).
- Nav links and "GET IN TOUCH" button show at `md`+; hamburger shows below `md`.
- Award badge hides on mobile (`hidden sm:flex`).
- All text sizes, paddings, gaps, and margins scale up through `sm:` and `lg:` prefixes.
- Stats and CTA row use `flex-wrap` to prevent overflow on small screens.

Make everything fully mobile responsive. Use a single `App.tsx` component with `useState` for the menu toggle. No routing needed.

---
source: "motionsites"
id: "cozypaws"
title: "CozyPaws"

---

## Prompt to Recreate CozyPaws Hero Section

**Build a single-page "CozyPaws" pet store hero section using React, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React icons. The layout is viewport-height (h-screen), no scroll, with three responsive breakpoints (mobile, tablet md, desktop lg+). Use Vite + TypeScript.**

---

### Fonts (Google Fonts)
- **Inter** (weights: 400, 500, 600) — body/UI text
- **DM Serif Display** (weight: 400) — hero heading only

Load via `<link>` in `index.html`:
```
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap
```

Apply with CSS utility class `.font-serif-display { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; }` and `body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }`

---

### Color Palette
- Background: `#EFFDF0` (light mint green)
- Primary dark green: `#1a3d1a`
- Hover green: `#2a5a2a`
- Orange accent: `#E86A10`
- Orange hover: `#d45e0d`

---

### Asset URLs (all external, do not download)

| Asset | URL |
|-------|-----|
| Logo SVG | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/0ae29d6d9628bede667f90d57bebe81b8f1ec2bf.svg` |
| Avatar | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/e62173d41f91350a59628e8a9a55ae078a886fb9.png?w=128` |
| Product card (Cat House) | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/3e5158dad63d392ade022e81890edc9f54d750bc.png` |
| Video card (TikTok/YouTube) | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/76be6ec3a93a703b15e9cc01e764a4e3f9d7d2c0.png` |
| Bottom left image | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/8d44b25186ef45a5789c74668fb781cea4e1ff49.png` |
| Bottom center image (tallest) | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/96745c4e72ad5c5208e53a885df797fd82cd854a.png?h=1024` |
| Bottom right image | `https://polo-pecan-73837341.figma.site/_assets/v11/81bd2e7a66b58f3d8f3ad78fd1ebf01af8dfdee1.png` |

---

### Header
- Full-width, `px-12` on desktop, `py-4`, relative z-30
- **Left:** Logo image (205x52px desktop, 130x33px mobile)
- **Center nav (hidden below md):** Links "Home" (text-gray-900), "Shop", "Delivery and payment", "Brands", "Blog" (text-gray-600), text-sm font-medium, gap-8
- **Right:** Search button (circle, border, hidden below sm), Favorites button (orange circle, white star icon, badge "4"), Cart button (circle, border, cart icon, badge "1"), Avatar (circle, 40x40)
- Badges: absolute -top-1 -right-1, 20x20, bg-orange, border-2 border-background, white text 10px bold

---

### Desktop Hero Layout (lg+)

**Text layer (z-5):** Centered, `px-12 pt-[5.4rem]`
- Heading: `font-serif-display`, color `#1a3d1a`, `text-[clamp(60px,7.5vw,110px)]`, `leading-[0.95]`, tracking-tight
- Text reads: "Everything" (line 1), "Your Pets Love" (line 2)
- Each word is an `inline-block` with staggered `animate-word-pop` animation

**Left product card:** Absolutely positioned `top-[50px] left-12`
- Width: `clamp(160px,14vw,260px)`
- Image: aspect-ratio 260/257, rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden
- Arrow button bottom-right corner (dark green circle, ArrowUpRight icon)
- Text below: "Cozy Cat House" in gray-700, "$49.99" in dark green bold
- Responsive font sizes via clamp

**Right video card:** Absolutely positioned `top-[50px] right-12`
- Width: `clamp(120px,10vw,177px)`
- Image: aspect-ratio 177/287, rounded-2xl
- Play button (dark green circle) centered near bottom
- Text below play button: "Watch Product Reviews on TikTok and YouTube"

**Bottom 3 images:** Absolutely positioned `bottom-0 left-0 right-0`, z-10, flex items-end, no gaps
- Left image: `flex-1`, max-height `min(70vh, 55vw)`
- Center image: `flex-[1.265]` (wider), max-height `min(85vh, 70vw)`
- Right image: `flex-1`, max-height `min(70vh, 55vw)`
- All images: `w-full h-auto block`

**Overlays on bottom images:**
- Left: "98K+" stat with avatar stack (avatar + green circle with Plus icon)
- Center: "Best Products for Your Pet" white heading + "Explore Products" orange pill button with ArrowRight icon
- Right: "4.6" rating with orange filled Star icon
- All positioned with `bottom: clamp(20px, 4vh, 50px)`

---

### Tablet Layout (md to lg) — Similar to desktop but smaller
- Heading: text-7xl
- Side cards at `top-[80px]`, left-4/right-4, smaller fixed widths (160px/120px)
- Bottom images: same 3-panel flex, maxHeight 60vh/75vh/60vh

---

### Mobile Layout (below md)
- Top section: centered title (36px), subtitle, "Explore Products" button
- Two cards side-by-side (flex, gap-3): product card (aspect-square) + video card (aspect-3/4)
- Stats row: "98K+" with avatars left, divider, "4.6" star right
- Bottom images: same 3-panel flex, no max-height constraint

---

### Animations (CSS keyframes, custom classes)

| Class | Keyframe | Duration | Easing |
|-------|----------|----------|--------|
| `.animate-fade-up` | 0→30px translateY, 0→1 opacity | 0.8s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |
| `.animate-fade-in` | 0→1 opacity | 0.6s | ease-out |
| `.animate-slide-up` | 0→60px translateY | 0.9s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |
| `.animate-slide-in-left` | -40px→0 translateX | 0.8s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |
| `.animate-slide-in-right` | 40px→0 translateX | 0.8s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |
| `.animate-text-reveal` | translateY(40px) skewY(3deg) blur(4px) → none | 1s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |
| `.animate-word-pop` | translateY(60px) scale(0.7) rotate(-4deg) blur(8px) → bounce overshoot → settle | 0.9s | cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) |
| `.animate-scale-in` | scale(0.85)→1 | 0.7s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |
| `.animate-photo-reveal` | translateY(80px) scale(1.02) → normal | 1.1s | cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) |

All use `animation-fill-mode: both`. `.animate-word-pop` starts with `opacity: 0`.

**Delay classes:** `.delay-100` through `.delay-1200` in 100ms increments.

---

### Stagger Order
1. Header fades in (100-300ms)
2. Hero heading words pop in (200-600ms stagger)
3. Side cards slide in (600-700ms)
4. Bottom photos reveal upward (600-900ms stagger, center first)
5. Overlay stats/buttons pop in (1000-1200ms)

---

### Key Technical Details
- Container: `h-screen flex flex-col overflow-hidden` (no scrolling)
- Header: `shrink-0`
- Hero section: `flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-hidden`
- All responsive layouts use show/hide (`hidden lg:flex`, etc.), not CSS-only media queries
- Extensive use of `clamp()` for fluid typography and spacing
- Lucide icons used: Search, ShoppingCart, Star, ArrowUpRight, Play, ArrowRight, Plus

Three full-screen looping videos (muted, autoPlay, playsInline, loop) stacked absolutely with crossfade switching. All three render simultaneously; only the active one has `opacity-100`, the others have `opacity-0` with `transition-opacity duration-[1200ms] ease-in-out`.

Container: `max-w-[1340px]`, full height, flex column, `justify-end items-end`, `gap-[150px]`, `pt-[190px] px-[15px]`

- Right column (`flex-1`, `pl-[50px]`): Paragraph text ("I craft bold brands and modern websites with purpose...") at `text-base leading-6 tracking-[-0.16px] font-medium`. Below it, a "start a project" button (lowercase) with white border. Button has a fill-up hover effect: `::before` pseudo-element with `#F598F2` background that translateY from 101% to 0 on hover, text turns black, border turns pink. Both animate in with `revealRight` (translateX 100px to 0, 0.9s spring ease), button delayed by 0.08s.

**Reveal animations** trigger once via IntersectionObserver at 0.35 threshold.

---

### Responsive Tablet (810px-1199px)
- Navbar: `py-[30px] px-[18px]`, nav gaps shrink to `gap-4`
- Hero name: `text-[129.6px] leading-[113.4px] tracking-[-7.7px]`

@keyframes dotPulse { 0%,100% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1) } 50% { opacity:0.45; transform:scale(1.45) } }

- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disables all animations
- Semantic landmarks: `<header>`, `<main>`, `<nav>`, `<section>`

- Videos are `aria-hidden="true"`

No other packages. ## Assets ``` BG_IMAGE_1 (base, red-tinted portrait): https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260609_125121_afb71ce9-9c64-4c54-90b5-c89c0764c052.png&w=1920&q=85 BG_IMAGE_2 (alternate reveal image): https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260609_135737_0da59642-725b-451a-997b-b0283d95a42a.png&w=1280&q=85 ``` ## Fonts (index.css) - Google Fonts import: `JetBrains Mono` weights 300–800 plus italic 400/500. - Apply globally: `* { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }` and a `.font-helvetica-neue` class that also resolves to JetBrains Mono. - Also declare a `@font-face` for 'Helvetica Neue Roman' from `/fonts/HelveticaNeue-Roman.woff2` / `.woff` (weight 400, `font-display: swap`) — declared but the mono font is what renders. - Root wrapper div: `min-h-screen bg-white tracking-[-0.02em]` with inline `fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace"`. ## Navbar (fixed, z-50) `
` - **Desktop (md+): ONE centered pill** — `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full pl-3 pr-2 py-2 flex items-center gap-1` containing, in order: a 22x22 white SVG logo (geometric angular mark, viewBox 0 0 256 256, path: `M 256 64 L 256 128 L 192.5 128 L 160 95 L 128 64 L 96 95 L 63.5 128 L 64 128 L 128 192 L 128 256 L 64.5 256 L 32 223 L 0 192 L 0 64 L 64 0 L 192 0 Z M 256 192 L 256 256 L 192.5 256 L 160 223 L 128 192 L 128 128 L 192 128 Z`); text link buttons "Module" (white, active), "Case Records", "Biotech", "Tiers", "Live Demo" (gray-300, `text-sm font-medium px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white`); and a white CTA "Connect" (`bg-white text-gray-900 text-sm font-semibold px-5 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-100 ml-1`). - **Mobile (` of grid lines (`stroke #64748b`, width 0.6). The pattern's x/y offset follows the mouse with parallax: target = (normalized cursor position − 0.5) × 16px, eased at 0.06 lerp per frame. 2. **Base image (z-10):** `bg-center bg-cover` div with BG_IMAGE_1, with a Ken Burns intro: `@keyframes kenBurns { from { transform: scale(1.12) } to { scale(1) } }`, 2.4s `cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)` forwards. 3. **Cursor spotlight reveal layer (z-30):** a second `bg-cover` div with BG_IMAGE_2, masked by a canvas-generated radial gradient that follows the smoothed cursor.
